Hierarchical RL itself was not introduced by this paper; the contribution lies in this concrete interface, training order, and complete system.

System contribution: the same footstep interface supports path following, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, and soccer dribbling through foot–ball contact, demonstrating its value as an action abstraction for multiple environment-aware locomotion tasks.

Key auxiliary design: reference-motion rewards reduce the exploration burden of 3D bipedal walking, while a four-slot bilinear phase transform explicitly separates gait phases. These components are important to training but are not the central hierarchical contribution.

Limited module reuse: style-specific LLCs are fine-tuned from a nominal LLC, and HLCs can be fine-tuned after changing the LLC. The evidence supports reuse as a useful initialization, not arbitrary lossless plug-and-play compatibility.
implementation: Data preparation: the LLC can use either a handcrafted keyframed walk cycle or roughly seven seconds of walking and turning mocap. The mocap is divided into about ten single-step clips, normalized to right-foot support, and time-warped to 0.5 seconds; clips are mirrored according to the current support leg. At each step, a nearest-neighbor selector chooses the clip best matching the requested foot placement and heading.

LLC inputs and outputs: the 110-dimensional low-level state contains root-relative link positions, rotations, linear and angular velocities, two foot-contact indicators, and a fixed phase. It also receives two future footsteps and a desired torso heading. At 30 Hz, the LLC outputs 22-dimensional joint PD targets rather than torques.

Boundary of reference motion: reference clips are used only to select imitation targets and compute training rewards; they are not LLC runtime inputs. Mocap, the reference selector, and imitation rewards can therefore be removed at runtime, so the LLC is not a reference-conditioned tracker.

LLC reward: the objective combines joint-pose, joint-velocity, root-height, center-of-mass velocity, swing- and stance-foot position, and heading terms. Reference terms preserve motion style, while foot-placement and heading terms allow the policy to deviate from the reference and follow high-level commands.

Learning algorithm: both levels use a CACLA-style actor–critic with a replay buffer containing the latest 50k transitions. The critic learns a one-step bootstrapped value; the actor moves toward an exploratory action only when noise was actually applied and the TD error is positive. Exploration uses a fixed diagonal Gaussian gated by a Bernoulli variable, while runtime execution uses only the actor mean.

Network and optimization: after the four-slot bilinear phase transform, the LLC actor uses 512- and 256-unit ReLU layers and a 22-dimensional output. Optimization uses SGD with 0.9 momentum; the actor has L2 weight decay of 0.0005, while the critic has no weight decay. This is an auxiliary policy-regularization choice rather than a core contribution.

HLC inputs and outputs: for static-environment tasks, the high-level state combines character features with a character-centric 32×32 height map and is reported as 1129-dimensional; dynamic-obstacle tasks replace it with a velocity map encoding horizontal obstacle velocities. The HLC additionally receives a task goal and outputs two 2D footsteps plus one heading at 2 Hz, yielding a five-dimensional interface by construction.

HLC network: the map passes through 16 filters of size 5×5, 32 filters of size 4×4, 32 filters of size 3×3, and a 128-unit fully connected layer. The result is concatenated with character features and the task goal, followed by 512- and 256-unit ReLU layers. Convolution stride, padding, pooling, and the complete HLC critic architecture are not specified.

Two-stage training: the nominal LLC is trained for about 6M iterations and then fully frozen; a separate HLC is trained for each path, obstacle, or soccer task for about 1M iterations. The paper reports roughly two days for LLC training and seven days per HLC on a 16-core CPU, but it does not define whether an iteration denotes a transition, batch, or SGD update.

Runtime loop: the HLC generates a foot plan every 0.5 seconds, during which the LLC performs about 15 updates. Stable PD converts joint targets into bounded torques, and Bullet advances physics at 3 kHz. Runtime retains the HLC actor, LLC actor, fixed phase, state and map extraction, action clipping, PD, and physical system; critics, replay buffers, rewards, reference motions, and exploration noise are removed.

Experimental conclusion: Figure 11 shows that the hierarchical version substantially outperforms the authors' monolithic versions on path following and soccer, while Figure 8 shows that multiple reference clips improve LLC learning. The nominal gait tolerates the tested 200 N forward push, 210 N lateral push, and 16% uphill slope, but the experiments provide no multi-seed error bars, external-method baseline, or real-robot validation.

Key limitations: the system relies on simulation-ground-truth proprioception, foot contacts, local maps, and ball state. The default LLC only walks and turns at an approximately fixed speed and cannot stop, contributing to the low dynamic-obstacle NCR of 0.18. Each new heterogeneous task still requires a new HLC, and the system is bounded by the LLC skill repertoire and footstep-training distribution.

Reproduction caveats: the critic target in Algorithm 1 conflicts with the main-text equations and may subtract the value twice; the final slot in the bilinear phase equation also appears to repeat Phi2 instead of Phi3. Complete link inertias and collision geometry, precise normalization parameters, per-dimension exploration variances, mocap indices, and retargeting scripts are also missing.

zh.title: Retargeting Matters: General Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Motion Tracking
zh.authors: João Pedro Araújo, Yanjie Ze, Pei Xu, Jiajun Wu, C. Karen Liu
zh.institutions: Department of Computer Science, School of Engineering, Stanford University
zh.takeaway: 局部非均匀缩放加两阶段逐帧 IK，把人体动作转换为更易被物理策略跟踪的机器人参考。
zh.mainContent: GMR 将人体骨架动作、机器人模型和关键体配置转换为机器人 root 位姿与关节参考轨迹。方法先分开处理 root 的全局缩放与各肢体的局部缩放，再逐帧进行两阶段 IK：先匹配关键体旋转和手脚位置，随后扩展到全部关键体的位置精修。固定 BeyondMimic 训练管线的 G1 / LAFAN1 实验比较不同参考，展示重定向中的穿地、自交和关节突跳对下游跟踪质量的影响。
innovations: 将 root 的整体位移与肢体相对 root 的形态缩放分开处理。
以粗构型初始化加全关键体精修组织两阶段 IK。
在固定物理跟踪管线中比较重定向参考质量。
implementation: 输入 LAFAN1 BVH、机器人 XML / URDF、关键体映射、rest-pose offset、scale、位置旋转权重和关节限位。
预处理对齐 rest pose，分别缩放 root 的世界平移和 body 相对 root 的位置。
第一阶段使用 Mink differential IK，匹配关键体旋转与手脚位置；第二阶段扩展关键体位置目标，以第一阶段结果初始化。
逐帧使用上一帧解 warm start；完成整段后通过 FK 修正 root 的统一竖直偏移。每条新动作重新执行这套运动学求解。
下游按参考分别训练 BeyondMimic single-trajectory policy，在 sim、域随机化 sim 和 MuJoCo sim2sim 中比较成功率与跟踪误差。

en.title: Retargeting Matters: General Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Motion Tracking
en.authors: João Pedro Araújo, Yanjie Ze, Pei Xu, Jiajun Wu, C. Karen Liu
en.institutions: Department of Computer Science, School of Engineering, Stanford University
en.takeaway: Combines local nonuniform scaling and two-stage framewise IK to produce robot references that are easier for physical policies to track.
en.mainContent: GMR converts skeletal human motion, a robot model, and key-body configuration into root and joint reference trajectories. It separates global root scaling from local body scaling, then runs two-stage framewise IK: key-body rotations and hand/foot positions first, followed by position refinement for all key bodies. G1 / LAFAN1 experiments with a fixed BeyondMimic pipeline show how penetration, self-intersection, and joint jumps affect downstream tracking.
innovations: Separates global root displacement from local limb scaling.
Organizes IK as a coarse configuration followed by full key-body refinement.
Compares retargeting references through a fixed physical-tracking pipeline.
implementation: Inputs include LAFAN1 BVH, robot XML / URDF, key-body mappings, rest-pose offsets, scales, pose weights, and joint limits.
Aligns rest poses and separately scales world-space root translation and root-relative body positions.
Stage 1 uses Mink differential IK for key-body rotations and hand/foot positions; Stage 2 expands position targets and starts from the Stage 1 solution.
Warm-starts each frame from the previous solution and uses FK to correct a uniform vertical root offset after processing. Each new clip runs this kinematic solver.
Trains a BeyondMimic single-trajectory policy per reference and evaluates success and tracking error in simulation, randomized simulation, and MuJoCo sim-to-sim.

zh.title: Physics-Based Motion Imitation with Adversarial Differential Discriminators
zh.authors: Ziyu Zhang, Sergey Bashkirov, Dun Yang, Yi Shi, Michael Taylor, Xue Bin Peng
zh.institutions: Simon Fraser University; Sony PlayStation; NVIDIA
zh.takeaway: 用对抗差分判别器聚合跟踪误差，替代手工配权的奖励，同时保留 reference-conditioned PPO 控制。
zh.mainContent: ADD 保留 reference-conditioned motion imitation 的 PPO / PD 控制链，以 differential discriminator 聚合参考与实际动作之间的差异，形成可学习跟踪奖励。判别器替代手工配权的多项奖励，策略继续根据当前状态和参考闭环执行。实验评估不同动作的模仿质量，并与 DeepMimic 等跟踪方法比较。
innovations: 核心创新：提出 Adversarial Differential Discriminator（ADD），用 MLP 判别器替代多目标损失的固定线性加权，将高维差分非线性地聚合为单一训练信号，并允许聚合关系随当前策略误差分布变化。
核心机制：把理想解统一表示为唯一的零差分正样本，把当前模型或策略产生的差分作为负类样本；判别器学习的是“当前误差离理想零点有多近”，而不是 AMP 式 expert motion distribution。
关键辅助设计：在策略实际产生的负类差分附近施加 zero-centered gradient penalty，避免判别器退化为只识别精确零点的硬分类器；消融显示没有该项或直接采用 WGAN-GP 时多数任务失败。
工程扩展：同一 ADD 聚合形式被用于精确 motion tracking、imitation + steering，以及 Walker/Go1 的非模仿多目标 RL；reference-conditioned actor、PPO、GAE、TD(λ) 与 PD controller 均属于继承组件，不是本文新提出的控制接口。
implementation: 输入与差分：参考状态和同一时刻的仿真状态先映射为同构特征，再计算 \(\boldsymbol{\Delta}_t\)。差分包含 root 全局位置/旋转、各关节局部位置与全局旋转、root 局部线/角速度及各关节局部速度。
Actor 接收当前各 body link 相对 root 的位置、6D normal-tangent 旋转、局部线/角速度以及同步目标 reference pose，输出高斯动作分布下的关节目标旋转；球关节使用 3D exponential map，转动关节输出标量角度，随后由 PD controller 转成执行力矩。

训练循环：策略在 Isaac Gym 中 rollout，逐步计算差分与奖励 \(r_t=-\log(1-D(\boldsymbol{\Delta}_t))\)；GAE 估计优势、TD(λ) 构造 value target，PPO 更新 actor，回归损失更新 critic，判别器使用零向量正类与 rollout/cache 中的差分负类交替更新。判别器梯度不会穿过仿真器直接回传给 actor。
网络与优化：actor、critic 和 discriminator 都使用 1024、512 单元的两层 ReLU MLP；actor 后接线性动作头，critic 与 discriminator 输出标量。策略协方差是人工指定的固定对角阵。

控制与训练规模：28-DoF humanoid 的仿真/策略频率为 120/30 Hz，26-DoF Sony EVAL 为 150/50 Hz；主要实验使用 NVIDIA A100。多数单动作约训练 7.5–8.5 亿 samples，ADD 约 9 h；DanceDB 约 90 亿 samples、约 5 天，LaFAN1 子集约 180 亿 samples、约 10 天，因此它减少的是 reward 调参成本而不是计算成本。
关键证据与失败：Double Kong 的位置误差为 ADD 0.030 m、DeepMimic 0.223 m；DanceDB 为 0.044/0.045 m，LaFAN1 为 0.028/0.029 m。Run 上 ADD 为 0.165 m、DeepMimic 为 0.013 m，且 Sideflip、Roll 会出现局部最优。

训练/部署边界：训练时需要参考动作、物理仿真器、ADD、critic、PPO/GAE、经验缓存和梯度惩罚；推理时只保留当前状态、同步 reference pose、冻结 actor 与 PD controller，ADD 和 tracking 差分都不再运行。论文全部结果均为仿真，没有 system identification、domain randomization、延迟/噪声建模或真机部署证据。
ADD 的 Double Kong / DanceDB / LaFAN1 位置误差为 0.030 / 0.044 / 0.028 m，DeepMimic 为 0.223 / 0.045 / 0.029 m；Run 为 0.165 m 对 0.013 m，Sideflip 与 Roll 出现局部最优。

en.title: Physics-Based Motion Imitation with Adversarial Differential Discriminators
en.authors: Ziyu Zhang, Sergey Bashkirov, Dun Yang, Yi Shi, Michael Taylor, Xue Bin Peng
en.institutions: Simon Fraser University; Sony PlayStation; NVIDIA
en.takeaway: Uses adversarial differential discriminators to aggregate tracking errors into rewards within reference-conditioned PPO control.
en.mainContent: ADD retains reference-conditioned PPO / PD motion imitation and learns tracking rewards with differential discriminators over reference–execution differences. The discriminator aggregates reward components while the policy executes feedback control from current state and reference. Experiments compare imitation quality against tracking methods including DeepMimic.
innovations: Core innovation: Adversarial Differential Discriminator (ADD) replaces a fixed weighted sum of objectives with an MLP discriminator that nonlinearly aggregates a high-dimensional differential into one training signal and can adapt to the current error distribution.

Core mechanism: the ideal solution is represented by a single zero-differential positive sample, while differentials produced by the current model or policy form the negative class; unlike AMP, the discriminator learns proximity to an ideal zero-error point rather than an expert motion distribution.

Key supporting design: a zero-centered gradient penalty is applied near policy-generated negative-class differentials to prevent the discriminator from becoming a hard detector of the exact zero point; the ablation shows that omitting it or directly using WGAN-GP causes most tasks to fail.

Engineering extension: the same ADD aggregation is applied to precise motion tracking, imitation plus steering, and non-imitation Walker/Go1 multi-objective RL. The reference-conditioned actor, PPO, GAE, TD(λ), and PD controller are inherited components rather than new control interfaces introduced by this paper.
implementation: Inputs and differential: aligned reference and simulated states are mapped to matching features before computing \(\boldsymbol{\Delta}_t\). Features include global root position/rotation, local joint positions and global joint rotations, local root linear/angular velocities, and local joint velocities.

The actor receives current body-link positions relative to the root, 6D normal-tangent rotations, local linear/angular velocities, and a synchronized target reference pose. It outputs Gaussian-distributed joint target rotations: 3D exponential maps for spherical joints and scalar angles for revolute joints, followed by a PD controller that produces torques.

Training loop: the policy rolls out in Isaac Gym and computes \(r_t=-\log(1-D(\boldsymbol{\Delta}_t))\) at every step. GAE estimates advantages, TD(λ) supplies value targets, PPO updates the actor, regression updates the critic, and the discriminator alternates updates using zero-vector positives and rollout/cache differential negatives. Discriminator gradients are not backpropagated through the simulator into the actor.

Networks and optimization: actor, critic, and discriminator use two-layer ReLU MLPs with 1024 and 512 hidden units. The actor has a linear action head, while critic and discriminator output scalars. The policy covariance is a manually specified fixed diagonal matrix.

Control and training scale: the 28-DoF humanoid runs at 120 Hz simulation and 30 Hz policy frequency, while the 26-DoF Sony EVAL runs at 150/50 Hz; major experiments use an NVIDIA A100. Most single-motion runs use roughly 0.75–0.85 billion samples and about 9 h for ADD; DanceDB uses about 9 billion samples and 5 days, and the LaFAN1 subset about 18 billion samples and 10 days, so the method reduces reward-tuning effort rather than computation.

ADD position errors on Double Kong / DanceDB / LaFAN1 are 0.030 / 0.044 / 0.028 m versus 0.223 / 0.045 / 0.029 m for DeepMimic. Run reaches 0.165 m versus 0.013 m; Sideflip and Roll exhibit local optima.

Training/deployment boundary: training requires reference motions, the physics simulator, ADD, critic, PPO/GAE, replay storage, and gradient regularization. In inference, only the current state, synchronized reference pose, frozen actor, and PD controller remain; ADD and tracking-differential computation are removed. All reported results are simulated, with no system identification, domain randomization, latency/noise model, or real-robot evidence.

zh.title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
zh.authors: Joonho Lee, Jemin Hwangbo, Lorenz Wellhausen, Vladlen Koltun, Marco Hutter
zh.institutions: Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich; Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Lab, KAIST; Intelligent Systems Lab, Intel
zh.takeaway: 把特权教师的动作和环境 latent 蒸馏到约两秒本体历史的 TCN，学生调节足端轨迹并由 IK / PD 执行。
zh.mainContent: 论文研究 ANYmal 在没有视觉、显式接触检测和滑移检测的条件下，如何仅依靠本体感知历史在未知崎岖地形上稳定运动。方法先在程序化刚体地形中以 TRPO 训练具有地形、接触、摩擦和外力特权信息的教师，再通过 DAgger 让因果 TCN 学生同时模仿教师动作与教师隐变量，并用粒子滤波课程把训练地形维持在中等难度。部署时只保留本体学生、PMTG、水平足端坐标系、解析 IK、状态估计器与关节 PD，网络输出的是四腿频率偏置和足端位置残差，而不是力矩或最终关节位置目标。多随机种子消融、10 kg 载荷、湿滑表面、自然地形与 DARPA 地下挑战部署支持其鲁棒性，但方法只得到 trot 步态，盲行无法预见悬崖，且自然地形泛化缺少系统的大样本成功率统计。
innovations: 核心创新：以长时间因果 TCN 读取本体历史，让策略隐式利用卡脚、滑移、持续外力和地形变化的时间证据，减少对人工接触/滑移检测器和反射状态机的依赖。
核心创新：采用特权教师—本体学生两阶段学习。教师直接读取仿真中的局部地形、接触、摩擦和外力真值；学生在自己访问的状态分布上通过 DAgger 同时拟合教师动作与教师环境隐变量，把困难的部分可观测 RL 转化为带表征监督的模仿学习。
核心创新：以 0.5 到 0.9 的可通行性区间为目标，用粒子滤波维护程序化地形参数分布，使课程随当前策略能力自动移动到“能够前进但仍有挑战”的区域，而不是按固定时间表单调加难。
关键系统设计：策略采用 PMTG 接口，只修正每条腿的频率和三维足端目标；水平足端坐标系保持竖直轴与重力对齐，再由已有的 FTG、解析 IK 和 PD 完成可执行映射。PMTG、IK、PD、TRPO、TCN 与 DAgger 本身并非本文新算法，贡献在于围绕特权训练和纯本体部署形成闭环。
implementation: 任务输入是平面运动方向、离散转向命令以及机器人本体状态；方向命令只给方向而不指定速度幅值。当前观测包含重力方向、基座线/角速度、关节位置/速度、腿相位与频率及执行器短历史，实机基座状态依赖 IMU 与腿运动学状态估计器。
教师状态由可部署观测 o_t 与特权信息 x_t 组成；特权信息包括每足周围的局部高度、地形法向、足/胫/大腿接触、足地摩擦和基座外力。教师的特权编码器产生环境 latent，Table S5 的末层规模表明该 latent 为 64 维，但正文未单独声明这一维数。
教师在 RaiSim 中使用 TRPO 训练：batch size 80,000，共 10,000 次迭代，平均 KL 约束阈值 0.01，共轭梯度 50 次，damping 0.1；奖励覆盖命令方向速度、转向、机身稳定、摆动足净空、非足端碰撞、足端目标平滑和关节力矩。
课程标签由 rollout 自动生成：若下一状态沿命令方向的速度投影大于 0.2 m/s，则该状态转移标 1；速度不足或 episode 终止则标 0。地形可通行性是这些转移标签的期望或比例，不等同于严格的整回合到达终点成功率，也不是要求精确达到某个预设速度；线速度奖励在 0.6 m/s 处饱和，与课程的 0.2 m/s 判定阈值用途不同。
每类 hills、slippery hills、steps 或 stairs 地形维护 10 个参数粒子，每粒子生成 6 条轨迹；课程每 10 次策略迭代重估权重并重采样，以 0.8 概率在离散参数网格上随机移动到邻居，以 0.05 概率回放旧地形。粒子表示的是地形生成参数而非机器人状态，粒子滤波只负责下一批训练地形的采样，不在真机上估计地形。
学生使用因果 TCN 编码本体历史。默认 TCN-100 每 0.02 s 保存一帧、覆盖约 2.0 s，采用卷积核 5、dilation 1/2/4 的三组因果卷积与 stride-2 卷积，最终产生 64 维 latent；动作主干为 256-128-64-16 的 MLP。学生损失是动作均方误差与 latent 均方误差之和。
学生阶段冻结教师，由学生在课程地形上 rollout，再让教师针对学生实际访问的同一仿真状态生成动作与 latent 标签。学生用 Adam 训练 4,000 次迭代，batch size 20,000，每轮 4 个 epoch、5 个 minibatch，初始学习率 5e-4 并指数衰减。
策略 action 共 16 维：4 个腿频率偏置和 4 个三维足端位置残差。在线链路为“TCN/MLP action → FTG 周期足端底稿与残差相加 → 从水平足端坐标系变换 → 解析 IK 得到 12 维关节位置目标 → 高频关节 PD 产生力矩”，因此神经网络 action 本身不是 PD target。
仿真中使用针对机器人平台训练的执行器网络近似串联弹性执行器与 PD 动态，并随机化地形摩擦、外力和观测噪声。真机部署删除教师、特权信息、地形课程、诊断 decoder 与仿真执行器网络，只保留学生前向、状态估计、相位或足端轨迹生成、IK 和真实关节 PD；ANYmal-B 与 ANYmal-C 不能据论文视为共享同一组跨形态权重。
教师训练约 12 小时，学生约 4 小时，报告硬件为 Intel i7-8700K 与 GeForce RTX 2080。论文对控制频率存在内部不一致：Figure 4C 标注网络或轨迹生成 50 Hz、关节 PD 400 Hz，而 Supplement S2 又称神经网络策略运行于 400 Hz；复现时需以代码或平台配置核对。
关键证据包括：控制参数量后，2.0 s 历史相较短历史更利于高台阶和持续横向外力；论文给定预算下，无特权 TCN-20 直接 TRPO 未学会，但这不能外推为所有纯本体直接 RL 都会失败；自适应课程优于全范围均匀采样。实机还展示了 10 kg 载荷、湿滑表面、泥雪植被、碎石和流水中的鲁棒性，但方法只有 trot，依赖经典状态估计。

en.title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
en.authors: Joonho Lee, Jemin Hwangbo, Lorenz Wellhausen, Vladlen Koltun, Marco Hutter
en.institutions: Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich; Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Lab, KAIST; Intelligent Systems Lab, Intel
en.takeaway: Distills privileged teacher actions and environment latents into a TCN over about two seconds of proprioception; the student modulates foot trajectories for IK / PD execution.
en.mainContent: The paper studies blind ANYmal locomotion over unknown challenging terrain using only proprioceptive history, without vision or explicit contact and slip detectors. A privileged teacher is first trained with TRPO on procedurally generated rigid terrain using ground-truth terrain, contact, friction, and external-force information; DAgger then trains a causal TCN student to imitate both the teacher's actions and latent environment representation, while a particle-filter curriculum maintains terrains of medium difficulty. At deployment, only the proprioceptive student, PMTG, horizontal foot frames, analytical IK, state estimator, and joint PD controller remain; the network predicts per-leg frequency offsets and foot-position residuals rather than torques or final joint targets. Multi-seed ablations and deployments with a 10 kg payload, slippery surfaces, natural terrain, and the DARPA Subterranean Challenge support robustness, but the method learns only a trot gait, cannot anticipate cliffs when operating blindly, and lacks systematic large-sample success statistics for natural-terrain generalization.
innovations: Core contribution: a long-horizon causal TCN processes proprioceptive history so that the policy can exploit temporal evidence of foot trapping, slippage, sustained forces, and terrain changes, reducing reliance on hand-engineered contact or slip detectors and reflex state machines.

Core contribution: a two-stage privileged-teacher/proprioceptive-student pipeline. The teacher directly observes simulated terrain, contact, friction, and force ground truth, while DAgger trains the student on its own state distribution to match both teacher actions and the teacher's environment latent, turning a difficult partially observable RL problem into imitation learning with representation supervision.

Core contribution: a particle-filter terrain curriculum targets a traversability band from 0.5 to 0.9, adapting the procedural-terrain parameter distribution toward regions that are currently traversable but still challenging instead of increasing difficulty on a fixed schedule.

Key system design: the policy uses a PMTG interface and predicts only per-leg frequency and 3D foot-target corrections. Gravity-aligned horizontal foot frames stabilize the action semantics, after which existing FTG, analytical IK, and PD components produce executable commands. PMTG, IK, PD, TRPO, TCN, and DAgger are not individually new; the contribution is their closed-loop organization around privileged training and proprioception-only deployment.
implementation: The task input consists of a planar travel direction, a discrete turning command, and proprioceptive robot state; the direction command specifies direction but not a target speed magnitude. Current observations include gravity direction, base linear/angular velocity, joint positions/velocities, leg phases and frequencies, and short actuator histories; on hardware, base state comes from an IMU- and leg-kinematics-based estimator.

The teacher receives deployable observations o_t plus privileged variables x_t, including local height samples and normals around each foot, foot/shank/thigh contacts, foot-ground friction, and base external force. Its privileged encoder produces an environment latent; the final layer in Table S5 implies a 64-dimensional latent, although the main text does not separately state the dimension.

The teacher is trained in RaiSim with TRPO using a batch size of 80,000 for 10,000 iterations, an average-KL limit of 0.01, 50 conjugate-gradient iterations, and damping 0.1. Rewards cover commanded-direction velocity, turning, body stability, swing-foot clearance, non-foot body collisions, foot-target smoothness, and joint torque.

Curriculum labels are generated automatically from rollouts: a transition is labeled 1 if the next state's velocity projection along the commanded direction exceeds 0.2 m/s, and 0 if progress is slower or the episode terminates. Traversability is the expectation or fraction of these transition labels, not strictly a binary full-episode arrival success rate and not exact tracking of a prescribed speed; the velocity reward saturates at 0.6 m/s, which serves a different purpose from the curriculum threshold.

Each terrain family—hills, slippery hills, steps, or stairs—maintains 10 parameter particles, with six trajectories per particle. Every 10 policy iterations, the curriculum reweights and resamples particles, moves them to neighboring grid cells with probability 0.8, and replays old terrains with probability 0.05. Particles represent terrain-generation parameters rather than robot states, and this filter samples future training terrains rather than estimating terrain online on the robot.

The student uses a causal TCN over proprioceptive history. The default TCN-100 stores one frame every 0.02 s for an approximately 2.0 s receptive field, uses kernel size 5 with dilations 1/2/4 interleaved with stride-2 convolutions, and outputs a 64-dimensional latent; the action MLP is 256-128-64-16. Its objective is the sum of action MSE and latent MSE.

During student training, the frozen teacher labels states actually visited by student rollouts on curriculum terrains. Adam runs for 4,000 iterations with batch size 20,000, four epochs and five minibatches per iteration, starting at 5e-4 with exponential decay.

The policy action is 16-dimensional: four per-leg frequency offsets and four 3D foot-position residuals. The online chain is 'TCN/MLP action → residual added to the FTG periodic foot template → horizontal-foot-frame conversion → analytical IK producing 12 joint-position targets → high-rate joint PD producing torque'; therefore, the neural action itself is not the PD target.

Simulation uses a platform-specific learned actuator model to approximate the series-elastic actuator and PD dynamics, together with randomization of terrain friction, external forces, and observation noise. Deployment removes the teacher, privileged variables, terrain curriculum, diagnostic decoder, and simulated actuator network, retaining only student inference, state estimation, phase or foot trajectory generation, IK, and physical joint PD.

Teacher and student training take approximately 12 and 4 hours, respectively, on an Intel i7-8700K and GeForce RTX 2080. The paper is internally inconsistent about control rate: Figure 4C labels network or trajectory generation at 50 Hz and joint PD at 400 Hz, whereas Supplement S2 states that the neural policy runs at 400 Hz; reproduction requires checking code or platform configuration.

Key evidence shows that, at roughly matched capacity, 2.0 s of history improves tall-step traversal and rejection of sustained lateral forces; the non-privileged TCN-20 direct-TRPO baseline fails under the reported budget. Hardware tests include a 10 kg payload, slippery surfaces, mud, snow, vegetation, rubble, and water, but the controller supports only trot, depends on classical state estimation.

papers.venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

zh.title: DreamWaQ: Learning Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion With Implicit Terrain Imagination via Deep Reinforcement Learning
zh.authors: I Made Aswin Nahrendra, Byeongho Yu, Hyun Myung
zh.institutions: 韩国科学技术院（KAIST）电气工程学院，韩国大田
zh.takeaway: 用本体历史同时估计速度和隐式动力学上下文，让 actor 在接触反馈中适应未知地形。
zh.mainContent: DreamWaQ 的 CENet 从短时本体历史同时估计机身速度，并通过 β-VAE 下一观测预测学习隐式动力学上下文。actor 根据这些表征输出运动控制动作，在接触反馈中适应未知地形。训练将速度监督、观测重建、KL 正则与 PPO 控制结合，部署保留历史估计器和 actor。
innovations: 提出 Context-Aided Estimator Network（CENet），用同一个共享编码器联合学习可解释的三维机身速度和无显式标签的 16 维环境上下文，使状态估计与隐式动力学表征相互辅助。
把 CENet、Actor 和特权 Critic 放在同一批在线 rollout 中并发训练，避免先训练特权 Teacher、再用行为克隆训练 Student 的两阶段流程。非对称 Actor–Critic、PPO 和 β-VAE 本身均为已有组件，创新主要来自它们在本体感知 locomotion 中的系统组合。
在 CENet 内使用 β-VAE 辅助任务：潜变量用于预测下一时刻本体观测，重建损失要求其保留影响状态转移的信息，KL 正则则约束后验分布接近标准正态并限制潜变量随意记忆。VAE 并没有另一套独立编码器，承担 VAE encoder 角色的就是部署时保留的同一个 CENet 编码器。
提出 Adaptive Bootstrapping（AdaBoot），根据并行环境 episodic return 的变异系数自适应调节策略暴露于估计速度误差的程度，缓解训练早期估计器不准与部署时必须依赖估计器之间的矛盾。
提供两条长距离户外真机路线作为工程验证，这是较强的持续部署证据；但它属于实证贡献，不是新的学习算法。
implementation: 当前本体观测包含机身角速度、机身坐标系重力方向、速度命令、12 个关节的位置与速度以及上一时刻动作。CENet 使用历史长度 H=5；按论文符号可能表示当前帧加过去 5 帧，但具体堆叠 5 帧还是 6 帧存在歧义。
CENet 只有一个共享编码器。论文图示编码器为 128→64→19，19 维输出拆为三维估计机身线速度和 16 维潜变量；VAE 解码器为 64→128→48，用潜变量重建下一时刻观测。CENet 损失由速度估计 MSE、下一观测重建 MSE 和 β 加权 KL divergence 组成。
KL 正则约束的是编码器产生的潜变量后验分布，而不是动作、真实速度或某个地形类别。重建项迫使潜变量保存预测下一观测所需的信息，KL 项则把后验限制在标准正态先验附近。
Actor 为 512→256→128→12 的 ELU MLP，输入当前本体观测、CENet 估计速度和潜变量，输出 12 个相对站立姿态的目标关节角偏置。Critic 为 512→256→128→1 的 ELU MLP，训练时额外读取仿真真实机身速度、外部扰动和局部高度扫描。
训练时先由 CENet 编码历史，Actor 输出动作，PD 与仿真器推进到下一状态；新产生的真实速度和下一观测分别作为 CENet 的监督标签与自监督重建目标。Actor、Critic 和 CENet 使用同一批 rollout 同步更新。
AdaBoot 使用 episodic return 的 coefficient of variation 判断训练稳定性：回报差异较大时减少 bootstrapping，回报趋于一致时提高 bootstrapping 概率，让 actor 更多使用估计速度。
训练在 Isaac Gym 中并行运行 4,096 个 Unitree A1 环境，共 1,000 iterations。地形包括 smooth、rough、discretized 和 stairs 四类，并设置 0°–22° 的十级课程；域随机化覆盖负载、PD 增益、电机强度、质心偏移、摩擦系数和 0–15 ms 系统延迟。
PPO 超参数包括 clip ratio 0.2、折扣因子 0.99、GAE 系数 0.95；各网络使用 Adam，学习率为 0.001。作者报告在 RTX 3060 Ti 上训练约 1 小时。
奖励覆盖线速度和偏航率跟踪、机身高度与姿态稳定、关节加速度、动作一阶与二阶差分、足端间隙及功率正则。作者额外引入 power distribution reward，惩罚各电机功率分布的高方差，以降低单个电机过热风险，但真机山路实验中仍因前腿电机升温而降低了命令速度。
真机部署在 Unitree A1 的 Intel NUC 上，CENet 与 Actor 以 50 Hz 同步推理，低层 PD 以 200 Hz 执行，增益为 Kp=28、Kd=0.7。部署保留历史缓存、训练得到的同一个 CENet 编码器、速度头、潜变量分支、Actor 和 PD；Critic、VAE 解码器、重建与 KL 损失、AdaBoot、仿真真速度和高度扫描均不参与部署。
完整 DreamWaQ 在仿真速度扰动测试中达到 1.121±0.164 m/s 的最大速度 kick，并在 30 分钟随机行走测试中达到 95.23±1.61% 生存率；去掉 AdaBoot 后分别为 1.015±0.121 m/s 和 90.71±1.25%，这是论文中隔离最清楚的消融。
所谓 implicit terrain imagination 只是对控制有用的隐式 belief，并非显式高度图或可供 MPC 查询的世界模型。CENet 只能在地形已经通过碰撞、滑动或负载变化影响本体响应后进行适应，无法提前感知尚未接触的台阶或障碍。

en.title: DreamWaQ: Learning Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion With Implicit Terrain Imagination via Deep Reinforcement Learning
en.authors: I Made Aswin Nahrendra, Byeongho Yu, Hyun Myung
en.institutions: School of Electrical Engineering, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Daejeon, Republic of Korea
en.takeaway: Estimates velocity and implicit dynamics context from proprioceptive history so the actor adapts to unknown terrain through contact feedback.
en.mainContent: DreamWaQ’s CENet estimates body velocity and learns implicit dynamics context through β-VAE next-observation prediction from short proprioceptive history. The actor uses these features to adapt to unknown terrain through contact feedback. Velocity supervision, reconstruction, KL regularization, and PPO train the estimator and controller; deployment retains the history estimator and actor.
innovations: The Context-Aided Estimator Network jointly learns interpretable three-dimensional body velocity and an unlabeled 16-dimensional environmental context through one shared encoder, allowing explicit state estimation and implicit dynamics representation to support each other.

CENet, the actor, and the privileged critic are trained concurrently from the same online rollouts, avoiding a separate privileged-teacher and behavior-cloning stage. Asymmetric actor–critic learning, PPO, and β-VAE are established components; the main novelty lies in their integration for proprioceptive locomotion.

A β-VAE auxiliary objective predicts the next proprioceptive observation from the latent context. Reconstruction requires the latent to retain transition-relevant information, while KL regularization constrains its posterior toward a standard-normal prior and limits arbitrary memorization. The VAE does not use a separate encoder: its encoder is the same CENet encoder retained at deployment.

Adaptive Bootstrapping adjusts how strongly the policy is exposed to estimated-velocity errors according to the coefficient of variation of episodic returns across randomized environments, addressing the conflict between inaccurate early estimates and deployment-time dependence on the estimator.
The two long-distance outdoor robot courses provide a valuable empirical deployment contribution, although this is evidence rather than a new learning algorithm.
implementation: The current proprioceptive observation contains body angular velocity, projected gravity, velocity commands, positions and velocities of 12 joints, and the previous action. CENet uses a history length of H=5; the notation may mean the current frame plus five past frames, but the paper does not resolve whether five or six samples are stacked.

CENet has only one shared encoder. The figure specifies an encoder of 128→64→19, with its 19-dimensional output divided into three estimated body-velocity dimensions and a 16-dimensional latent context. A 64→128→48 VAE decoder reconstructs the next observation. The CENet objective combines velocity-estimation MSE, next-observation reconstruction MSE, and a β-weighted KL-divergence term.

KL regularization constrains the posterior distribution produced by the encoder rather than the action, ground-truth velocity, or a terrain class. Reconstruction forces the latent to retain information needed for next-observation prediction, while KL keeps the posterior near a standard-normal prior.

The actor is a 512→256→128→12 ELU MLP that takes the current observation, CENet velocity estimate, and latent context and outputs 12 desired joint-angle offsets from a standing pose. The critic is a 512→256→128→1 ELU MLP with additional access to ground-truth body velocity, external disturbances, and local terrain-height scans during training.

During training, CENet first encodes the observation history, the actor outputs an action, and the PD controller and simulator advance the environment. The resulting ground-truth velocity and next observation serve as supervised and self-supervised CENet targets. The actor, critic, and CENet are updated synchronously from the same rollouts, but the paper does not state whether PPO gradients propagate through the actor inputs into CENet.

AdaBoot uses the coefficient of variation of episodic returns as a learning-stability signal: bootstrapping is reduced when return variation is high and increased once returns become more consistent, exposing the actor to estimated-velocity errors.

Training uses 4,096 parallel Unitree A1 environments in Isaac Gym for 1,000 iterations. Terrain classes include smooth, rough, discretized, and stairs, with ten curriculum levels spanning 0°–22°. Domain randomization covers payload, PD gains, motor strength, center-of-mass displacement, friction, and 0–15 ms system delay.

Reported PPO settings include a clip ratio of 0.2, discount factor of 0.99, and GAE coefficient of 0.95. All networks use Adam with a learning rate of 0.001. Training takes approximately one hour on an RTX 3060 Ti, but episode length, command-sampling ranges, action distribution, mini-batch configuration, and relative loss-update schedules are not fully specified.

The reward includes linear-velocity and yaw-rate tracking, body-height and orientation stability, joint acceleration, first- and second-order action differences, foot clearance, and power regularization. A power-distribution reward penalizes high variance in motor power to reduce individual motor overheating, although the real mountain-course experiment still required lowering the command speed because the front-leg motors heated rapidly.

On the Unitree A1, CENet and the actor run synchronously at 50 Hz on an Intel NUC, while a 200 Hz PD loop uses Kp=28 and Kd=0.7. Deployment retains the history buffer, the exact trained CENet encoder, velocity head, latent branch, actor, and PD controller. The critic, VAE decoder, reconstruction and KL losses, AdaBoot, simulator ground-truth velocity, and height scans do not participate in deployment.

Full DreamWaQ withstands a maximum simulated velocity kick of 1.121±0.164 m/s and achieves a 95.23±1.61% survival rate in a 30-minute random-walking test. Without AdaBoot, these values fall to 1.015±0.121 m/s and 90.71±1.25%, making the AdaBoot comparison the cleanest ablation in the paper.

Implicit terrain imagination should be understood as a task-relevant latent belief rather than an explicit height map or a world model that can be queried by MPC. CENet can adapt only after terrain, slipping, collision, or payload changes affect proprioceptive responses; it cannot anticipate an unseen step before contact. The paper also provides no latent probing to verify separate representations of height, friction, or restitution.

zh.title: Hybrid Internal Model: Learning Agile Legged Locomotion with Simulated Robot Response
zh.authors: Junfeng Long, Zirui Wang, Quanyi Li, Jiawei Gao, Liu Cao, Jiangmiao Pang
zh.institutions: OpenRobotLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory; Zhejiang University; Tsinghua University
zh.takeaway: 用下一状态自监督对齐历史表征，联合学习显式速度与隐式机器人响应，再交给 PPO actor 控制。
zh.mainContent: HIMLoco 用真实下一状态作为自监督视图，使历史编码器学习显式速度和隐式机器人响应。HIM 表征目标与 actor 的 PPO 更新交替进行，将短时本体历史转化为控制上下文。部署保留历史编码器、actor 和 PD 控制，训练用的 target encoder 与 prototype 留在训练阶段。
innovations: 核心创新是 HIO：不让部署 Actor 模仿读取特权环境参数的 teacher，也不回归 privileged extrinsics latent，而是把历史观测与其真实 successor state 视为同一 transition 的两个视角，用 prototype-based swapped assignment 学习可部署的响应表征。
提出 hybrid internal embedding，将具有明确物理意义的三维机体速度估计与 16 维无人工标签的隐式响应 latent 组合；前者服务速度跟踪，后者为 Actor 提供接触、负载、扰动和稳定恢复相关的上下文。
Actor 在整个训练期间只使用可部署本体信息及 HIM 输出，避免先训练 privileged policy、再蒸馏 student 的独立两阶段流程；高度图和外力仍可供训练期 Critic 使用，因此这是 asymmetric actor-critic 设计，而不是完全不使用特权训练信息。
PPO、GAE、SwAV 式交换分配、Sinkhorn-Knopp、asymmetric critic、domain randomization、terrain curriculum 和 PD 位置控制均为已有组件；论文的新意主要在于把 successor-response 表征学习嵌入四足 on-policy 控制闭环，而不是提出新的 RL 优化器或经典世界模型。
implementation: 部署观测包含速度命令、关节角、关节速度、机体角速度、机体系重力方向和上一动作；Actor 不直接读取机体线速度、地形高度、摩擦或外力。对 12-DoF 四足，按论文各项计数，单帧 Actor 观测为 45 维，动作是 12 维关节位置偏置。
HIM source/history encoder 接收短时观测历史，输出三维速度估计与 16 维 source latent；target encoder 接收同一 transition 的真实下一状态并输出 16 维 target latent。论文设置历史参数 \(H=5\)，但记号 \(\mathbf{o}_{t-H:t}\) 与文字存在五帧或六帧的 off-by-one 歧义。
两个 latent 与同一组 16 个可学习 prototype 计算相似度。latent 和 prototype 先做 L2 归一化，因此点积表示余弦相似度；这只去除向量尺度而不降维。Softmax temperature 调整分配的尖锐程度，不能从分子分母中约掉。
Sinkhorn-Knopp 在整个 mini-batch 上把样本到 prototype 的相似度变成近似均衡的软伪标签，使每条样本的分配权重和固定、各 prototype 接收的总权重近似相等，从而降低所有样本坍缩到同一 prototype 的风险；它不是人工地形标签，也不是随机平均分组。

HIO 使用交换交叉熵 \(\operatorname{CE}(q^{t},p^{s})+\operatorname{CE}(q^{s},p^{t})\)：用 successor 分支的平衡分配监督 history 分支，并反向训练 target 分支。对齐的是两端的 prototype assignment，而不是强制两个 latent 数值相等；prototype 只是训练期可学习聚类锚点，不是可执行运动 primitive。

同一 on-policy 训练循环中，当前 HIM 与 Actor 先在 Isaac Gym 收集 transition；HIO 用速度真值和 history-successor 配对更新 source encoder、target encoder 与 prototype；随后冻结或 detach HIM 输出，以 PPO 更新 Actor 和 Critic。它不是先完整预训练 HIM、再从头训练 Actor 的串行两阶段方法。
Critic 在训练时额外读取外力和周围地形高度，以改善 value estimation；这些特权量不进入 Actor。训练使用 4096 个并行环境，并结合地形/命令课程及质量、摩擦、恢复系数、电机强度、PD 增益、延迟和外力等 domain randomization。
Actor 输出动作后生成目标关节角 \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^{\mathrm{target}}_t=\boldsymbol{\theta}_0+k\mathbf{a}_t\)，再由 PD 跟踪。真机策略频率为 50 Hz，PD 频率为 500 Hz。

部署只保留 history/source encoder、Actor 与低层 PD：历史本体观测经 HIM 得到速度估计和响应 latent，Actor 再输出关节目标。target encoder、prototype、Sinkhorn、交叉监督损失、successor state、Critic 和所有训练期特权输入均删除；Actor 功能上可从 latent 生成动作，但它是 RL policy，不是自编码器 decoder。
真机每项基准进行 20 次试验；代表性结果包括 A1 短楼梯成功率 100%（RMA 60%）、Aliengo 长楼梯连续 176.5±7.81 级（RMA 75.35±19.98）、变形坡成功率 55%（RMA 10%）和 42 cm 缺台阶后保持平衡 100%（RMA 0%）。拖拽物最大重量与 RMA 同为 10 kg，因此不能概括为所有指标都严格优于 RMA。

复现需注意论文与公开代码默认值存在差异：论文写 HIM MLP 隐藏层 512/256/128、prototype 数量 16；公开代码默认 estimator 隐藏层 128/64、prototype 数量 32、temperature 3、Sinkhorn 3 次。论文还存在 200M frames 与 rollout 配置算术不一致、\(H=5\) 帧数歧义，以及 target 更新、temperature 和 Sinkhorn 细节未完整说明等问题。

en.title: Hybrid Internal Model: Learning Agile Legged Locomotion with Simulated Robot Response
en.authors: Junfeng Long, Zirui Wang, Quanyi Li, Jiawei Gao, Liu Cao, Jiangmiao Pang
en.institutions: OpenRobotLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory; Zhejiang University; Tsinghua University
en.takeaway: Uses next-state self-supervision to align history representations that encode velocity and implicit robot responses for a PPO actor.
en.mainContent: HIMLoco uses the observed next state as a self-supervised view for history representations of velocity and implicit robot response. Representation learning alternates with PPO actor updates, turning short proprioceptive history into control context. Deployment keeps the history encoder, actor, and PD control; target encoders and prototypes serve training.
innovations: The central contribution is HIO: instead of distilling actions from a privileged teacher or regressing a privileged extrinsics latent, it treats historical observations and the real successor state of the same transition as two views and learns a deployable response representation through prototype-based swapped assignments.

The hybrid internal embedding combines an explicitly supervised three-dimensional base-velocity estimate with a 16-dimensional implicit response latent. The former supports velocity tracking and the latter provides contact-, load-, disturbance-, and recovery-related context, although the paper does not show that individual latent dimensions correspond to identifiable physical parameters.

The Actor uses only deployable proprioceptive information and HIM outputs throughout training, avoiding a separate privileged-policy-to-student distillation pipeline. Terrain height and external force remain available to the training-only Critic, so this is an asymmetric actor-critic design rather than training with no privileged information at all.

PPO, GAE, SwAV-style swapped assignments, Sinkhorn-Knopp, the asymmetric Critic, domain randomization, terrain curriculum, and PD position control are established components. The novelty lies mainly in integrating successor-response representation learning into an on-policy quadruped-control loop, not in a new RL optimizer or a classical rollout world model.
implementation: The deployable observation contains a velocity command, joint positions, joint velocities, body angular velocity, gravity direction in the body frame, and the previous action; the Actor does not directly observe base linear velocity, terrain height, friction, or external force. For a 12-DoF quadruped, counting the listed terms gives a 45-dimensional per-frame Actor observation and a 12-dimensional joint-position-offset action.

The HIM source/history encoder consumes a short observation history and outputs a three-dimensional velocity estimate plus a 16-dimensional source latent. The target encoder consumes the real successor state from the same transition and outputs a 16-dimensional target latent. The paper sets \(H=5\), but its notation \(\mathbf{o}_{t-H:t}\) and prose leave an off-by-one ambiguity between five and six frames.

Both latents are compared with the same set of 16 learnable prototypes. Latents and prototypes are L2-normalized, so their dot product is cosine similarity; normalization removes vector scale but does not reduce dimensionality. A softmax temperature controls assignment sharpness and cannot be cancelled between the numerator and denominator.

Sinkhorn-Knopp transforms sample-to-prototype similarities over the full mini-batch into approximately balanced soft pseudo-labels: each sample has a fixed total assignment and every prototype receives approximately equal total mass. This discourages collapse to a single prototype; it is neither a hand-labeled terrain classifier nor random equal grouping.

HIO uses the swapped cross-entropy \(\operatorname{CE}(q^{t},p^{s})+\operatorname{CE}(q^{s},p^{t})\): the balanced successor assignment supervises the history branch, and the reverse term trains the target branch. It aligns prototype-assignment distributions rather than forcing the two latent vectors to be numerically equal; prototypes are training-time clustering anchors, not executable motion primitives.

Within the same on-policy loop, the current HIM and Actor first collect transitions in Isaac Gym; HIO updates the source encoder, target encoder, and prototypes using velocity ground truth and history-successor pairs; HIM outputs are then frozen or detached while PPO updates the Actor and Critic. This is not a serial pipeline that fully pretrains HIM and then trains a new Actor from scratch.

During training, the Critic additionally observes external force and surrounding terrain height for value estimation, while the Actor does not. Training uses 4,096 parallel environments together with terrain/command curricula and domain randomization over mass, friction, restitution, motor strength, PD gains, latency, and external force.

The Actor defines the joint target \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^{\mathrm{target}}_t=\boldsymbol{\theta}_0+k\mathbf{a}_t\), which is tracked by a PD controller. The real-robot policy runs at 50 Hz and the PD loop at 500 Hz.

Deployment retains only the history/source encoder, Actor, and low-level PD loop: proprioceptive history produces velocity and response latents, after which the Actor outputs joint targets. The target encoder, prototypes, Sinkhorn, swapped loss, successor state, Critic, and all privileged training observations are removed. Although the Actor maps a latent to an action, it is an RL policy rather than an autoencoder decoder.

Each real-world benchmark uses 20 trials. Representative results include 100% success on A1 short stairs versus 60% for RMA, 176.5±7.81 consecutive Aliengo stair steps versus 75.35±19.98, 55% success on a deformable slope versus 10%, and 100% balance recovery after a 42 cm missing step versus 0%. Both HIM and RMA tow at most 10 kg, so HIM is not strictly better on every metric.

Reproduction requires care because the paper and public-code defaults differ: the paper reports 512/256/128 HIM hidden layers and 16 prototypes, whereas the public code defaults to 128/64 estimator layers, 32 prototypes, temperature 3, and three Sinkhorn iterations. The paper also has an arithmetic mismatch around 200M frames, an \(H=5\) history-length ambiguity, and incomplete details on target updates, temperature, and Sinkhorn.

zh.title: CTS: Concurrent Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning for Legged Locomotion
zh.authors: Hongxi Wang, Haoxiang Luo, Wei Zhang, Hua Chen
zh.institutions: School of System Design and Intelligent Manufacturing (SDIM), Southern University of Science and Technology; Zhejiang University-University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Institute (ZJUI); LimX Dynamics
zh.takeaway: 让学生历史编码器闭环采样，用这些 rollout 的 PPO 信号更新共享 actor，在训练中适应部署分布。
zh.mainContent: CTS 让 teacher 特权编码器和 student 历史编码器使用共享 actor。学生闭环采集的 rollout 参与 GAE / PPO 更新，使 actor 在训练时接触部署观测分布；学生编码器通过 latent 重建学习教师上下文。教师、学生与控制更新处于同一训练循环。
innovations: 核心创新：将 8192 个并行环境分成 teacher 与 student 两组，让两条路径同时闭环 rollout，并把两组优势共同用于更新共享 actor；student 的失败状态和恢复需求因此会直接进入策略优化，而不再只通过监督模仿间接体现。

相对 sequential distillation 的关键改动：传统方法先在 \(d_{\pi_T}\) 上训练 teacher，再让 student 模仿；CTS 直接在当前 student 诱导的 \(d_{\pi_S}\) 上采样并优化任务回报，使共享 actor 在训练期就接触不完美 student latent 及其造成的状态偏移，从而缓解 covariate shift 和误差累积。
表示学习设计：privileged encoder 的 latent 由 teacher 路径的 PPO 回报塑形，不要求人工指定应估计的物理量；proprioceptive encoder 再从短历史在线追踪这一任务相关表示。两者共同演化。
关键边界：student rollout 的 PPO 梯度只更新共享 actor 和 critic，不更新 proprioceptive encoder；student encoder 仍由 latent reconstruction loss 单独训练。因此 CTS 比纯蒸馏更强，但并不是 student 全网络端到端 RL。
工程组合而非独立算法创新：PPO、GAE、非对称 actor-critic、teacher-student latent 回归、地形课程、域随机化和低层 PD 都是继承组件；论文的新增价值主要在训练数据流和梯度路径的重组，以及在四足和点足双足上的系统验证。
implementation: 部署 observation 为基座角速度、基座坐标系重力方向、关节位置与速度、平面线速度/偏航角速度指令以及上一动作；teacher 的完整 state 还包含基座线速度、地形高度采样、足端接触力、关节力矩和关节加速度等训练期特权信息。

Privileged encoder 输入完整 state，proprioceptive encoder 输入五帧本体 observation 历史；两个 encoder 的隐藏层均为 [512, 256]，输出 32 维并进行 \(L_2\) 归一化。共享 actor 输入当前 observation 与二选一的 latent，critic 输入完整 state 与当前 latent；actor 和 critic 的隐藏层均为 [512, 256, 128]，全部使用 ELU。
训练使用 Isaac Gym 中 8192 个并行环境，teacher 组 6144 个、student 组 2048 个。每轮两组分别执行 24 个控制步：teacher 使用 privileged latent，student 使用 history latent；仿真器产生各自下一状态、奖励和终止信号，因此 student 数据来自其自身误差造成的真实闭环分布。

两组 rollout 分别通过 GAE 计算 advantage 和 return，再求和形成 teacher PPO 与 student PPO 目标。Teacher 轨迹更新 privileged encoder 与共享 actor，student 轨迹更新共享 actor；两组 return 共同训练同一个 critic。GAE 中 rollout 时保存的 old value、advantage 和 return target 是固定数据，所谓 new critic 是同一 critic 经 value-loss 梯度更新后的参数版本，并非额外生成的网络。

PPO 更新后固定 teacher encoder 与 actor，用 MSE 让 proprioceptive encoder 输出逼近 stop-gradient teacher latent；student encoder 每轮训练 5 个 epoch，学习率为 \(10^{-3}\)。论文式 (8) 把 student 历史写成与独立 teacher 组 state 配对，按字面无法实现；合理实现应使用同一 student 环境的特权 state 生成监督 target，但论文和公开代码均未澄清。

PPO 配置为每轮 24 步、5 个 epoch、clip 0.2、折扣 \(\gamma=0.99\)、GAE \(\lambda=0.95\)、entropy coefficient 0.01、desired KL 0.01 和自适应学习率。训练采用 3:1 teacher/student 环境数，但两个组内平均后的 PPO 目标按公式直接相加，因此该比例不必然等价于 teacher 梯度权重为 student 的三倍。

Policy 在 50 Hz 输出驱动关节相对名义姿态的偏移，位置目标为 \(\mathbf{q}^{\mathrm{ref}}_t=\mathbf{q}^{\mathrm{nominal}}+K\mathbf{a}_t\)，再由低层 PD 执行；它不是直接力矩策略。部署仅保留五帧历史缓存、proprioceptive encoder、共享 actor 与低层控制器，不需要 teacher encoder、critic、地形高度、奖励、GAE 或 PPO。
训练地形包括斜坡、粗糙斜坡、楼梯和离散障碍，并使用地形难度/速度指令课程。域随机化覆盖质量、payload、基座质心、摩擦、恢复系数、PD 增益、电机强度和 0–20 ms 动作延迟；奖励包括速度跟踪、姿态安全、能耗平滑、关节限制及足端调节，点足双足另加姿态、双脚距离和相位接触项。
定量仿真只在 Unitree A1 上进行，使用五个随机种子并在 5000 次迭代处评估。相对两阶段 T-S，CTS 在斜坡、粗糙斜坡、楼梯和离散障碍上的速度跟踪指标分别改善 17.85%、19.12%、7.9% 和 21.85%；抗推存活率分别提高 5.04%、6.47%、4.76% 和 4.57%，但 EstimatorNet 在多类地形上的抗推表现高于 CTS。
论文展示了 A1、Aliengo 和 P1 的零样本 Sim-to-Real 行为。由于没有外感知，策略只能在足端与障碍发生接触后根据本体反馈适应，无法在首次接触前预见台阶或洞；同一框架可适配不同平台不等于一个策略参数集合能跨形态通用。

en.title: CTS: Concurrent Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning for Legged Locomotion
en.authors: Hongxi Wang, Haoxiang Luo, Wei Zhang, Hua Chen
en.institutions: School of System Design and Intelligent Manufacturing (SDIM), Southern University of Science and Technology; Zhejiang University-University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Institute (ZJUI); LimX Dynamics
en.takeaway: Collects closed-loop rollouts through the student history encoder and uses their PPO signal to adapt a shared actor to deployment observations.
en.mainContent: CTS shares an actor between a privileged teacher encoder and a history-based student encoder. Student-controlled rollouts contribute GAE / PPO updates so the actor trains on deployment observations, while latent reconstruction teaches the student context. Teacher, student, and control updates run in one training loop.
innovations: Core innovation: 8192 parallel environments are split into teacher and student groups that perform closed-loop rollouts concurrently, and the advantages from both paths update a shared actor; student failures and recovery requirements therefore enter policy optimization directly instead of appearing only through supervised imitation.

Key change relative to sequential distillation: conventional methods train a teacher on \(d_{\pi_T}\) and then ask the student to imitate it, whereas CTS samples from the current student-induced \(d_{\pi_S}\) and optimizes task return there. The shared actor is consequently exposed during training to imperfect student latents and the state deviations they cause, mitigating covariate shift and compounding error.

Representation-learning design: the privileged encoder latent is shaped by PPO return on the teacher path rather than by manually specified physical estimation targets, and the proprioceptive encoder tracks this task-relevant representation online from a short history. The two representations co-evolve.

Important boundary: PPO gradients from student rollouts update the shared actor and critic but not the proprioceptive encoder; the student encoder is updated separately through latent reconstruction. CTS is therefore stronger than pure distillation but is not end-to-end RL over the entire student network.

Engineering integration rather than separate algorithmic novelty: PPO, GAE, asymmetric actor-critic, teacher-student latent regression, terrain curriculum, domain randomization, and low-level PD control are inherited components. The new contribution is mainly the reorganization of training data flow and gradient paths, plus system validation on quadrupedal and point-foot bipedal robots.
implementation: The deployable observation contains base angular velocity, gravity projected into the base frame, joint positions and velocities, planar/yaw velocity commands, and the previous action. The teacher's full state additionally includes training-only privileged information such as base linear velocity, terrain-height samples, foot contact forces, joint torques, and joint accelerations.

The privileged encoder consumes the full state and the proprioceptive encoder consumes a five-frame observation history; both use [512, 256] hidden layers and produce an \(L_2\)-normalized 32-dimensional latent. The shared actor takes the current observation plus one of the two latents, while the critic takes the full state and current latent; actor and critic both use [512, 256, 128] hidden layers, and all networks use ELU activations.

Training uses 8192 Isaac Gym environments, with 6144 assigned to the teacher group and 2048 to the student group. In every iteration, each group runs 24 control steps: the teacher uses the privileged latent and the student uses the history latent. The simulator generates each group's next states, rewards, and terminations, so student data come from the closed-loop distribution induced by the student's own estimation and action errors.

GAE is applied separately to both rollout sets to compute advantages and returns, and the teacher and student PPO objectives are summed. Teacher trajectories update the privileged encoder and shared actor, student trajectories update the shared actor, and returns from both groups train the same critic. The rollout-time old values, advantages, and return targets are fixed data during optimization; the 'new critic' is simply the same critic after value-loss gradient updates, not a separately created network.

After PPO optimization, the teacher encoder and actor are held fixed while MSE trains the proprioceptive encoder toward a stop-gradient teacher latent; the student encoder is trained for five epochs per iteration with a learning rate of \(10^{-3}\). Equation (8) appears to pair a student history with a state from an independent teacher group, which is not directly implementable; a plausible implementation would generate the teacher target from the privileged state of the same student environment, but neither the paper nor public code resolves this ambiguity.

PPO uses 24 rollout steps per iteration, five epochs, clip 0.2, discount \(\gamma=0.99\), GAE \(\lambda=0.95\), entropy coefficient 0.01, desired KL 0.01, and an adaptive learning rate. Although the environment-count ratio is 3:1, the paper's equations average within each group and then add the two PPO objectives, so this ratio does not necessarily make the teacher gradient three times larger than the student gradient.

At 50 Hz, the policy outputs offsets from nominal joint poses, producing \(\mathbf{q}^{\mathrm{ref}}_t=\mathbf{q}^{\mathrm{nominal}}+K\mathbf{a}_t\), which are executed by a low-level PD controller; the policy does not output joint torques directly. Deployment retains only the five-frame history buffer, proprioceptive encoder, shared actor, and low-level controller, with no teacher encoder, critic, terrain heights, rewards, GAE, or PPO.

Training covers slopes, rough slopes, stairs, and discrete obstacles with terrain-difficulty and velocity-command curricula. Domain randomization includes masses, payload, base center of mass, friction, restitution, PD gains, motor strength, and 0–20 ms action delay. Rewards cover velocity tracking, posture and safety, energy and smoothness, joint limits, and foot regulation, with additional posture, foot-distance, and phase-contact terms for the point-foot biped.

Quantitative simulation evaluation is performed only on Unitree A1 with five random seeds at iteration 5000. Relative to two-stage teacher-student training, CTS improves the velocity-tracking metric by 17.85%, 19.12%, 7.9%, and 21.85% on slopes, rough slopes, stairs, and discrete obstacles, respectively, and improves push-survival rate by 5.04%, 6.47%, 4.76%, and 4.57%; however, EstimatorNet is more push-robust than CTS on several terrains.

The paper demonstrates zero-shot Sim-to-Real behavior on A1, Aliengo, and P1. Without exteroception, the policy can adapt only after physical contact exposes an obstacle through proprioceptive feedback and cannot anticipate a step or hole before first contact; applying the framework separately to several platforms is not evidence that one parameter set generalizes across morphologies.

zh.title: CMoE: Contrastive Mixture of Experts for Motion Control and Terrain Adaptation of Humanoid Robots
zh.authors: Shihao Ma, Hongjin Chen, Zijun Xu, Yi Zhao, Ke Wu, Ruichen Yang, Leyao Zou, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding
zh.institutions: 复旦大学智能机器人与先进制造学院（College of Intelligent Robotics and Advanced Manufacturing, Fudan University）
zh.status: 全文已精读（含官方代码核查）
zh.takeaway: 把地形表征与 gate 激活对齐，让五个软混合专家在同一 PPO 控制器中学出地形相关专化。
zh.mainContent: CMoE 用历史状态估计器和地形编码器形成控制输入，再由 gate 混合五个 actor expert 的动作。训练通过 SwAV 式 swapped assignment 把地形表征和 gate 激活对齐，Sinkhorn–Knopp 在 batch 中平衡 prototype 伪分配。混合地形、gate 聚类和专家移除实验展示地形相关路由，模型在真机人形上完成多地形控制。
innovations: 将地形条件的表征对齐引入人形 MoE 路由。
联合 PPO 与双向 swapped-assignment 监督学习 gate 和专家。
通过混合地形与专家移除实验分析控制专化。
implementation: 10 帧本体历史进入 β-VAE，输出 3 维速度估计和 16 维历史 latent；下一观测重建与速度监督训练估计器。
gate 输出 softmax 权重，动作均值为 \(\mu=\sum_{i=1}^{5}w_i\mu_i\)；每个样本同时经过五个专家。
gate 与地形分支各投影到 16 维，使用 32 个可学习 prototype；预测 softmax 温度为 0.2。
Sinkhorn–Knopp 以 ε=0.05 做三轮行列缩放，产生停止梯度的平衡 prototype assignment；两分支交叉监督对方的预测。
估计器先按自身目标更新，PPO 和对比损失随后更新 actor、gate、projector 与 prototype。域随机化覆盖动力学、推扰和地形观测误差。

en.title: CMoE: Contrastive Mixture of Experts for Motion Control and Terrain Adaptation of Humanoid Robots
en.authors: Shihao Ma, Hongjin Chen, Zijun Xu, Yi Zhao, Ke Wu, Ruichen Yang, Leyao Zou, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding
en.institutions: College of Intelligent Robotics and Advanced Manufacturing, Fudan University, Shanghai, China
en.takeaway: Aligns terrain features with gate activations so five softly mixed experts learn terrain-related specialization in one PPO controller.
en.mainContent: CMoE combines history-based state estimation and terrain encoding with a gate that mixes five actor experts. SwAV-style swapped assignments align terrain features and gate activations, using Sinkhorn–Knopp to balance prototype pseudo-labels within each batch. Mixed-terrain tests, gate clustering, and expert removal demonstrate terrain-related routing, alongside real-humanoid deployment.
innovations: Introduces terrain-conditioned representation alignment into humanoid MoE routing.
Combines PPO with bidirectional swapped-assignment supervision for gates and experts.
Studies control specialization using mixed terrain and expert removal.
implementation: A β-VAE maps ten proprioceptive frames to a 3-D velocity estimate and 16-D history latent, trained by velocity supervision and next-observation reconstruction.
The gate produces softmax weights and action mean \(\mu=\sum_{i=1}^{5}w_i\mu_i\); every sample passes through all five experts.
Gate and terrain branches project to 16 dimensions and share 32 learnable prototypes, with prediction softmax temperature 0.2.
Sinkhorn–Knopp uses ε=0.05 and three row/column scaling rounds to form balanced, stop-gradient prototype assignments; the branches supervise each other’s predictions.
Estimators update with their own objectives; PPO and contrastive losses then update actors, gates, projectors, and prototypes. Randomization covers dynamics, pushes, and terrain-observation errors.

papers.venue: Proceedings of the 8th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2024), PMLR 270

zh.title: SLR: Learning Quadruped Locomotion without Privileged Information
zh.authors: Shiyi Chen, Zeyu Wan, Shiyang Yan, Chun Zhang, Weiyi Zhang, Qiang Li, Debing Zhang, Fasih Ud Din Farrukh
zh.institutions: Tsinghua University; Shenzhen Technology University
zh.takeaway: 在 history-based PPO 上增加价值、一步 latent 预测和 triplet 目标，学习可用于控制的本体表征。
zh.mainContent: SLR 在 history-based PPO 中加入价值回归、latent transition 和 triplet loss，分别学习回报相关性、一步预测结构和表征区分。训练期的 transition model 提供辅助信号，部署策略使用本体历史 latent 进行运动控制。
innovations: 真正的新意是训练信号的组合与梯度接线，而不是单独提出 encoder、transition model 或 triplet loss：历史 encoder 同时接受 critic value loss 与 latent transition/triplet loss，无需 privileged observation、privileged target 或 teacher latent。
actor 前向使用 \(\mathbf z_t\)，但通过 stop-gradient 阻断 PPO policy loss 到 encoder 的梯度；critic 保留到 encoder 的梯度，使 latent 倾向于保留有助于预测未来回报的信息。这里的作用是 value-predictive，而不是直接对 latent 做回报最大化。
以 \(\mathbf z_{t+1}\) 为 anchor、预测的 \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\) 为 positive、随机时刻的 \(\mathbf z_{t+n}\) 为 negative 构造 triplet loss，同时施加一步动力学一致性与防坍缩约束；这是辅助表示学习机制，不用于部署期预测或规划。
跨 MoB、RLvRL、ROA、HIM 和普通 baseline 的原始代码配置验证可插拔性，并在 Go2 上部署，是较有价值的工程性系统整合与验证，但 PPO、MLP、triplet loss、PD 控制和域随机化本身均是继承组件。
implementation: 当前观测为 45 维，包括基座角速度、3 维速度命令、投影重力、12 维关节位置、12 维关节速度和上一时刻 12 维动作；encoder 读取最近 \(H=10\) 步历史，经 [256, 128] 隐层输出 20 维 \(\mathbf z_t\)。

正文公式中 actor 输入当前观测与 \(\operatorname{sg}[\mathbf z_t]\)，经 [512, 256, 128] 隐层输出 12 维关节位置目标，再由 PD 控制器转成力矩；critic 以当前观测和未 detach 的 \(\mathbf z_t\) 预测 value。附录 Table A3 将 actor/critic 输入写成历史观测与 latent，与正文存在不一致。

transition model 经 [256, 128] 隐层计算 \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}=\mu(\mathbf z_t,\mathbf a_t)\)。论文最小化 \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{trip}}=\max(\lVert\mathbf z_{t+1}-\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\rVert_2^2-\lVert\mathbf z_{t+1}-\mathbf z_{t+n}\rVert_2^2+m,0)\)，其中 \(m=1.0\)；正样本项拉近真实与预测的下一 latent，负样本项要求随机时刻至少更远一个 margin。

四个网络在同一轮 on-policy PPO 中联合更新，但梯度来源不同：actor 由 PPO clipped policy loss 与 entropy 更新；critic 由 value loss 更新；encoder 由 value loss 与 triplet loss 更新，不接收 actor policy loss；transition model 只由 triplet loss 更新。rollout 中保存的动作作为辅助损失输入。

论文报告 rollout buffer 为 \(4096\times24\)，PPO clip 为 0.2，\(\gamma=0.99\)，GAE \(\lambda=0.95\)，learning rate 为 \(10^{-3}\)，triplet coefficient 为 1.0；Algorithm 1 每轮清空 buffer，因此不是跨迭代复用经验的 off-policy replay。

部署时仅保留 history encoder、actor 和 PD 控制器：每一步由最新本体历史重新计算 \(\mathbf z_t\) 并输出动作。critic、transition model、随机负样本、triplet loss、reward、GAE 和 PPO optimizer 全部删除；网络权重不在线更新，也不会使用 \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\) 做多步 rollout、MPC 或地形规划。
实验在主要消融中训练 6000 iterations、使用 3 个随机种子，并在五套既有代码库内比较；Go2 真机结果证明该冻结策略可以闭环部署在多类地形上。

en.title: SLR: Learning Quadruped Locomotion without Privileged Information
en.authors: Shiyi Chen, Zeyu Wan, Shiyang Yan, Chun Zhang, Weiyi Zhang, Qiang Li, Debing Zhang, Fasih Ud Din Farrukh
en.institutions: Tsinghua University; Shenzhen Technology University
en.takeaway: Adds value regression, one-step latent prediction, and triplet objectives to history-based PPO for useful proprioceptive control representations.
en.mainContent: SLR adds value regression, latent transitions, and triplet loss to history-based PPO for reward relevance, one-step temporal structure, and distinct representations. The transition model supplies a training signal, while deployment uses proprioceptive-history latents for locomotion.
innovations: The substantive novelty is the combination of training signals and gradient routing rather than the encoder, transition model, or triplet loss individually: the history encoder is shaped jointly by critic value loss and latent transition/triplet loss without privileged observations, privileged targets, or a teacher latent.

The actor uses \(\mathbf z_t\) in its forward pass but blocks the PPO policy gradient at the encoder, whereas the critic retains the gradient path to the encoder. This makes the latent value-predictive rather than directly maximizing return with respect to the latent.

A triplet objective uses \(\mathbf z_{t+1}\) as the anchor, predicted \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\) as the positive, and a random-time \(\mathbf z_{t+n}\) as the negative, imposing one-step latent consistency and an anti-collapse constraint. This is an auxiliary representation-learning mechanism, not a deployment-time predictor or planner.

Evaluation in the original configurations of MoB, RLvRL, ROA, HIM, and a plain baseline, followed by Go2 deployment, provides useful engineering evidence of plug-in portability; PPO, MLPs, triplet loss, PD control, and domain randomization themselves are inherited components.
implementation: The 45-dimensional current observation contains base angular velocity, a 3-D velocity command, projected gravity, 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities, and the previous 12-D action. The encoder reads the latest \(H=10\) observations and uses hidden layers [256, 128] to output a 20-D \(\mathbf z_t\).

In the main-text equations, the actor takes the current observation and \(\operatorname{sg}[\mathbf z_t]\), uses hidden layers [512, 256, 128], and outputs 12 joint-position targets that a PD controller converts to torques; the critic predicts value from the current observation and non-detached \(\mathbf z_t\). Appendix Table A3 instead lists observation history plus latent as the actor/critic input, creating an internal inconsistency.

The transition model uses hidden layers [256, 128] to compute \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}=\mu(\mathbf z_t,\mathbf a_t)\). The paper minimizes \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{trip}}=\max(\lVert\mathbf z_{t+1}-\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\rVert_2^2-\lVert\mathbf z_{t+1}-\mathbf z_{t+n}\rVert_2^2+m,0)\), with \(m=1.0\); the positive term aligns the actual and predicted next latent, while the negative term requires a random-time latent to be farther away by at least the margin.

All four networks are trained jointly within each on-policy PPO update, but receive different gradients: PPO clipped policy loss and entropy update the actor; value loss updates the critic; value and triplet losses update the encoder, with no actor policy gradient reaching it; and triplet loss alone updates the transition model. Rollout actions are stored inputs to the auxiliary loss, and the paper does not state that this loss differentiates through the action into the actor.

Reported hyperparameters include a \(4096\times24\) rollout buffer, PPO clip 0.2, \(\gamma=0.99\), GAE \(\lambda=0.95\), learning rate \(10^{-3}\), and triplet coefficient 1.0. Algorithm 1 clears the buffer every iteration, so it is not an off-policy replay buffer reused across iterations.

Deployment retains only the history encoder, actor, and PD controller; the latest proprioceptive history is re-encoded at every step. The critic, transition model, random negatives, triplet loss, rewards, GAE, and PPO optimizer are removed, the weights are frozen, and \(\tilde{\mathbf z}_{t+1}\) is never used for multi-step rollout, MPC, or terrain planning.
The main ablation is trained for 6000 iterations with 3 random seeds, and the method is compared within five existing codebases before Go2 deployment.

zh.title: TAR: Teacher-Aligned Representations via Contrastive Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion
zh.authors: Amr Mousa, Neil Karavis, Michele Caprio, Wei Pan, Richard Allmendinger
zh.institutions: The University of Manchester, United Kingdom；BAE Systems, United Kingdom
zh.takeaway: 让学生 latent transition 对齐特权 critic 的下一状态表征，部署保留本体历史编码器和 actor。
zh.mainContent: TAR 让学生历史 latent 的一步预测 \(f_D(z_t^S,a_t)\) 对齐共同训练的特权 critic 下一状态表征 \(z_{t+1}^T\)。该锚点将训练时可用的动力学信息带入学生表征，与 PPO 一起优化控制。部署使用学生历史编码器与 actor，论文报告仿真比较和零样本真机运动。
innovations: 核心方法增量：把 SLR 中作为正锚点的下一时刻 student latent \(z_{t+1}^S\)，替换为共同训练的 privileged critic encoder latent \(z_{t+1}^T\)，从而把仿真特权信息接入可部署 student 的 latent dynamics 学习。
TAR 内部没有预训练并冻结的 teacher actor，也不是两阶段 action behavioral cloning；所谓 teacher 是 critic 的 privileged encoder。其 latent 同时受 value loss 和 TAR metric loss 塑造，因此是 moving target，而不是固定真值标签。
方法把 recurrent student、显式速度估计、asymmetric actor–critic、PPO、domain randomization 和 latent transition prediction 整合为单阶段训练与可裁剪部署闭环；其中 LSTM、速度回归和 PPO 本身属于辅助或继承组件，不应单独计作核心创新。
论文提出由不同并行环境提供 task-informed negatives，并将部分提升归因于此；但官方代码没有读取摩擦、质量、地形或 environment ID 来保证跨域采样，只能确认随机选择不同 transition，因此该机制归因尚未被实现与消融充分支持。
implementation: 可部署观测 \(O_t\in\mathbb R^{45}\) 包含 base angular velocity 3、projected gravity 3、速度指令 3、12 维关节位置、12 维关节速度和上一动作 12。训练期 privileged observation 还包含真实 base linear velocity、187 维 height scan、外力、足端接触、摩擦和质量/载荷等仿真量。

主模型中 student encoder 是 hidden size 256 的 LSTM，输出 45 维 \(z_t^S\)；privileged critic encoder 输出 45 维 \(z_t^T\)；forward model 读取 \((z_t^S,a_t)\)；actor/critic MLP 为 [512, 256, 128]。velocity estimator 读取 \(z_t^S\) 与最近 4 帧本体观测，输出 3 维基座线速度估计。

一次 rollout 前向为：\((O_t,h_{t-1},c_{t-1})\rightarrow z_t^S\)，\((z_t^S,O_{t-4:t})\rightarrow\hat v_t\)，再由 actor 读取 \((O_t,\operatorname{sg}(z_t^S),\operatorname{sg}(\hat v_t))\) 输出 12 维动作。LSTM 的 hidden/cell state 是在线递推状态而非可训练参数；其门控权重通过序列重放和 BPTT 更新，episode 终止处重置状态。

更新关系必须分开理解：PPO actor loss 只更新 actor；value loss 更新 critic encoder 与 value head；TAR metric loss 更新 student LSTM、forward model 和 privileged critic encoder，但不经过 value head；按 Algorithm 1 与官方代码，velocity MSE 还会通过未 detach 的 \(z_t^S\) 更新 student。actor 输入处的 stop-gradient 使 PPO 不直接反向训练 student 或 velocity estimator。
TAR 正样本关系是 \(f_D(z_t^S,a_t)\approx z_{t+1}^T\)，而不是监督 critic 的最终标量 \(V_{t+1}\)。\(z_{t+1}^T\) 是 critic network 中 encoder 与 value head 之间的中间特征；TAR loss 可改变 encoder 参数，但 value head 权重只由 value loss 更新。
论文 Eq. (4) 写成相对距离的标准 triplet hinge；官方代码则实现无条件 positive MSE 加独立 negative hinge，两者不是同一个目标。代码的 negative branch 被 detach，而 positive privileged latent 未 detach，因此 privileged critic encoder 会参与正样本对齐。
论文配置使用 Adam、\(\gamma=0.99\)、GAE \(\lambda=0.95\)、4 个 minibatch、每批 5 个 epoch、45 维 latent、20,000 iterations；官方配置显示 4096 个并行环境、每环境每轮 24 步。论文以更少 PPO iteration 表述 sample efficiency。

zero-shot 部署只保留 normalizer、student LSTM、velocity estimator 和 actor；privileged encoder、critic value head、forward model、metric loss 与 rollout buffer 均可删除。新地形或载荷下直接递推 hidden state 并推理，不做逐实例数值优化，也不需要重新训练。

作者在 3 个 seeds 上报告主方法最终训练 return 比 fully privileged Teacher 高 4.1%；7,500 iterations 的 combined evaluation error 比 Teacher、SLR 和 HIM 分别低 74%、39.8% 和 42.2%。但该指标是归一化复合分数，评估曲线没有置信区间，主 TAR 与 SLR 在 LSTM/历史结构、latent 维度、速度输入和参数量上也未匹配，因此不能把全部差异归因于 teacher alignment。
真机评估使用冻结策略进行 Unitree Go2 零样本部署。接口核对时，论文将 action 描述为 target joint torque，而官方配置使用 joint-position target；复现需按实际执行代码确定底层接口。

en.title: TAR: Teacher-Aligned Representations via Contrastive Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion
en.authors: Amr Mousa, Neil Karavis, Michele Caprio, Wei Pan, Richard Allmendinger
en.institutions: The University of Manchester, United Kingdom; BAE Systems, United Kingdom
en.takeaway: Aligns student latent transitions with privileged critic representations of the next state; deployment keeps the history encoder and actor.
en.mainContent: TAR aligns the student’s one-step latent prediction \(f_D(z_t^S,a_t)\) with the jointly trained privileged critic representation \(z_{t+1}^T\). This anchor transfers training-time dynamics information to student features alongside PPO. Deployment uses the history encoder and actor; experiments include simulation comparisons and zero-shot real-robot locomotion.
innovations: The core methodological increment replaces SLR's next-student-latent positive anchor \(z_{t+1}^S\) with the jointly trained privileged critic-encoder latent \(z_{t+1}^T\), injecting simulation-only information into latent-dynamics learning for a deployable student.

TAR contains neither a pretrained frozen teacher actor nor two-stage action behavioral cloning; its “teacher” is the critic's privileged encoder. Because this latent is shaped jointly by the value loss and TAR metric loss, it is a moving target rather than a fixed ground-truth label.

The system integrates a recurrent student, explicit velocity estimation, asymmetric actor–critic learning, PPO, domain randomization, and latent transition prediction into a single-stage training and prunable deployment pipeline. LSTM, velocity regression, and PPO are auxiliary or inherited components rather than standalone core innovations.

The paper proposes task-informed negatives from different parallel environments and attributes part of the gain to this design. However, the official code does not read friction, mass, terrain, or environment IDs to guarantee cross-domain sampling; it only confirms sampling a different random transition, so the mechanism claim is not adequately isolated or implemented as described.
implementation: The deployable observation \(O_t\in\mathbb R^{45}\) contains 3-D base angular velocity, 3-D projected gravity, a 3-D velocity command, 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities, and the previous 12-D action. During training, the privileged observation additionally includes true base linear velocity, a 187-D height scan, external force, foot contacts, friction, and mass/payload variables from simulation.

In the main model, the student encoder is an LSTM with hidden size 256 and a 45-D output \(z_t^S\); the privileged critic encoder outputs a 45-D \(z_t^T\); the forward model consumes \((z_t^S,a_t)\); and the actor/critic MLP widths are [512, 256, 128]. The velocity estimator consumes \(z_t^S\) and the latest four proprioceptive frames and outputs a 3-D base-linear-velocity estimate.

One rollout step is \((O_t,h_{t-1},c_{t-1})\rightarrow z_t^S\), followed by \((z_t^S,O_{t-4:t})\rightarrow\hat v_t\), after which the actor consumes \((O_t,\operatorname{sg}(z_t^S),\operatorname{sg}(\hat v_t))\) and emits a 12-D action. LSTM hidden/cell states are recurrent runtime states, not trainable parameters; its gate weights are updated through sequence replay and BPTT, with states reset at episode termination.

The update paths must be separated: the PPO actor loss updates only the actor; the value loss updates the critic encoder and value head; the TAR metric loss updates the student LSTM, forward model, and privileged critic encoder but does not pass through the value head. According to Algorithm 1 and the official code, the velocity MSE also updates the student through an undetached \(z_t^S\), while stop-gradient at the actor input prevents PPO from directly training the student or velocity estimator.

The TAR positive relation is \(f_D(z_t^S,a_t)\approx z_{t+1}^T\); it does not supervise the critic's final scalar \(V_{t+1}\). The quantity \(z_{t+1}^T\) is the intermediate feature between the critic encoder and value head, so TAR can change encoder parameters, whereas value-head weights are updated only by the value loss.

Equation (4) presents a standard relative-distance triplet hinge, whereas the official code implements an unconditional positive MSE plus a separate negative hinge; these are not the same objective. The code detaches the negative branch but not the positive privileged latent, so the privileged critic encoder participates in positive alignment.

The paper specifies Adam, \(\gamma=0.99\), GAE \(\lambda=0.95\), 4 minibatches, 5 epochs per batch, a 45-D latent, and 20,000 iterations; the official configuration shows 4,096 parallel environments and 24 steps per environment per iteration. Sample efficiency is stated in terms of fewer PPO iterations, while matched wall-clock time and FLOPs are not reported.

Zero-shot deployment retains only the normalizer, student LSTM, velocity estimator, and actor; the privileged encoder, critic value head, forward model, metric loss, and rollout buffer can be removed. A new terrain or payload is handled by recurrent-state inference without per-instance numerical optimization or retraining.

Across 3 seeds, the authors report a 4.1% higher final training return than the fully privileged Teacher; at 7,500 iterations, the combined evaluation error is reported as 74%, 39.8%, and 42.2% lower than Teacher, SLR, and HIM, respectively. However, this is a normalized composite score without confidence intervals, and the main TAR and SLR configurations do not match LSTM/history structure, latent dimension, velocity input, or parameter count, so the full difference cannot be attributed to teacher alignment.

The hardware study establishes only zero-shot execution of a frozen policy on a Unitree Go2. It provides no online parameter-update curve, real-world reward, safety mechanism, or SAC/off-policy implementation, and the conclusion lists off-policy extension and real-world fine-tuning as future work. There is also a paper–code conflict: the paper calls the 12-D action a target joint torque, whereas the official code configures a joint-position target, so the low-level interface is not fully resolved.

Real-robot evaluation deploys a frozen policy zero-shot on Unitree Go2. The paper describes action as target joint torque, while official configuration uses joint-position targets; reproduction should resolve the low-level interface from the execution code.

zh.title: Sobolev Training for Neural Networks
zh.authors: Wojciech Marian Czarnecki, Simon Osindero, Max Jaderberg, Grzegorz Swirszcz, Razvan Pascanu
zh.institutions: DeepMind, London, UK
zh.takeaway: 同时蒸馏教师的输出与输入导数，让学生在样本点附近复制教师的局部响应。
zh.mainContent: Sobolev Training 在监督目标中同时匹配函数值和输入导数，让模型利用每个样本的局部变化信息。教师 Jacobian 为学生提供邻域响应监督，实验包括函数逼近与 Atari 策略离线蒸馏。它为反馈控制与策略蒸馏中的导数匹配提供基础。
innovations: 核心方法是统一的值—输入导数联合监督范式：学生不仅拟合目标输出，还拟合目标关于输入的一阶或高阶导数；论文并给出 ReLU/leaky-ReLU 网络的一阶 Sobolev 逼近论证，但该理论是表示存在性而非优化收敛或一般深网样本复杂度保证。
关键辅助设计是 stochastic Sobolev Training：从输出空间单位球采样随机方向 \(v\)，通过 \(J(x)^\top v\) 比较教师与学生的 directional derivative，从而无需物化完整 Jacobian。
作者把同一监督接口应用于 policy distillation 和 Synthetic Gradients；这些是有价值的工程组合，而不是新的强化学习算法。Synthetic Gradient 场景中，loss predictor 同时拟合真实 loss value 与其对隐藏激活的梯度。
implementation: 通用训练目标由值损失和导数损失组成：\(\mathcal L(\theta)=\sum_i[\ell(m_\theta(x_i),f(x_i))+\sum_j\ell_j(D_x^j m_\theta(x_i),D_x^j f(x_i))]\)。目标函数或教师提供固定标签，反向传播只更新学生参数 \(\theta\) 与优化器状态；教师输出、教师导数、输入样本和随机方向都不是被优化变量。
Atari 阶段先用 A3C 训练教师 80M steps，再冻结教师并采集 100K frames，约对应 400K actual environment steps。输入是连续 4 帧、灰度、缩放到 \(84\times84\) 的图像，action repeat 为 4；教师动作数在 Pong、Breakout、Space Invaders 中分别为 3、4、6。

Atari 学生是更小的 CNN：两层卷积分别为 16 个 \(8\times8\)/stride 4 和 32 个 \(4\times4\)/stride 2 卷积核，随后是 256 维全连接层和 softmax。每个 minibatch 含 200 个教师状态，使用 10%、20% 或 50% 的教师数据；优化目标是动作分布 KL 加上随机方向上的 \(\nabla_s\langle\log\pi(s),v\rangle\) 匹配，蒸馏阶段没有环境 reward、advantage 或 A3C 更新。
Atari 蒸馏中被冻结的 A3C 教师 \(\pi^*(s)\) 和学生 \(\pi_\theta(s)\) 都输出离散动作概率分布。普通标签是教师动作分布，Sobolev 标签是教师 log-policy 对像素状态的输入 Jacobian 投影；两类损失共同更新学生 CNN，而不是更新教师或重新执行强化学习。
训练结束后，回归和策略蒸馏都只保留学生网络；教师、输入导数标签和随机方向均不部署。新输入只需一次学生前向推理，不需要逐实例优化，也不需要重新计算 Jacobian；只有更换目标函数、教师或游戏时才需要重新训练或微调。
二维回归使用两层、每层 256 单元的 ReLU 学生网络，Adam learning rate 为 \(3\times10^{-5}\)，训练点数量为 20、100 或 10000，并用 10000 个同域点测试。七个函数中六个的测试 MSE 明显改善，但高频 Ackley 函数在低数据区间变差，说明不充分的局部导数采样也可能误导插值。
Synthetic Gradient 场景中，主网络先产生隐藏激活 \(h\)，loss predictor 用预测梯度更新上游参数；完整下游稍后给出真实 loss 和 \(\partial L/\partial h\)，再监督 loss predictor。主网络同步更新，辅助模块通过 Hogwild 异步更新；最终分类推理仅保留主网络。
Atari 蒸馏在教师生成的留出帧上，以 most-probable-action error 和 KL divergence 衡量学生对教师输出的拟合。

en.title: Sobolev Training for Neural Networks
en.authors: Wojciech Marian Czarnecki, Simon Osindero, Max Jaderberg, Grzegorz Swirszcz, Razvan Pascanu
en.institutions: DeepMind, London, UK
en.takeaway: Distills both teacher outputs and input derivatives so the student reproduces local responses around training points.
en.mainContent: Sobolev Training matches function values and input derivatives in supervised learning, using local variation around each sample. Teacher Jacobians supervise student responses in function approximation and offline Atari policy distillation. It provides a foundation for derivative-aware policy and feedback distillation.
innovations: The core method is a unified value-and-input-derivative supervision paradigm: the student matches both target outputs and first- or higher-order input derivatives. The paper also gives a first-order Sobolev approximation argument for ReLU/leaky-ReLU networks, but this is a representation-existence result rather than an optimization-convergence or general deep-network sample-complexity guarantee.

A key supporting design is stochastic Sobolev Training: a random direction \(v\) is sampled from the output-space unit sphere, and teacher and student directional derivatives are compared through \(J(x)^\top v\), avoiding explicit construction of the full Jacobian.

The same supervision interface is applied to policy distillation and Synthetic Gradients; these are useful engineering integrations rather than a new reinforcement-learning algorithm. In the Synthetic Gradient setting, a loss predictor is supervised on both the true loss value and its gradient with respect to hidden activations.
implementation: The general objective combines value and derivative losses: \(\mathcal L(\theta)=\sum_i[\ell(m_\theta(x_i),f(x_i))+\sum_j\ell_j(D_x^j m_\theta(x_i),D_x^j f(x_i))]\). The target function or teacher supplies fixed labels, and backpropagation updates only student parameters \(\theta\) and optimizer state; teacher outputs, teacher derivatives, input samples, and random directions are not optimization variables.

For Atari, the teacher is first trained with A3C for 80M steps, then frozen and used to collect 100K frames, corresponding to about 400K actual environment steps. Each input contains four consecutive grayscale frames resized to \(84\times84\), with action repeat 4; Pong, Breakout, and Space Invaders use 3, 4, and 6 actions, respectively.

The Atari student is a smaller CNN with 16 \(8\times8\)/stride-4 filters, 32 \(4\times4\)/stride-2 filters, a 256-unit fully connected layer, and softmax output.
