Minibatches contain 200 teacher states, and experiments use 10%, 20%, or 50% of the teacher dataset; the objective combines policy KL with matching \(\nabla_s\langle\log\pi(s),v\rangle\) along random directions, with no environment reward, advantage, or A3C update during distillation.

During Atari distillation, both the frozen A3C teacher \(\pi^*(s)\) and student \(\pi_\theta(s)\) output categorical action distributions. The ordinary target is the teacher action distribution, while the Sobolev target is a projection of the teacher log-policy input Jacobian with respect to pixel observations; both losses update the student CNN rather than the teacher or an RL objective.

After training, regression and policy-distillation applications retain only the student network; the teacher, derivative labels, and random directions are discarded. A new input requires only a student forward pass, with no per-instance optimization or Jacobian recomputation; changing the target function, teacher, or game requires retraining or fine-tuning.

The two-dimensional regression study uses a ReLU student with two 256-unit hidden layers, Adam at learning rate \(3\times10^{-5}\), 20, 100, or 10000 training points, and 10000 in-domain test points. Test MSE improves clearly on six of seven functions, while the high-frequency Ackley function degrades in low-data settings, showing that sparsely sampled local derivatives can also mislead interpolation.

In the Synthetic Gradient setting, the main network produces hidden activation \(h\), and a loss predictor supplies a predicted gradient for an immediate upstream update; the complete downstream computation later provides the true loss and \(\partial L/\partial h\) to train the predictor. Main-network updates are synchronous, auxiliary-module updates use asynchronous Hogwild, and final classification inference retains only the main network.

The central evidence boundary is that Atari results report only most-probable-action error and KL divergence on held-out teacher-generated frames; the student is never rolled out in the game, and score, state-distribution shift, and disturbance recovery are not reported. Major reproducibility gaps include the Atari derivative weight \(\alpha\), training duration, the Figure 4 x-axis unit, random seeds, and the exact random-direction sampling protocol.
Atari distillation evaluates teacher-generated holdout frames using most-probable-action error and KL divergence to measure student output fidelity.

zh.title: Towards Adaptive Humanoid Control via Multi-Behavior Distillation and Reinforced Fine-Tuning
zh.authors: Yingnan Zhao, Xinmiao Wang, Dewei Wang, Xinzhe Liu, Dan Lu, Qilong Han, Peng Liu, Chenjia Bai
zh.institutions: College of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Engineering University; Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom; School of Information Science and Technology, University of Science and Technology of China; School of Information Science and Technology, ShanghaiTech University; College of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology; Shenzhen Research Institute of Northwestern Polytechnical University; National Engineering Laboratory for Modeling and Emulation in E-Government, Harbin Engineering University
zh.takeaway: 把起身与行走教师蒸馏为双专家 MoE，再用分行为 critic 和 PCGrad 进行多行为地形微调。
zh.mainContent: AHC 先训练起身和行走两个 PPO + AMP 教师，再通过高度路由蒸馏为双专家 MoE。随后用 behavior-specific critics 与 PCGrad 在复杂地形联合微调，使统一策略同时保持起身和行走能力。
innovations: 可辩护的核心贡献是训练调度与系统接口：先得到 privileged recovery/walking teachers，再蒸馏为 proprioception-only unified actor，最后在目标地形上 reinforced fine-tuning；MoE、DAgger、AMP、PPO、multi-critic 和 PCGrad 本身均为已有组件。
蒸馏期用当前基座高度 \(h_{\mathrm{base}}>0.5\,\mathrm m\) 选择 walking teacher，否则选择 recovery teacher，从而为同一个 student 在连续 rollout 中生成行为相关的教师标签；部署时删除该高度路由。
第二阶段把两种行为放在各自 task worker、reward 与 critic 中产生 rollout 和梯度，同时共享一套 MoE actor，并用 PCGrad 处理负内积的 actor gradients，以降低联合微调时的任务干扰。
implementation: 完整训练分三段：两个平地 PPO+AMP teachers 各训练 10,000 iterations；冻结 teachers 后蒸馏 MoE student 4,000 iterations；再在 flat、slope、hurdle、discrete terrains 上联合 PPO fine-tune 10,000 iterations。论文采用 IsaacGym、4096 个并行环境、rollout length 32、每轮 5 epochs 和 4 minibatches；teacher/student learning rate 为 \(10^{-3}\)，fine-tuning 降为 \(10^{-4}\)。
两个 teacher 与两个 student experts 不是同一组对象。\(\pi_w^b\) 和 \(\pi_r^b\) 是先独立训练、蒸馏时冻结并负责给标签的完整策略；student 的两个 experts 与 learned gate 共同构成唯一的 MoE 策略 \(\pi^d\)，它们不是两个 teacher 的直接复制，也没有被显式指定为一号走路、二号起身。

Student MoE 由两个 \([512,256,128]\) expert MLP 和一个同样为 \([512,256,128]\) 的 gate MLP 构成，gate 产生两个 expert action 的 mixing weights。论文只监督最终混合输出，没有 gate cross-entropy、expert identity label 或 load-balancing loss，也没有公开 gate 归一化、混合位置或 expert 权重可视化，因此不能确认两个 experts 是否真正发生 recovery/walking 专门化。

Base height 不是 student observation，也不直接进入 MoE gate 或 loss。训练器先计算 \(m_t=\mathbf 1[h_t^{\mathrm{base}}>0.5\,\mathrm m]\)，再由 \(m_t\) 选择 walking/recovery teacher；真正进入 loss 的标签是所选 teacher 的 action 和 policy distribution。等价地，height 只决定这一步向哪个老师查询答案，并不监督 student 内部应调用哪个 expert。
蒸馏环境可确认会从 fallen 或 standing posture 初始化。Teacher 是按每一步当前 base height 动态选择，而非永久绑定环境组；因此同一个 recovery-reset environment 理论上可在站起超过阈值后改由 walking teacher 监督，standing environment 摔倒后也可反向切换。

作者称蒸馏为 DAgger，但 Algorithm 1 漏写 \(\mathrm{env.step}(a)\)，没有说明由 student action、teacher action 还是二者混合推进状态。若由 student 主导 rollout，才符合用 learner-induced states 查询 teacher 的 DAgger 核心；现有正文只能确认迭代教师查询和监督更新，不能确认严格的数据聚合方式。

蒸馏目标为 \(\mathcal L=0.1\,\lVert a^d-a^b\rVert_2^2+0.5\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi^d\Vert\pi^b)\)。这里 \(\pi(\cdot\mid s)=\mathcal N(\mu(s),\operatorname{diag}(\sigma^2))\) 表示完整高斯动作分布，而 \(a\sim\pi(\cdot\mid s)\) 是一次动作样本或控制输出；MSE 对齐动作，KL 同时对齐均值与方差，二者部分重叠但不等价。

Deployed actor 的输入是 69 维 \(s_t^{\mathrm{prop}}=[\omega_t,g_t,c_t,q_t,\dot q_t,a_{t-1}]\)，其中包含机身角速度、重力方向、三维速度命令、20 维关节位置/速度和上一动作，不含 base height、显式 behavior ID 或 privileged dynamics。策略以 50 Hz 输出 20 维关节位置偏移，低层 500 Hz PD 执行；teachers、critics、AMP discriminators、reference motions、rewards、PCGrad 和高度路由全部在部署时删除。

Fine-tuning 以蒸馏后的 \(\pi^d\) 初始化共享 MoE actor；walking 与 recovery 各自在独立 task worker/GPU、环境、reward、AMP reference 和 critic 上计算 rollout、GAE 与 actor gradient。若两任务梯度内积为负，main process 随机选择一个方向执行 PCGrad 投影，再更新唯一的共享 actor 并把参数广播回 workers；critics 各自更新，不进入 PCGrad。
根据作者的训练观察，fine-tuning 学习率从 \\(10^{-3}\\) 降到 \\(10^{-4}\\)，以降低策略退化和技能遗忘。

关键证据限制包括：没有 direct multi-task RL from scratch 的容量与总交互量匹配基线，没有单 expert 或参数量匹配 dense actor，没有 two policies + hysteresis FSM、oracle-height gate、gate weight/expert specialization 分析，也没有四项 critic/PCGrad 消融对应的最终 success 与多 seed 置信区间。因此不能把统一控制效果因果归因于 MoE、DAgger、PCGrad 或两阶段训练中的任一单独模块。

复现仍受多处正文缺口阻碍：项目页截至核查时仍标注 code coming soon；action scale、observation normalization、student history、gate normalization、reset 比例和 DAgger rollout action 未公开。Eq. (3) 的 PD 误差写成 \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}-q^{\mathrm{default}}\) 而不是常规的 \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}-q_t\)，AMP discriminator objective 的最大化符号也与目标描述冲突，均需官方代码或作者澄清。

en.title: Towards Adaptive Humanoid Control via Multi-Behavior Distillation and Reinforced Fine-Tuning
en.authors: Yingnan Zhao, Xinmiao Wang, Dewei Wang, Xinzhe Liu, Dan Lu, Qilong Han, Peng Liu, Chenjia Bai
en.institutions: College of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Engineering University; Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom; School of Information Science and Technology, University of Science and Technology of China; School of Information Science and Technology, ShanghaiTech University; College of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology; Shenzhen Research Institute of Northwestern Polytechnical University; National Engineering Laboratory for Modeling and Emulation in E-Government, Harbin Engineering University
en.takeaway: Distills standing-up and walking teachers into a two-expert MoE, then fine-tunes behaviors on terrain with behavior-specific critics and PCGrad.
en.mainContent: AHC trains standing-up and walking PPO-plus-AMP teachers, distills them into a two-expert MoE with height-based routing, and fine-tunes on complex terrain with behavior-specific critics and PCGrad. The unified policy retains both recovery and walking.
innovations: The defensible core contribution is the training schedule and system interface: privileged recovery/walking teachers are distilled into a proprioception-only unified actor, which is then reinforced-fine-tuned on target terrains; MoE, DAgger, AMP, PPO, multi-critic learning, and PCGrad are all inherited components.

During distillation, current base height \(h_{\mathrm{base}}>0.5\,\mathrm m\) selects the walking teacher and otherwise selects the recovery teacher, producing behavior-dependent labels for one student along a continuous rollout; this height router is removed at deployment.

The second stage generates rollouts and gradients in separate task workers with their own rewards and critics while sharing one MoE actor, and applies PCGrad to conflicting actor gradients to reduce interference during joint fine-tuning.
implementation: Training has three segments: two flat-ground PPO+AMP teachers are trained for 10,000 iterations each; the frozen teachers supervise MoE student distillation for 4,000 iterations; joint PPO fine-tuning then runs for 10,000 iterations on flat, slope, hurdle, and discrete terrains. The paper uses IsaacGym, 4,096 parallel environments, rollout length 32, five epochs and four minibatches per iteration; teacher/student learning rate is \(10^{-3}\), reduced to \(10^{-4}\) for fine-tuning.

The two teachers and the two student experts are different objects. \(\pi_w^b\) and \(\pi_r^b\) are complete independently trained policies that are frozen and queried for labels during distillation; the two experts and learned gate jointly constitute the single MoE student \(\pi^d\), are not direct copies of the teachers, and are not explicitly assigned walking versus recovery roles.

The student MoE contains two \([512,256,128]\) expert MLPs and a \([512,256,128]\) gate MLP that produces mixing weights over expert actions. Only the final mixture is supervised: there is no gate cross-entropy, expert identity label, or load-balancing loss, and the paper does not disclose the gate normalization, mixture location, or gate/expert visualizations, so actual recovery/walking specialization is unverified.

Base height is neither a student observation nor a direct input to the MoE gate or loss. The trainer first computes \(m_t=\mathbf 1[h_t^{\mathrm{base}}>0.5\,\mathrm m]\) and uses it to select the walking or recovery teacher; the selected teacher's action and policy distribution are the labels that enter the loss. Height therefore decides which teacher answers the current query, but does not supervise which internal expert the student should use.

The paper confirms that distillation environments initialize from fallen or standing postures. Teacher selection is recomputed from current base height at every step rather than permanently bound to an environment group, so a recovery-reset environment can in principle switch to walking supervision after standing up, and a standing environment can switch in the opposite direction after falling.

The authors call the procedure DAgger, but Algorithm 1 omits \(\mathrm{env.step}(a)\) and never states whether student actions, teacher actions, or a mixture advances the simulation. Student-driven rollouts would satisfy DAgger's core requirement of querying teachers on learner-induced states; the paper as written only establishes iterative teacher querying and supervised updates, not strict data aggregation.

The distillation objective is \(\mathcal L=0.1\,\lVert a^d-a^b\rVert_2^2+0.5\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi^d\Vert\pi^b)\). Here \(\pi(\cdot\mid s)=\mathcal N(\mu(s),\operatorname{diag}(\sigma^2))\) is the full Gaussian action distribution, whereas \(a\sim\pi(\cdot\mid s)\) is one sampled action or control output; MSE aligns actions and KL aligns both means and variances, so the terms overlap but are not equivalent.

The deployed actor observes the 69-D vector \(s_t^{\mathrm{prop}}=[\omega_t,g_t,c_t,q_t,\dot q_t,a_{t-1}]\): base angular velocity, gravity direction, a 3-D velocity command, 20-D joint positions and velocities, and the previous action. It contains no base height, explicit behavior ID, or privileged dynamics. The 50 Hz policy outputs 20-D joint-position offsets for a 500 Hz PD loop; teachers, critics, AMP discriminators, reference motions, rewards, PCGrad, and the height router are all removed at deployment.

Fine-tuning initializes the shared MoE actor from \(\pi^d\). Walking and recovery use separate task workers/GPUs, environments, rewards, AMP references, and critics to compute rollouts, GAE, and actor gradients. If the task-gradient inner product is negative, the main process randomly chooses one projection direction for PCGrad, updates the single shared actor, and broadcasts its parameters; critics update separately and do not enter PCGrad.

The authors report that retaining \(10^{-3}\) during fine-tuning readily causes policy collapse and forgetting, motivating \(10^{-4}\). In context, policy collapse should be read as a large PPO update causing overall policy performance and on-policy rollouts to deteriorate, followed by a bad-data feedback loop; it is distinct from losing only one skill and is not evidence of MoE gate/expert collapse. The paper defines no collapse metric.

Key evidence gaps are the absence of a capacity- and interaction-matched direct multi-task RL baseline, a single-expert or capacity-matched dense actor, two policies plus a hysteresis FSM, an oracle-height gate, gate/expert specialization analysis, and final success with multi-seed confidence intervals for the critic/PCGrad ablations. Consequently, the unified-control result cannot be causally attributed to any one of MoE, DAgger, PCGrad, or the two-stage schedule.

Reproduction remains blocked by missing implementation details: the project page still stated code coming soon at the time of review, and action scaling, observation normalization, student history, gate normalization, reset ratios, and the DAgger rollout action were not disclosed. Eq. (3) uses \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}-q^{\mathrm{default}}\) rather than the conventional \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}-q_t\) PD error, and the AMP discriminator objective's maximization sign conflicts with its stated target; both require official code or author clarification.

zh.title: WoCoCo: Learning Whole-Body Humanoid Control with Sequential Contacts
zh.authors: Chong Zhang, Wenli Xiao, Tairan He, Guanya Shi
zh.institutions: ETH Zurich; Carnegie Mellon University（Chong Zhang 的工作在 Carnegie Mellon University 完成）
zh.takeaway: 把顺序接触计划拆为阶段，让同一个 RL 策略根据实际接触推进全身任务。
zh.mainContent: WoCoCo 研究的是：在顺序接触计划已经给定时，如何用端到端 model-free RL 控制人形机器人连续完成多阶段全身任务，而不为每段动作单独生成参考轨迹或训练独立控制器。它把任务拆成预定义的 contact stages，每个 stage 由 contact goal 与 task goal 共同定义；同一个策略根据本体观测和当前目标输出关节位置目标，环境在 rollout 内逐控制步检查真实接触与任务条件，满足后才推进 stage。Dense contact reward、stage-count reward 和基于随机网络哈希的 count-based curiosity 共同缓解稀疏接触与长时序探索，随后通过三阶段 curriculum 加入 domain randomization 和更强 regularization 完成 Sim-to-Real。作者在真机上展示了 parkour、箱体 loco-manipulation、clap-and-tap dancing 和 cliffside climbing，并在 22-DoF dinosaur 仿真任务中验证了框架可迁移性；但它不生成 contact sequence，依赖外部 goal representation 与显式接触反馈，各任务仍分别训练策略，安全性与不可行计划检测也未解决。
innovations: 把顺序接触任务统一表示为预定义 contact stages；第 \(i\) 个 stage 只有在 contact goal \(g_i^{\mathrm{con}}\) 与 task goal \(g_i^{\mathrm{task}}\) 同时满足时才完成。它统一的是任务分解和策略学习接口，不是一个 contact planner。
提出针对失败链设计的 WoCoCo reward：dense contact reward 对每个正确或错误末端接触分别计分，stage-count reward 鼓励策略离开当前安全阶段并继续完成后续阶段，从而避免只用 0-1 完成奖励时的探索失败和故意停滞。
以随机初始化并冻结的神经网络把 task-agnostic curiosity observation 哈希到离散 bucket，再用访问计数的反平方根作为 curiosity reward；相较论文对照中的 RND，它减少了对罕见但无意义危险状态的持续过度探索。
将已有的 PPO、symmetry augmentation、domain randomization 和 regularization 组织为三阶段 Sim-to-Real curriculum。该部分更准确地属于系统化训练流程整合：先解决任务探索，再处理模型误差，最后压制激进动作，而不是全新的 RL 优化算法。
同一套 contact-stage formulation 与 reward family 支撑四类差异很大的真机人形任务及一个非人形 embodiment；证据表明框架可跨任务复用，但不是一套同时覆盖所有任务的 universal multi-task policy。
implementation: 任务输入首先是一条预定义 contact sequence。环境维护当前 stage index \(i\)；Actor 接收 proprioception 与 goal representation。Parkour 额外输入未来两个 stages 的目标，其他任务主要输入当前 stage；论文原型用 motion-capture system 提供目标表示，没有使用 camera 或 LiDAR。

共享本体观测包括 joint positions、joint velocities、previous actions、base linear/angular velocities 和 projected gravity；joint states 与 previous actions 堆叠最近 3 个 control steps。Actor 与 Critic 都是隐藏层为 [512, 256, 128] 的 MLP。

单个控制步的数据流是：当前观测与 stage goal \(\rightarrow\) Actor \(\rightarrow\) joint target positions \(\rightarrow\) low-level PD \(\rightarrow\) Isaac Gym 或机器人 \(\rightarrow\) 新状态、末端位置与接触信息 \(\rightarrow\) reward 和 stage check。一个 rollout 内同一个 Actor 可以连续经历多个 stages；并非一个 rollout 结束后才检查一次，也不会每切换一次 stage 就立刻反向传播。
Stage manager 是环境逻辑而非可学习网络。每个控制步检查当前 contact goal 和 task goal；若未完成则保持 \(i\)，若完成则在预定义等待时间后令 \(i\leftarrow i+1\)。物理触地只表示存在接触力，正确接触还必须满足指定末端、目标区域及该任务的附加条件。

论文正文只抽象规定以 sensors 或 human observation 判断 stage fulfillment，没有给出所有任务统一的接触阈值。公开 clap-and-tap 示例代码以脚部竖直接触力大于 1 N 作为触地条件之一，再结合足端目标区域、手部接触和全身条件；成功会锁存 `current_contact_reached`，计时 0.4–0.8 s 后切换 stage，因此该示例不要求成功条件在整个等待区间持续成立。上述数值不能直接推广到 Parkour、Box 或 Cliffside。

任务无关奖励为 \(r_{\mathrm{WoCoCo}}=w_{\mathrm{con}}r_{\mathrm{con}}+w_{\mathrm{stage}}r_{\mathrm{stage}}+w_{\mathrm{curi}}r_{\mathrm{curi}}\)。其中 \(r_{\mathrm{con}}=n_{\mathrm{corr}}-n_{\mathrm{con}}n_{\mathrm{wrong}}\mathbb{1}(n_{\mathrm{stage}}>0)+2n_{\mathrm{con}}^2F_{\mathrm{con}}F_{\mathrm{task}}\)，\(r_{\mathrm{stage}}=n_{\mathrm{stage}}F_{\mathrm{task}}\)；总奖励还加 task-specific reward 与 Sim-to-Real regularization。

Curiosity observation 包括 base 的世界系位置、姿态、线速度与角速度，以及全部末端的世界系位置和接触状态。冻结的 hash network 只有一个 32-unit hidden layer 与 16-D output；其输出符号经 BIN2DEC 形成 bucket ID，奖励为 \(r_{\mathrm{curi}}=1/\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{visit}}}\)。Curiosity 只在训练 Phase 1 开启。

训练在 Isaac Gym 中使用并行 PPO 和左右 symmetry augmentation。各并行环境逐步收集 \((o_t,a_t,r_t,o_{t+1})\) 等 transition；rollout batch 收集完成后才计算 return 和 advantage，并统一更新 Actor 与 Critic，所以同一 PPO batch 可以混合不同环境和不同 contact stages 的样本。

三阶段训练从同一 checkpoint 连续续训：Phase 1 不开 domain randomization，使用 curiosity 学会任务；Phase 2 关闭 curiosity，并加入 friction、mass、base CoM、PD gain、control delay、torque disturbance、push 和 terrain 等随机化；Phase 3 保持随机化，每 2000 iterations 将 regularization 权重提高 20%，直到初始值的 2 倍。消融显示过早加入随机化会降低 Parkour progress，取消 Phase 3 会使真机动作更加 jerky 和 aggressive。
部署时保留 goal/stage manager、Actor、动作滤波、PD controller 和接触反馈，不保留 Critic、PPO、reward 或 curiosity 模块。策略以 50 Hz 更新，PD torque command 以 200 Hz 更新，PD targets 经过 4 Hz Butterworth low-pass filter。
实验结论需要限定：四个真机任务证明了预定义接触计划下的可执行性和一定 Sim-to-Real 能力，但主要是任务级展示；Parkour 真机因场地限制只测试 double-foot sequence 的 1–2 次连续跳跃。

en.title: WoCoCo: Learning Whole-Body Humanoid Control with Sequential Contacts
en.authors: Chong Zhang, Wenli Xiao, Tairan He, Guanya Shi
en.institutions: ETH Zurich; Carnegie Mellon University (Chong Zhang's work was conducted at Carnegie Mellon University)
en.takeaway: Splits a sequential contact plan into stages and lets one RL policy progress through them using observed contact.
en.mainContent: WoCoCo studies how to use end-to-end model-free RL to execute a given sequential contact plan with a humanoid, without generating a reference trajectory or training a separate controller for every motion segment. It decomposes a task into predefined contact stages, each jointly specified by a contact goal and a task goal; one policy maps proprioception and the active goal to joint-position targets, while the environment checks physical contacts and task conditions at every control step and advances the stage inside the rollout. Dense contact, stage-count, and random-network-hash count-based curiosity rewards address sparse contacts and long-horizon exploration, followed by a three-phase curriculum that introduces domain randomization and stronger regularization for Sim-to-Real. The paper demonstrates parkour, box loco-manipulation, clap-and-tap dancing, and cliffside climbing on a real humanoid, plus a 22-DoF dinosaur task in simulation; however, it does not generate contact sequences, relies on external goal representations and explicit contact feedback, trains separate task policies, and does not solve safety or infeasible-plan detection.
innovations: A unified decomposition of sequential-contact tasks into predefined contact stages, where stage \(i\) is completed only when both contact goal \(g_i^{\mathrm{con}}\) and task goal \(g_i^{\mathrm{task}}\) hold. This unifies the task and policy interface; it is not a contact planner.

A failure-chain-oriented WoCoCo reward: dense contact rewards score every correct and incorrect end-effector contact, while stage-count rewards incentivize leaving a locally safe stage and progressing further, addressing failed exploration with binary completion rewards and deliberate stalling.

A count-based curiosity mechanism that hashes task-agnostic curiosity observations into discrete buckets with a randomly initialized frozen neural network and assigns inverse-square-root visitation bonuses; in the paper's ablation, this avoids the persistent over-exploration of rare but meaningless dangerous states observed with RND.

A three-phase Sim-to-Real curriculum that organizes existing PPO, symmetry augmentation, domain randomization, and regularization. It is best viewed as a systematic training integration—first solve exploration, then model mismatch, then aggressive actions—rather than a new RL optimizer.

The same contact-stage formulation and reward family support four substantially different real-world humanoid tasks and one non-humanoid embodiment. This supports framework reuse across tasks, but not a single universal multi-task policy.
implementation: The task input is a predefined contact sequence. The environment maintains the active stage index \(i\), and the Actor receives proprioception plus a goal representation. Parkour additionally exposes the next two stages, whereas the other tasks mainly expose the current stage; the prototype uses a motion-capture system for goal representations and does not use cameras or LiDAR.

Shared proprioception includes joint positions, joint velocities, previous actions, base linear and angular velocities, and projected gravity; joint states and previous actions are stacked over the latest three control steps. Both Actor and Critic are MLPs with hidden sizes [512, 256, 128].

One control step follows: observation and stage goal \(\rightarrow\) Actor \(\rightarrow\) joint target positions \(\rightarrow\) low-level PD \(\rightarrow\) Isaac Gym or robot \(\rightarrow\) next state, end-effector positions, and contacts \(\rightarrow\) reward and stage check. The same Actor can traverse multiple stages within one rollout; stage checks are not deferred to rollout termination, and stage switches do not trigger immediate backpropagation.

The stage manager is environment logic, not a learned network. It checks the current contact and task goals at every control step; it keeps \(i\) if they are unmet and advances \(i\leftarrow i+1\) after a predefined waiting period once they are met. Physical contact alone is insufficient: the specified end effector, target region, and task-specific conditions must also be correct.

The paper abstracts stage fulfillment as being checked by sensors or human observation and does not give one contact threshold shared by all tasks. In the released clap-and-tap example, a vertical foot contact force above 1 N is one contact condition, combined with target foot regions, hand-contact logic, and whole-body conditions; success latches `current_contact_reached`, and the stage changes after a 0.4–0.8 s timer, so success need not remain continuously true throughout that waiting interval. These numbers should not be generalized to Parkour, Box, or Cliffside.

The task-agnostic reward is \(r_{\mathrm{WoCoCo}}=w_{\mathrm{con}}r_{\mathrm{con}}+w_{\mathrm{stage}}r_{\mathrm{stage}}+w_{\mathrm{curi}}r_{\mathrm{curi}}\), with \(r_{\mathrm{con}}=n_{\mathrm{corr}}-n_{\mathrm{con}}n_{\mathrm{wrong}}\mathbb{1}(n_{\mathrm{stage}}>0)+2n_{\mathrm{con}}^2F_{\mathrm{con}}F_{\mathrm{task}}\) and \(r_{\mathrm{stage}}=n_{\mathrm{stage}}F_{\mathrm{task}}\). The total reward also includes task-specific terms and Sim-to-Real regularization.

Curiosity observations contain world-frame base position, orientation, linear and angular velocity, plus all end-effector world positions and contact states. The frozen hash network has one 32-unit hidden layer and a 16-D output; output signs are converted by BIN2DEC into a bucket ID, and \(r_{\mathrm{curi}}=1/\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{visit}}}\). Curiosity is enabled only in Phase 1.

Training uses parallel PPO in Isaac Gym with left-right symmetry augmentation. Parallel environments collect transitions such as \((o_t,a_t,r_t,o_{t+1})\) step by step; only after a rollout batch is collected are returns and advantages computed and Actor/Critic updated, so one PPO batch can mix environments and contact stages.

The three phases resume from the same checkpoint: Phase 1 learns the task without domain randomization and with curiosity; Phase 2 disables curiosity and adds randomization of friction, mass, base CoM, PD gains, control delay, torque disturbance, pushes, and terrain; Phase 3 keeps randomization and increases regularization weights by 20% every 2,000 iterations until they reach twice their initial values. Ablations show that early randomization reduces Parkour progress and removing Phase 3 yields jerkier, more aggressive real-world behavior.

Deployment retains the goal and stage manager, Actor, action filter, PD controller, and explicit contact feedback, but not the Critic, PPO, reward computation, or curiosity module. The policy runs at 50 Hz, PD torque commands at 200 Hz, and PD targets pass through a 4-Hz Butterworth low-pass filter.

The evidence must be scoped carefully: the four real-robot tasks establish executability under predefined contact plans and some Sim-to-Real capability, but evaluation is primarily task-level demonstration; due to facility constraints, real-world Parkour only tests one or two consecutive jumps with double-foot sequences.

zh.title: X-Loco: Towards Generalist Humanoid Locomotion Control via Synergetic Policy Distillation
zh.authors: Dewei Wang, Xinmiao Wang, Chenyun Zhang, Jiyuan Shi, Yingnan Zhao, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
zh.institutions: University of Science and Technology of China; Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom; Harbin Engineering University
zh.takeaway: 以 CASS 选教师、SAR 混合采样，将行走、恢复和全身协调专家蒸馏为单一视觉 generalist。
zh.mainContent: X-Loco 用 PPO 训练视觉地形行走、跌倒恢复和全身协调三个特权 specialist，再以 CASS 根据头部高度与地形选择教师，以 SAR 逐步转向学生闭环 rollout。教师动作监督一个读取本体历史、深度图和速度命令的视觉 generalist。仿真三类任务平均成功率为 0.939、0.871、1.000，并在 G1 上展示连续地形、翻滚和起身。
innovations: 系统层面的主要贡献是把 upright locomotion、fall recovery 与 whole-body coordination 三类动力学和目标差异明显的技能，整合到一个基于深度视觉、仅由速度指令驱动的 generalist policy 中；这更接近已有 PPO、AMP、motion tracking、behavior cloning 与 MoE 的系统组合，而不是提出新的基础 RL 算法。
Case-Adaptive Specialist Selection（CASS）根据机器人头部高度和地形类别 one-hot 选择一个 specialist 产生动作标签，使学生在不同技能区间及其切换状态获得相应教师监督。
Specialist Annealing Rollout（SAR）以退火概率混合 specialist 与 student 动作来推进环境：前期借教师到达复杂动作的后半段，后期逐渐暴露学生自身诱导的状态分布，以缓解纯 teacher-forced behavior cloning 的 covariate shift。
Stochastic Fall Injection（SFI）在行走和攀爬过程中施加情境相关外力，使训练数据包含从正常运动进入失衡、再切换到恢复的过渡状态；并通过停滞检测终止不可恢复轨迹。
工程上实现了面向大规模并行环境的 Warp 深度渲染，并将静态地形 mesh 与每个环境自身的动态机器人 mesh 分开查询，以支持视觉策略训练。
implementation: 三个 specialist 都是预训练并在蒸馏阶段冻结的完整 Actor-Critic 教师，统一输出 23 维 action。action 通过 \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}=q^{\mathrm{default}}+\alpha\odot a_t\) 转换为关节目标，再由 PD 控制器执行。
Upright locomotion specialist \(\pi_l\) 通过 PPO 训练，输入十帧特权状态历史、143 维 elevation map 和速度指令；任务奖励负责速度跟踪与地形穿越，LAFAN1 动作片段只用于 AMP discriminator 产生 style reward，因此 AMP 是辅助风格约束，不是逐帧 reference tracking。
Fall recovery specialist \(\pi_r\) 从加入大关节噪声的 prone（俯卧）和 supine（仰卧）姿态初始化，不使用 elevation map；PPO 奖励分为恢复任务、AMP style、regularization 和站立后的 post-task 奖励，并采用四个独立 critics。恢复 MoCap 用于 AMP 风格判别而非逐帧 BC。

Whole-body coordination specialist \(\pi_w\) 采用 reference-conditioned motion tracking，而不是 AMP。它接收当前本体状态、elevation map 和 52 维 motion command，直接用身体位置、姿态、线角速度和 anchor tracking 等逐帧奖励学习箱体攀爬与前滚等动作；reference motion 只在教师训练和蒸馏标签生成阶段使用，部署 generalist 不需要它。
三个 specialists 通过独立 PPO 预训练，作为冻结教师提供动作标签；学生的两个 MoE experts 从随机初始化开始随 generalist 联合学习。

Generalist 输入为十步 proprioceptive history、连续 64×64 深度图和速度指令。CNN depth encoder 将深度序列压缩为 128 维 latent，history encoder 编码本体历史；其时间特征与视觉 latent 一起送入 MoE。gate 和每个 expert 都是三层 MLP [512, 256, 128]，采用两个 experts；论文只说明 gate 调制 expert contributions，没有公开足以确认 tensor-level 混合位置和最终 action head 连接方式的完整公式。

CASS 根据 \(f(b_t,I_t)\) 选择当前唯一教师：头部高度低于 1.1 m 时选 recovery，面对高平台或约 0.7 m 悬挂障碍时选对应 whole-body specialist，其余情况选 locomotion。所选 specialist 用干净的 privileged observation 输出 \(a_t^*\)，学生用加噪非特权观测输出动作，并最小化 \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}}=\mathbb{E}[\lVert\pi_g(o_{u,t})-a_t^*\rVert_2^2]\)。该 MSE 更新学生的编码器、gate、两个 MoE experts 和动作输出部分，不更新 specialists。

SAR 与 MoE 属于两个独立层面：MoE 决定学生内部怎样算出动作，SAR 决定哪个动作实际推进仿真器。每步采样 \(b_t\sim\mathrm{Bernoulli}(\rho)\)，执行 \(a_{\mathrm{env}}=b_ta_t^*+(1-b_t)a_t^u\)，但无论执行教师还是学生动作，都保存 \((o_{u,t},a_t^*)\) 训练学生；只有执行教师动作的步骤属于 teacher-forced rollout。
SAR 的 specialist ratio \(\rho\) 以滞回规则退火：蒸馏 MSE 低于 0.005 时每轮减少 \(10^{-4}\)，高于 0.010 时暂停衰减。它先利用教师访问成功技能轨迹的后半段，再逐渐转向学生诱导的部署状态分布。
SFI 不只在 episode 开始时设置倒地状态，而是在高速转弯、翻滚等脆弱阶段施加外力，主动产生 locomotion/coordination 到 recovery 的切换数据；若恢复阶段连续头高方差低于阈值，认为机器人卡住并终止 episode。
训练在 Isaac Lab 中使用 4096 个并行环境。三个 specialists 分别训练 30,000、10,000 和 50,000 iterations；generalist 以 supervised behavior cloning 训练 30,000 iterations，而不是再用 PPO 更新。
部署平台为 23-DoF Unitree G1，配备 Intel RealSense D435i 和 Jetson Orin NX；policy 以 50 Hz 输出关节目标，500 Hz PD 回路执行。深度 Sim-to-Real 使用噪声、模糊、相机内外参随机化，以及真机深度 hole filling 和 Gaussian filtering。
仿真结果中 X-Loco 在 upright locomotion、WBC 和 recovery 上分别达到 0.939、0.871 和 1.000 的平均成功率。MoE-2 的总体平均成功率为 0.928，高于无 MoE 的 0.749 和 MoE-3 的 0.779。
作者明确限制包括窄视场相机导致感知范围有限、真实深度噪声难以完全建模，以及 behavior cloning 使 generalist 的能力上界受 specialist 性能与状态覆盖约束；WBC 从 specialist 的 1.000 降至 generalist 的 0.871，也说明复杂接触技能仍有明显蒸馏损失。

en.title: X-Loco: Towards Generalist Humanoid Locomotion Control via Synergetic Policy Distillation
en.authors: Dewei Wang, Xinmiao Wang, Chenyun Zhang, Jiyuan Shi, Yingnan Zhao, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
en.institutions: University of Science and Technology of China; Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom; Harbin Engineering University
en.takeaway: Uses CASS teacher selection and SAR mixed rollouts to distill walking, recovery, and coordination specialists into one visual generalist.
en.mainContent: X-Loco trains privileged PPO specialists for terrain walking, recovery, and whole-body coordination. CASS selects teachers from head height and terrain, while SAR gradually shifts to student-controlled rollouts. Teacher actions supervise a generalist using proprioceptive history, depth, and velocity commands; simulation success averages 0.939, 0.871, and 1.000 across the three tasks, with G1 demonstrations of terrain traversal, rolling, and recovery.
innovations: The primary system-level contribution is the integration of upright locomotion, fall recovery, and whole-body coordination—three regimes with substantially different dynamics and objectives—into one depth-based, velocity-commanded generalist. This is best viewed as a system synthesis of existing PPO, AMP, motion tracking, behavior cloning, and MoE components rather than a new foundational RL algorithm.

Case-Adaptive Specialist Selection (CASS) uses robot head height and terrain category to select one specialist as the action-label provider, exposing the student to appropriate supervision within each skill regime and around transitions.

Specialist Annealing Rollout (SAR) mixes specialist and student actions with an annealed probability: early teacher control reaches later parts of complex maneuvers, while later student control exposes the learner to its deployment-induced state distribution and reduces covariate shift from pure teacher forcing.

Stochastic Fall Injection (SFI) applies context-dependent disturbances during locomotion and climbing so that training includes transitions from normal motion to imbalance and recovery, with stagnation-based termination for unrecoverable trajectories.
The system includes a Warp-based depth renderer that separately queries a shared static terrain mesh and each environment's local dynamic robot mesh for scalable visual-policy training.
implementation: The three specialists are complete Actor-Critic teachers pretrained and then frozen during distillation, all sharing a 23-dimensional action space. The action is mapped to joint targets by \(q_t^{\mathrm{target}}=q^{\mathrm{default}}+\alpha\odot a_t\) and executed by a PD controller.

The upright locomotion specialist \(\pi_l\) is trained with PPO from ten-step privileged state history, a 143-dimensional elevation map, and a velocity command. Task rewards define velocity tracking and terrain traversal, while LAFAN1 motion clips are used only by an AMP discriminator to produce a style reward; AMP is therefore an auxiliary prior, not frame-wise reference tracking.

The fall-recovery specialist \(\pi_r\) is initialized from noisy prone and supine poses and does not use an elevation map. PPO combines recovery-task, AMP-style, regularization, and post-task standing rewards, with four independent critics. Recovery MoCap trains the AMP style discriminator rather than providing frame-wise BC targets.

The whole-body coordination specialist \(\pi_w\) follows reference-conditioned motion tracking rather than AMP. It receives current proprioception, an elevation map, and a 52-dimensional motion command, and is directly rewarded for body position, orientation, linear/angular velocity, and anchor tracking when learning box climbing and forward rolls. Reference motions are used for teacher training and teacher-action generation during distillation, but not by the deployed generalist.

Specialists and MoE experts must not be conflated: the three specialists are independently PPO-pretrained teachers that are frozen and discarded after distillation; the two MoE experts are randomly initialized internal subnetworks jointly learned with the generalist. There is no locomotion/recovery/coordination-to-expert assignment and no expert-selection label.

The generalist consumes ten-step proprioceptive history, sequential 64×64 depth images, and a velocity command. A CNN depth encoder produces a 128-dimensional latent, while a history encoder processes proprioceptive history; their temporal and visual features feed the MoE. The gate and each expert are three-layer MLPs [512, 256, 128], with two experts. The paper states that the gate modulates expert contributions but does not provide enough tensor-level detail to confirm the exact mixing location and final action-head wiring.

CASS uses \(f(b_t,I_t)\) to choose exactly one teacher: recovery when head height is below 1.1 m, the relevant whole-body specialist for a high platform or an approximately 0.7 m overhead obstacle, and locomotion otherwise. The selected specialist produces \(a_t^*\) from clean privileged observations, and the student minimizes \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}}=\mathbb{E}[\lVert\pi_g(o_{u,t})-a_t^*\rVert_2^2]\) from noisy non-privileged observations. This MSE updates the student's encoders, gate, two MoE experts, and action-output components, while all specialists remain frozen.

SAR and MoE operate at separate levels: MoE determines how the student computes an action internally, whereas SAR determines which action advances the simulator. Each step samples \(b_t\sim\mathrm{Bernoulli}(\rho)\) and executes \(a_{\mathrm{env}}=b_ta_t^*+(1-b_t)a_t^u\), but stores \((o_{u,t},a_t^*)\) regardless of which action was executed. Only steps that execute the teacher action are teacher-forced rollouts.

The SAR specialist ratio \(\rho\) follows hysteresis-based annealing: it decreases by \(10^{-4}\) per iteration when distillation MSE is below 0.005 and pauses when the loss exceeds 0.010. This first uses teacher control to reach later parts of successful trajectories and then shifts toward the student-induced deployment distribution.

SFI applies disturbances during vulnerable contexts such as high-speed turns and rolls, instead of only initializing episodes from fallen states. During recovery, an episode terminates if the variance of recent head heights falls below a threshold, indicating that the robot is stuck.

Training uses Isaac Lab with 4,096 parallel environments. The locomotion, recovery, and whole-body specialists train for 30,000, 10,000, and 50,000 iterations, respectively; the generalist trains for 30,000 iterations using supervised behavior cloning rather than PPO.

Deployment uses a 23-DoF Unitree G1 with an Intel RealSense D435i and Jetson Orin NX. The policy outputs joint targets at 50 Hz and a 500 Hz PD loop executes them. Depth sim-to-real treatment includes noise, blur, camera intrinsic/extrinsic randomization, plus hole filling and Gaussian filtering for real depth images.

In simulation, X-Loco reaches mean success rates of 0.939, 0.871, and 1.000 on upright locomotion, WBC, and recovery. MoE-2 obtains an overall mean of 0.928 versus 0.749 without MoE and 0.779 for MoE-3. However, the paper does not include a parameter-matched wider MLP or visualize gate activations and expert roles, so the gain cannot be attributed conclusively to skill specialization rather than capacity or optimization differences.

The authors identify a narrow camera field of view, imperfect modeling of real depth noise, and the behavior-cloning ceiling imposed by specialist performance and state coverage as limitations. The WBC drop from 1.000 for the specialist to 0.871 for the generalist also shows substantial residual distillation loss for contact-rich skills.

zh.title: TaSIL: Taylor Series Imitation Learning
zh.authors: Daniel Pfrommer, Thomas T.C.K. Zhang, Stephen Tu, Nikolai Matni
zh.institutions: Massachusetts Institute of Technology; University of Pennsylvania; Robotics at Google（Daniel Pfrommer 的该项工作完成于 University of Pennsylvania 任职期间）
zh.takeaway: 把策略值与输入导数的联合匹配连接到专家闭环的 δ-ISS，给出离线模仿轨迹误差的条件上界。
zh.mainContent: TaSIL 在行为克隆之外匹配专家与学生策略的状态 Jacobian，并可加入更高阶 Taylor 项。利用专家闭环的局部 δ-ISS，在平滑性、稳定性和误差足够小的条件下，将专家轨迹上的模仿误差连接到闭环轨迹偏差上界。专家导数可由自动微分或黑盒有限差分获得，部署使用学生策略；MuJoCo 实验展示样本效率收益。
innovations: 核心创新：把 student 在自身访问状态上的 action error 改写成 expert 闭环的输入扰动，再利用 expert 的局部 δ-ISS 将该扰动上界连接到 student–expert imitation gap；Taylor 展开进一步把这一不可直接监督的误差拉回 expert 轨迹上的策略值与导数误差。
理论增量：建立 expert 鲁棒性增益、所需 Taylor 匹配最高阶数 \(p\) 与闭环轨迹误差之间的关系，并在可实现设定下给出按独立专家轨迹数 \(n\) 计的约 \(\widetilde O(1/n)\) 泛化率；这些结论依赖局部 δ-ISS、策略光滑、Taylor 余项有界及 ERM 等假设。
关键辅助设计：提出不要求解析 Jacobian 的 finite-difference TaSIL，通过在 \(x+\delta_i\) 处额外查询 expert 来匹配局部方向差分，并展示 TaSIL loss 可以作为插件加入 BC、DAgger 与 DART，而不改变部署接口。
新颖性边界：策略值与输入导数联合监督本身已有 Sobolev Training 和 Jacobian Matching 等前作；TaSIL 的知识增量是把它与连续控制中的 δ-ISS、闭环 imitation gap、所需导数阶数和有限样本保证系统连接，而不是首次提出 Jacobian 蒸馏。
implementation: 数据与标签：从初始状态分布采样并用固定 expert rollout，得到 \(x_t^\star\) 与 \(u_t^\star=\pi^\star(x_t^\star)\)；在每个训练状态缓存 expert 的 action、Jacobian，若做更高阶 TaSIL 则继续缓存 Hessian 等导数。它们是监督标签，不是环境 reward，也不是可训练参数。

一次学生更新：student 在同一 \(x_t^\star\) 上输出连续 action，并通过自动微分计算 \(\partial_x^j\pi_\theta(x_t^\star)\)。实践 loss 为 \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{TaSIL},p}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_i\sum_t\sum_{j=0}^{p}\lambda_j\lVert\operatorname{vec}(\partial_x^j\pi_\theta(x_{it})-\partial_x^j\pi^\star(x_{it}))\rVert_2\)；反向传播只更新 student 参数 \(\theta\) 与 Adam 临时状态，expert、标签和环境均固定。
Jacobian 的语义：student Jacobian 是 action 输出相对输入状态的派生导数，不是一个独立网络、额外 action head 或单独优化变量。Jacobian loss 对 \(\theta\) 的梯度会涉及 \(\partial^2\pi_\theta/(\partial\theta\,\partial x)\)，但部署时无需计算任何导数。
强化学习边界：MuJoCo expert 由上游 SAC 预训练，但 TaSIL 阶段不更新 expert actor/critic；student 没有 critic，不计算 return、advantage 或 policy gradient，MuJoCo reward 只用于 rollout 评估。

MuJoCo 主实验使用 2×256 ReLU expert 与 2×512 GELU student，轨迹长度为 300，batch size 为 100，初始学习率为 \(10^{-3}\)，weight decay 为 0.01，训练 4500 epochs；1-TaSIL 使用 \(\lambda_0=1\)、\(\lambda_1=0.01\)，student action 经 tanh 和动作范围缩放后送入环境。

DAgger 版本用 expert–student 混合策略收集学生分布附近的状态并聚合数据，再为新状态生成 expert action 与 Jacobian 标签；DART 版本根据 student–expert action error covariance 给 expert action 加高斯噪声以收集恢复状态。两者都只改变训练状态来源，student 更新仍是监督 imitation loss。
有限差分版本在半径 0.01 的球面上为每个样本固定抽取扰动方向，并比较 \(N=1,5,10,50\) 个方向；每个方向都需要额外 expert query，因此它消除了对白盒自动微分的要求，却没有消除训练期 expert oracle 与额外信息预算。

部署闭环只有“当前 observation \(x_t\) → 固定 student \(\pi_\theta(x_t)\) → 连续 action \(u_t\) → 环境下一状态”；不保留 expert、导数标签、优化器、critic、reward、有限差分、DAgger/DART 收集器或在线数值优化。相同任务的新状态与新初值可直接推理；更换 expert、任务、机器人或输入输出接口通常需要重新生成标签并训练。

证据审计：Figure 1 在人为可调 δ-ISS 增益的合成系统中最直接支持“expert 越不稳健，所需 Taylor 阶数越高”；Figure 2 只证明加入 Jacobian loss 对最终 normalized reward 有贡献。论文缺少在相同 teacher query、局部扰动样本、训练 FLOPs 与 wall-clock 下，将 TaSIL 和普通局部数据增强 BC 进行比较的决定性基线。
复现冲突：论文称 student 使用 Batch Normalization、Adam \(\epsilon=10^{-4}\)，官方代码却关闭 BatchNorm 并使用 \(10^{-8}\)；此外 MuJoCo expert 是 ReLU MLP，不直接满足理论所要求的连续高阶光滑假设。

en.title: TaSIL: Taylor Series Imitation Learning
en.authors: Daniel Pfrommer, Thomas T.C.K. Zhang, Stephen Tu, Nikolai Matni
en.institutions: Massachusetts Institute of Technology; University of Pennsylvania; Robotics at Google (Daniel Pfrommer completed this work while affiliated with the University of Pennsylvania)
en.takeaway: Connects joint policy-value and derivative matching to expert closed-loop δ-ISS, yielding conditional trajectory-error bounds for offline imitation.
en.mainContent: TaSIL augments behavior cloning with expert–student state-Jacobian matching and optional higher-order Taylor terms. Under smoothness, local expert closed-loop δ-ISS, and sufficiently small errors, it relates imitation loss on expert trajectories to closed-loop trajectory-error bounds. Derivatives come from autodiff or black-box finite differences, and deployment uses the student policy; MuJoCo experiments demonstrate sample-efficiency benefits.
innovations: Core innovation: rewrite the student's action error on its own visited states as an input perturbation to the expert closed loop, then use local δ-ISS of the expert to connect that perturbation bound to the student–expert imitation gap; a Taylor expansion pulls this otherwise unobservable error back to policy-value and derivative errors on expert trajectories.

Theoretical contribution: relate the expert robustness gain, the highest matched Taylor order \(p\), and closed-loop trajectory error, and derive an approximately \(\widetilde O(1/n)\) generalization rate in the realizable setting for \(n\) independent expert trajectories; these statements require local δ-ISS, policy smoothness, bounded Taylor remainders, and ERM-related assumptions.

Key auxiliary design: introduce finite-difference TaSIL, which avoids requiring analytic Jacobians by querying the expert additionally at \(x+\delta_i\) and matching local directional differences, and show that the TaSIL loss can plug into BC, DAgger, and DART without changing the deployment interface.

Novelty boundary: joint supervision of policy values and input derivatives predates TaSIL in Sobolev Training and Jacobian Matching; TaSIL's contribution is the systematic connection to δ-ISS, closed-loop imitation gap, required derivative order, and finite-sample guarantees in continuous control, not the first use of Jacobian distillation.
implementation: Data and labels: sample initial states and roll out a fixed expert to obtain \(x_t^\star\) and \(u_t^\star=\pi^\star(x_t^\star)\); cache the expert action and Jacobian at every training state, and cache Hessians or higher derivatives for higher-order TaSIL. These are supervision labels, not environment rewards or trainable parameters.

One student update: the student outputs a continuous action at the same \(x_t^\star\), and automatic differentiation computes \(\partial_x^j\pi_\theta(x_t^\star)\). The practical loss is \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{TaSIL},p}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_i\sum_t\sum_{j=0}^{p}\lambda_j\lVert\operatorname{vec}(\partial_x^j\pi_\theta(x_{it})-\partial_x^j\pi^\star(x_{it}))\rVert_2\); backpropagation updates only student parameters \(\theta\) and temporary Adam state, while the expert, labels, and environment remain fixed.

Jacobian semantics: the student Jacobian is a derived derivative of the action output with respect to the input state, not an independent network, an additional action head, or a separate optimization variable. Gradients of the Jacobian loss with respect to \(\theta\) involve \(\partial^2\pi_\theta/(\partial\theta\,\partial x)\), but no derivatives are computed at deployment.

Reinforcement-learning boundary: the MuJoCo expert is pretrained upstream with SAC, but TaSIL does not update the expert actor or critic; the student has no critic and computes no return, advantage, or policy gradient, while MuJoCo reward is used only for rollout evaluation.

The main MuJoCo experiments use a 2×256 ReLU expert and a 2×512 GELU student, trajectory length 300, batch size 100, initial learning rate \(10^{-3}\), weight decay 0.01, and 4500 training epochs; 1-TaSIL uses \(\lambda_0=1\) and \(\lambda_1=0.01\), and the student action is passed through tanh and rescaled to the action range before entering the environment.

The DAgger variant collects and aggregates states near the student distribution with an expert–student mixture policy, then generates expert action and Jacobian labels for those states; the DART variant injects Gaussian noise into expert actions according to the student–expert action-error covariance to collect recovery states. Both change only the source of training states, and student updates remain supervised imitation learning.

The finite-difference variant samples fixed perturbation directions per example on a sphere of radius 0.01 and compares \(N=1,5,10,50\) directions; every direction requires an additional expert query, so it removes the need for white-box automatic differentiation but not the training-time expert oracle or the extra information budget.

The deployment loop is only “current observation \(x_t\) → fixed student \(\pi_\theta(x_t)\) → continuous action \(u_t\) → next environment state.” The expert, derivative labels, optimizer, critic, reward, finite differences, DAgger/DART collectors, and online numerical optimization are absent. New states and initial conditions in the same task use direct inference; changing the expert, task, robot, or input/output interface generally requires regenerating labels and retraining.

Evidence audit: Figure 1 most directly supports “a less robust expert requires a higher Taylor order” in a synthetic system with manually adjustable δ-ISS gain, while Figure 2 only shows that adding the Jacobian loss contributes to final normalized reward. A decisive baseline matching teacher queries, local perturbation examples, training FLOPs, and wall-clock between TaSIL and ordinary locally augmented BC is missing.

Reproduction conflicts: the paper states that the student uses Batch Normalization and Adam \(\epsilon=10^{-4}\), whereas the official code disables BatchNorm and uses \(10^{-8}\); moreover, the MuJoCo expert is a ReLU MLP and therefore does not directly satisfy the continuous higher-order smoothness assumed by the theory.

zh.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
zh.authors: Lizhi Yang, Junheng Li, Nehar Poddar, Yiling Hou, Gio Huh, Robert Griffin, Georgia Gkioxari, Aaron D. Ames
zh.institutions: California Institute of Technology; The Institute for Human & Machine Cognition
zh.takeaway: 用分状态 KL 和 PPO 整合互补教师，得到接受任务空间命令的统一 soft-MoE 全身控制器。
zh.mainContent: HANDOFF 用三个互补 specialist teacher 提供运动与恢复能力，再以按速度、动作切片和恢复状态分配的 KL 与 PPO 训练统一 soft-MoE。高层 VLM 提供 10 维任务空间命令，控制器根据命令和身体状态执行全身运动。
innovations: 提出显式、紧凑的 10 维 planner-facing task-space interface：\([v_x,v_y,\omega_z,z,p_L^P,p_R^P]\)。上层无需生成控制频率下的完整关节或全身运动参考，同一接口可由脚本、几何 planner、遥操作器或 VLM 调用。
设计 action-sliced、context-weighted multi-teacher KL：普通状态下腿腰根据速度命令在 WBC 与 locomotion 教师之间连续混合，手臂由 WBC 教师约束；recovery flag 有效时改由 AMP 教师监督全身，从而避免运行时硬切换三个控制器。
将三个互补教师蒸馏到三 expert soft-MoE。KL、PPO 和负载均衡训练学生分工，recovery routing loss 引导第三个 expert 处理恢复状态。
关键辅助设计是对深蹲参考进行离线 CoP 可行性投影，并在部署时加入解析式 velocity-space CoP filter；这是对既有几何、Jacobian 和 barrier 投影思想的工程整合，不应与核心蒸馏方法一起泛称为全新算法。
implementation: 三个教师独立预训练：WBC teacher 接收完整运动参考并输出 29 维全身 action；locomotion teacher 接收随机速度命令和 gait phase，只输出 15 维腿腰 action，训练时手臂由课程化动作样本外部驱动；AMP teacher 依据 4 帧本体历史输出 29 维恢复 action，并用 fall-recovery transition 与 discriminator reward 训练。
学生阶段使用一套统一仿真 MDP，而不是分别运行三套 teacher environment。学生 action 推进得到同一仿真状态后，环境将其重组为 student、WBC、locomotion 和 AMP 各自所需的 observation；冻结教师只前向产生高斯动作分布作为 KL 目标，不执行动作、不推进环境，也不接收梯度。

学生环境确实要覆盖教师擅长的状态区域，但 reset 不是固定分成 WBC、locomotion、recovery 三组。论文明确将固定 20% 环境在 reset 时置为 fallen pose 并设置 recovery flag；其余普通环境同时维护 motion reference、随机 velocity command、gait phase 和 history，WBC/locomotion 监督由每一步 command 连续加权，而不是由环境组身份决定。
非恢复样本的腿腰权重为 \(\alpha_t=\sigma((\lVert c_t^{vel}\rVert-0.1)/0.02)\)：低速更接近 WBC teacher，高速更接近 locomotion teacher；手臂始终锚定 WBC。恢复样本屏蔽普通切片 KL，并在全部 29 个动作维度上计算 student-to-AMP KL。

MoE student 使用 11 帧历史的一维 temporal convolution 得到 64 维 latent；gate MLP hidden sizes 为 \((128,64)\)，三个 expert 均为 \((256,128)\) MLP，全部输出 29 维 action mean 并经 softmax 权重加权，三个 expert 共享 log-standard-deviation。学生训练采用 4096 个并行环境、每次 24 steps、5 epochs、4 minibatches，最多 30,000 updates。

部署时只保留 student actor、观测历史、内部 gait phase、在线 CoP filter 和低层关节伺服；教师、critic、AMP discriminator、KL、reward 和 optimizer 均被删除。actor 以 50 Hz 输出 29 维 joint-position action，硬件伺服以 500 Hz 跟踪；VLM/视觉规划栈运行在更低频，只把任务转成统一 10 维 command。

Table 2b 中最终 Ours+Stab 的 \(|\Delta v_x|,|\Delta v_y|,|\Delta\omega_z|\) 分别为 0.07、0.18、0.04，global feasibility 为 97.7%，robust workspace 为 \(0.31\,\mathrm{m^3}\)。这些结果支持最终系统能同时兼顾速度与工作空间，但 split-KL 和 MoE 被捆绑消融，且缺少等参数量 dense student、独立 MoE、独立 split-KL 与教师梯度冲突测量，因而没有直接验证作者声称的冲突缓解机制。

en.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
en.authors: Lizhi Yang, Junheng Li, Nehar Poddar, Yiling Hou, Gio Huh, Robert Griffin, Georgia Gkioxari, Aaron D. Ames
en.institutions: California Institute of Technology; The Institute for Human & Machine Cognition
en.takeaway: Combines complementary teachers with state-specific KL and PPO into one soft-MoE whole-body controller driven by task-space commands.
en.mainContent: HANDOFF combines three complementary specialists through KL and PPO terms assigned by velocity, motion segment, and recovery state, producing one soft-MoE controller. A higher-level VLM supplies ten-dimensional task-space commands, and the controller executes whole-body motion from commands and body state.
innovations: Introduces an explicit and compact 10-D planner-facing task-space interface, \([v_x,v_y,\omega_z,z,p_L^P,p_R^P]\), so scripts, geometric planners, teleoperation systems, or VLMs need not synthesize a full-body reference stream at the controller rate.

Uses action-sliced, context-weighted multi-teacher KL: in normal states, body supervision smoothly blends WBC and locomotion teachers according to commanded speed, arms remain anchored to the WBC teacher, and an active recovery flag assigns full-body supervision to the AMP teacher. This removes runtime switching among three controllers.

Distills the complementary teachers into one three-expert soft-MoE student. The student experts are not copied teacher networks: the first two have no explicit one-to-one WBC/locomotion labels and specialize through KL, PPO, and load balancing, while only the third is explicitly encouraged toward recovery by a routing loss.

As a key auxiliary design, applies an offline CoP-feasibility projection to squat references and an analytic velocity-space CoP filter at deployment. This is an engineering integration of existing geometric, Jacobian, and barrier-projection ideas rather than the core new distillation algorithm.
implementation: The three teachers are trained independently. The WBC teacher consumes a full motion reference and outputs a 29-D whole-body action; the locomotion teacher consumes randomized velocity commands and gait phase and outputs only the 15-D legs-and-waist action while curriculum-driven arm motions perturb the body during training; the AMP teacher consumes four frames of proprioceptive history, outputs a 29-D recovery action, and is trained with fall-recovery transitions and discriminator-derived rewards.

Student training uses one unified simulation MDP, not three separately advanced teacher environments. The student action advances the simulator; the resulting physical state is repackaged into the student-, WBC-, locomotion-, and AMP-specific observation schemas. Frozen teachers only produce Gaussian action distributions for KL targets, never execute the environment action, and receive no gradient.

The student environment must cover the specialists' state regions, but resets are not divided into fixed WBC, locomotion, and recovery groups. The paper sets a fixed 20% of environments to fallen poses with an active recovery flag at reset. The remaining normal environments jointly maintain a motion reference, randomized velocity command, gait phase, and history; WBC-versus-locomotion supervision is determined continuously by each step's command rather than by a permanent environment-group identity.

For non-recovery samples, the body weight is \(\alpha_t=\sigma((\lVert c_t^{vel}\rVert-0.1)/0.02)\): low speeds favor the WBC teacher and high speeds favor the locomotion teacher, while the arms remain anchored to WBC. Recovery samples exclude the normal sliced KL terms and use student-to-AMP KL across all 29 action dimensions.

The MoE student encodes an 11-frame history into a 64-D latent with a 1-D temporal convolution. A gate MLP with hidden sizes \((128,64)\) produces three softmax weights; three \((256,128)\) expert MLPs each output a 29-D action mean, and all experts share the log standard deviation. Student training uses 4,096 parallel environments, 24 steps per rollout, 5 epochs, 4 minibatches, and at most 30,000 updates.

Deployment retains only the student actor, observation history, internal gait phase, online CoP filter, and low-level joint servo. Teachers, critic, AMP discriminator, KL losses, rewards, and optimizer are removed. The actor produces 29-D joint-position actions at 50 Hz, tracked by the hardware servo at 500 Hz; the VLM/vision planning stack runs more slowly and only maps tasks into the shared 10-D command.

In Table 2b, the final Ours+Stab system reports \(|\Delta v_x|,|\Delta v_y|,|\Delta\omega_z|\) of 0.07, 0.18, and 0.04, 97.7% global feasibility, and a \(0.31\,\mathrm{m^3}\) robust workspace. These results show that the final system can combine velocity tracking and workspace coverage, but split-KL and MoE are ablated jointly. Without a parameter-matched dense student, isolated MoE and split-KL conditions, and direct teacher-gradient conflict measurements, the claimed conflict-reduction mechanism remains unverified.

zh.title: Neural probabilistic motor primitives for humanoid control
zh.authors: Josh Merel, Leonard Hasenclever, Alexandre Galashov, Arun Ahuja, Vu Pham, Greg Wayne, Yee Whye Teh, Nicolas Heess
zh.institutions: DeepMind, London, UK
zh.takeaway: 将 2707 个单动作专家压缩为带 60 维 latent 的反馈控制器，参考编码器或高层 RL 都能调用它。
zh.mainContent: NPMP 把 2707 个单动作专家离线蒸馏成带 60 维 latent 的共享反馈控制器。trajectory encoder 根据当前至未来五帧状态与上一 latent 编码参考，decoder 根据实际状态与 latent 输出动作，两者以行为克隆与 AR(1) 先验 KL 训练。下游任务由高层 RL 输出 latent，复用冻结的低层运动模块。
innovations: 提出 NPMP：以随机 latent bottleneck 连接 trajectory encoder 与状态反馈 decoder，将数千个单技能专家压缩为共享的 motor primitive embedding 和低层控制策略。
使用 AR(1) latent prior \(z_t=\alpha z_{t-1}+\sqrt{1-\alpha^2}\,\epsilon_t\) 约束相邻 latent 的时间连续性，并通过信息瓶颈限制 encoder 对未来参考窗口的依赖。
提出 LFPC：在教师名义轨迹上记录动作及动作对状态的 Jacobian，用一阶线性化为扰动状态合成反馈动作标签，以减少收集大量 noisy expert rollout 的成本。严格说它不计算或直接匹配学生 Jacobian，只是拟合 Jacobian 生成的邻域函数值；在完整 encoder-decoder 中，邻域响应还可能由 latent 通路与 decoder 状态通路共同承担。
把预训练 decoder 的 latent 空间当作新的高层动作空间：有参考轨迹时可由冻结 encoder 做 one-shot imitation，无参考的下游任务则由新训练的高层策略直接选择 \(z_t\)。
implementation: 数据与教师：从 CMU Mocap 数据库选取约 3000 段 2–6 秒片段，最终训练 2707 个 time-indexed 专家；专家在 MuJoCo 中以 mocap tracking reward、随机初始化参考姿态和跌倒提前终止训练，算法为 SVG(0)+Retrace，并以随机策略的均值动作作为教师。
Encoder：\(q_\phi(z_t\mid z_{t-1},x_t)\)，其中 \(x_t=[s_t,\ldots,s_{t+5}]\)；网络为两层、每层 1024 hidden units 的 MLP，输出带可学习方差的多元高斯，通常使用 60 维 latent。它没有 latent 标签，动作重建误差经 decoder 反向传播来训练它。
Decoder：\(\pi_\theta(a_t\mid s_t,z_t)\)，输入当前真实状态与 latent；网络为三层、每层 1024 hidden units 的 MLP，输出固定标准差 0.1 的高斯动作分布，动作归一化到 \([-1,1]\)。
联合目标是动作 log-likelihood 加权 AR(1) KL 正则；实验通常设 \(\alpha=0.95\)，完整压缩中 \(\beta=0.1\) 的 100-rollout 行为克隆表现最好。使用重参数化采样与 Adam，学习率 \(10^{-4}\)；100-rollout 模型使用 512 个长度 30 的子序列 minibatch。
LFPC 在名义点计算 \(J_t^E=\partial\mu_E/\partial s\)，对扰动状态 \(s_t^\star+\delta s_t\) 使用 \(a_t^\star+J_t^E\delta s_t\) 作为动作标签；训练不执行学生 rollout，也不显式计算 \(J_t^S\)。其 minibatch 为 32 个长度 30 的子序列，每个子序列生成 5 条扰动状态序列。

阶段分工：专家训练和数据收集阶段没有 NPMP encoder；离线蒸馏阶段 encoder 与 decoder 联合更新；one-shot 模仿时二者冻结，encoder 每时刻把 6 帧参考窗口编码为一个 \(z_t\)；下游 go-to-target、变速和视觉障碍任务中不使用 encoder，而以 SVG(0)+Retrace 训练高层策略直接输出 \(z_t\)，decoder 作为预训练低层模块复用。
关键结果与边界：对 one-shot 表现低于专家 50% 的轨迹，直接优化整段 latent 后，中位相对专家性能从 43% 提升到 78%，说明一部分失败来自 encoder，但残余误差也暴露了 decoder 对稀有行为训练不足。

en.title: Neural probabilistic motor primitives for humanoid control
en.authors: Josh Merel, Leonard Hasenclever, Alexandre Galashov, Arun Ahuja, Vu Pham, Greg Wayne, Yee Whye Teh, Nicolas Heess
en.institutions: DeepMind, London, UK
en.takeaway: Compresses 2,707 single-motion experts into a feedback controller with 60-dimensional latents callable by a reference encoder or higher-level RL.
en.mainContent: NPMP distills 2,707 single-motion experts into a shared feedback controller with 60-dimensional latents. A trajectory encoder observes the current-to-five-future-frame window and previous latent; the decoder produces actions from actual state and latent, trained by behavior cloning and AR(1)-prior KL. Downstream RL supplies latents to reuse the frozen motor module.
innovations: NPMP introduces a stochastic latent bottleneck between a trajectory encoder and a state-feedback decoder, compressing thousands of single-skill experts into a shared motor-primitive embedding and low-level controller.

An AR(1) latent prior, \(z_t=\alpha z_{t-1}+\sqrt{1-\alpha^2}\,\epsilon_t\), encourages temporal continuity between nearby latents, while the information bottleneck limits dependence on the future reference window.

LFPC records actions and action-to-state Jacobians along a teacher's nominal trajectory and uses first-order linearization to synthesize feedback action labels for perturbed states, reducing the need for many noisy expert rollouts. Strictly, it neither computes nor directly matches the student Jacobian; in the full encoder-decoder model, neighborhood response can also be shared between the latent path and the decoder's state path.

The pretrained decoder's latent space becomes a high-level action space: a frozen encoder enables one-shot imitation when a reference trajectory exists, while a newly trained high-level policy directly selects \(z_t\) for reference-free downstream tasks.
implementation: Data and teachers: roughly 3,000 clips of 2–6 seconds are selected from the CMU Mocap database, yielding 2,707 time-indexed experts. Experts are trained in MuJoCo with a mocap-tracking reward, initialization across reference poses, and early termination on falls, using SVG(0)+Retrace; the mean action of each stochastic policy is used as the teacher.

Encoder: \(q_\phi(z_t\mid z_{t-1},x_t)\), where \(x_t=[s_t,\ldots,s_{t+5}]\). It is a two-layer MLP with 1,024 hidden units per layer and outputs a multivariate Gaussian with learned variance, usually in a 60-dimensional latent space. There are no latent labels; it learns through action-reconstruction gradients propagated through the decoder.

Decoder: \(\pi_\theta(a_t\mid s_t,z_t)\) takes the actual current state and latent. It is a three-layer MLP with 1,024 hidden units per layer and outputs a Gaussian action distribution with fixed standard deviation 0.1; actions are normalized to \([-1,1]\).

The joint objective combines action log-likelihood with a weighted AR(1) KL regularizer. Experiments normally use \(\alpha=0.95\), and the best full-compression setting is 100-rollout behavioral cloning with \(\beta=0.1\). Training uses reparameterized sampling and Adam at \(10^{-4}\); the 100-rollout models use minibatches of 512 subsequences of length 30.

LFPC computes \(J_t^E=\partial\mu_E/\partial s\) at nominal points and labels a perturbed state \(s_t^\star+\delta s_t\) with \(a_t^\star+J_t^E\delta s_t\). Training executes no student rollouts and does not explicitly compute \(J_t^S\). Its minibatch contains 32 subsequences of length 30, with five perturbed state sequences generated per subsequence.

Stage roles: NPMP has no encoder during expert training or data collection; encoder and decoder are jointly updated during offline distillation; both are frozen for one-shot imitation, where the encoder emits one \(z_t\) per six-frame reference window; in go-to-target, variable-speed, and visual obstacle tasks, the encoder is unused and a high-level policy trained with SVG(0)+Retrace directly outputs \(z_t\) for the pretrained decoder.

Key result and boundary: for held-out clips whose one-shot performance is below 50% of the expert, directly optimizing the latent sequence raises median relative expert performance from 43% to 78%, indicating that some failures lie in the encoder while residual errors expose decoder undertraining on rare behaviors.

zh.title: Accelerating trajectory optimization with Sobolev-trained diffusion policies
zh.authors: Théotime Le Hellard, Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack, Quentin Le Lidec, Justin Carpentier
zh.institutions: Inria; 法国巴黎高等师范学院计算机科学系（DI ENS），PSL Research University; 纽约大学 Courant Institute
zh.takeaway: 用 ProxDDP 的局部反馈 Jacobian 监督 diffusion，让更少的优化轨迹产生更好的 TO warm start。
zh.mainContent: 论文用 ProxDDP 的局部反馈 Jacobian 为 trajectory-chunk diffusion 增加一阶监督，提高少量已求解轨迹下的 warm-start 质量。新任务先由生成模型给出初始轨迹，再由 ProxDDP 精修，结合摊销生成与逐实例优化。
innovations: 将 ProxDDP backward pass 得到的局部 feedback gain \(K_t=\partial u_t/\partial x_t\) 与可微动力学组合并向未来传播，构造整段 clean chunk 的一阶标签 \(G=\partial\tau_0/\partial x_{\mathrm{hist}}\)，从而让每条已求解轨迹同时提供函数值和局部反馈规律。
在 DDPM 的 clean-chunk MSE 上加入随机投影的 Sobolev loss：对随机输出方向 \(v\) 比较 \(v^\top G\) 与网络 clean estimate 对历史状态的向量—Jacobian 乘积，并把同一 full-process derivative target 施加到随机抽取的单个 denoising step。
提出 policy warm-start 与 TO refine 的交替闭环：插值初值和当前 policy 初值分别运行 ProxDDP，只接纳已收敛解并选择代价较低者，再用新轨迹和一阶标签继续训练 policy。
创新边界：Sobolev/Jacobian matching、DDP feedback gain、DDPM conditional U-Net、inpainting 和 DAgger-like 数据聚合思想均为已有组件；本文真正新增的是它们面向 trajectory-chunk diffusion warm-start 的具体一阶接口与 outer-loop 组合。
implementation: OCP 给定任务参数 \(\xi\)、已知可微动力学、代价与约束；ProxDDP 更新的是当前实例的数值轨迹 \(X,U\)，收敛后同时输出 \(K_t\)。由 \(F_t^{\mathrm{cl}}=f_{x,t}+f_{u,t}K_t\) 及链式传播得到 chunk Jacobian \(G\)；这些都是冻结的监督标签，不是可训练网络。

一次 diffusion 更新从 solver 轨迹切出 clean chunk \(\tau_0\)，随机采样噪声等级 \(k\) 与高斯噪声得到 \(\tau_k\)，conditional U-Net 输入 \(\tau_k,k,\xi,o_{\mathrm{hist}}\) 并直接预测 clean chunk。总损失由 clean-chunk MSE 与随机投影的一阶 Jacobian MSE 构成，只更新 U-Net 参数 \(\theta\)；因为还要对输入梯度再求参数梯度，训练涉及 mixed second-order autodiff。
diffusion 不是“一阶监督本身”，而是被零阶轨迹标签与一阶 Jacobian 标签联合训练的生成模型；部署时它仍输出未来 trajectory/action chunk，并不会显式输出 Jacobian，也不再需要 \(K_t\)、\(G\) 或 Sobolev loss。

默认实现使用 PyTorch conditional U-Net，hidden dimensions 为 [24, 24, 32, 32]、约 300k 参数；采用 square-cosine DDPM scheduler，固定 \(K=5\) 个 diffusion steps，默认 \(T_h=32\)、\(T_o=1\)、\(T_a=31\)，随机投影数 \(n_{\mathrm{proj}}=1\)。Sob+Diff 每个 epoch 约为普通 Diff 的 2 倍训练时间。
推理从高斯噪声 chunk 开始做完整反向去噪，每一步用 inpainting 固定已知历史，只执行生成 chunk 的前 \(T_a\) 个未来动作后重新规划。若生成变量就是控制 \(u_t\) 则直接使用；UR5 等 state-control 设置需经 RNEA/inverse mapping 得到力矩。
训练 outer loop 对插值初值与 policy 初值各运行一次 ProxDDP，若两者都未在 \(n_{\max}=1000\) 次内收敛便丢弃该任务实例，否则选择代价较低的收敛解；作者默认每轮清空数据 buffer，但保留并继续更新同一组网络参数。该过程没有 reward、critic、advantage 或 PPO，不属于 RL。

实验覆盖单/双倒立摆、四种 UR5 目标到达变体及含 0、1、3、9 个固定柱障碍的 quadrotor，共 3 类任务、8 个变体；结果以 5 个随机种子和每个种子 50 个测试实例评估。作者报告 Sob+Diff 通常比无一阶项的 Diff 少用 5–10 倍轨迹，并使 TO refinement 的 solver-only 时间缩短约 2×–20×；但在双摆的近 20× solver 加速设置中，加入 diffusion rollout 后的端到端时间并不一定更快。

en.title: Accelerating trajectory optimization with Sobolev-trained diffusion policies
en.authors: Théotime Le Hellard, Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack, Quentin Le Lidec, Justin Carpentier
en.institutions: Inria; Département d’Informatique de l’École normale supérieure, PSL Research University, France; Courant Institute, New York University, USA
en.takeaway: Supervises diffusion with ProxDDP feedback Jacobians so fewer optimized trajectories yield better trajectory-optimization warm starts.
en.mainContent: The method supervises trajectory-chunk diffusion with ProxDDP feedback Jacobians to improve warm starts from a small solved-trajectory set. New tasks receive generated initial trajectories followed by ProxDDP refinement, combining amortized generation with instance-specific optimization.
innovations: It combines the local feedback gains \(K_t=\partial u_t/\partial x_t\) produced by the ProxDDP backward pass with differentiable dynamics and propagates them forward to construct a first-order label \(G=\partial\tau_0/\partial x_{\mathrm{hist}}\) for an entire clean chunk, so each solved trajectory provides both function values and a local feedback law.

It augments DDPM clean-chunk MSE with a stochastic-projection Sobolev loss: for a random output direction \(v\), it matches \(v^\top G\) to the vector-Jacobian product of the network's clean estimate with respect to state history, applying the same full-process derivative target to a randomly sampled individual denoising step.

It proposes an alternating policy-warm-start and TO-refinement loop: ProxDDP is run from both interpolation and current-policy initializations, only converged solutions are admitted, the lower-cost solution is retained, and the policy is retrained on the resulting trajectories and derivative labels.

Novelty boundary: Sobolev/Jacobian matching, DDP feedback gains, conditional DDPM U-Nets, inpainting, and DAgger-like aggregation are inherited components; the contribution is their specific first-order interface and outer-loop integration for trajectory-chunk diffusion warm starts.
implementation: An OCP supplies task parameters \(\xi\), known differentiable dynamics, costs, and constraints. ProxDDP updates the instance-specific numerical trajectories \(X,U\) and returns \(K_t\) after convergence; \(F_t^{\mathrm{cl}}=f_{x,t}+f_{u,t}K_t\) and chain propagation yield the chunk Jacobian \(G\). These quantities are fixed supervision labels, not trainable networks.

For one diffusion update, a clean chunk \(\tau_0\) is cut from a solver trajectory, a noise level \(k\) and Gaussian noise are sampled to obtain \(\tau_k\), and a conditional U-Net receives \(\tau_k,k,\xi,o_{\mathrm{hist}}\) and directly predicts the clean chunk. The loss combines clean-chunk MSE with stochastic-projection Jacobian MSE and updates only U-Net parameters \(\theta\); differentiating an input gradient with respect to parameters requires mixed second-order autodiff.

The diffusion model is not itself the 'first-order supervision'; it is a generator jointly trained with zero-order trajectory labels and first-order Jacobian labels. At deployment it still outputs a future trajectory/action chunk rather than an explicit Jacobian, and \(K_t\), \(G\), and the Sobolev loss are no longer needed.

The default implementation uses a PyTorch conditional U-Net with hidden dimensions [24, 24, 32, 32] and about 300k parameters, a square-cosine DDPM scheduler, a fixed \(K=5\) diffusion steps, default \(T_h=32\), \(T_o=1\), and \(T_a=31\), and \(n_{\mathrm{proj}}=1\) stochastic projection. One Sob+Diff epoch takes roughly twice the training time of one Diff epoch.

Inference starts from a Gaussian-noise chunk and runs the full reverse denoising chain, inpainting known history at every step, then executes the first \(T_a\) future actions before replanning. If the generated variable is \(u_t\), it is used directly; state-control settings such as UR5 require RNEA or another inverse mapping to obtain torques, but the paper does not fully specify the discrete mapping from predicted states or velocities to inverse-dynamics inputs.

The outer loop runs ProxDDP once from an interpolation initialization and once from a policy initialization. If neither converges within \(n_{\max}=1000\) iterations, the task instance is discarded; otherwise the lower-cost converged result is retained. The authors reset the data buffer by default between outer iterations but keep updating the same network parameters. There is no reward, critic, advantage, or PPO update, so this is not RL.

Experiments cover single and double inverted pendulums, four UR5 reaching variants, and quadrotor tasks with 0, 1, 3, or 9 fixed column obstacles, totaling three task families and eight variants; evaluation uses five random seeds and 50 test instances per seed. The authors report that Sob+Diff usually needs 5-10 times fewer trajectories than Diff without the first-order term and reduces TO-refinement solver-only time by about 2x-20x, although end-to-end time need not improve in the double-pendulum setting with nearly 20x solver acceleration once diffusion rollout time is included.

Evidence boundary: all experiments fix \(K=5\) and sweep prediction/action horizons and replanning frequency, so they do not directly verify 'fewer denoising steps.' Equation (11) matches the clean-estimate Jacobian at one denoising step rather than the exact final Jacobian of the full reverse sampler. The paper also lacks real-robot, contact-rich, model-mismatch, controlled-perturbation recovery, and quantitative constraint-violation evaluations.

zh.title: Neural Predictor-Corrector: Solving Homotopy Problems with Reinforcement Learning
zh.authors: Jiayao Mai, Bangyan Liao, Zhenjun Zhao, Yingping Zeng, Haoang Li, Javier Civera, Tailin Wu, Yi Zhou, Peidong Liu
zh.institutions: 湖南大学; 西湖大学; 萨拉戈萨大学; 香港科技大学（广州）
zh.takeaway: 用 RL 根据求解状态调度同伦步长和校正器精度，提升 Predictor–Corrector 数值求解效率。
zh.mainContent: NPC 为 Predictor–Corrector 同伦求解器学习一个 RL 调度策略，根据求解状态选择步长与 Corrector 的停止精度或迭代预算。原数值求解器更新解变量，策略调整计算资源，在效率与解质量之间形成自适应调度。
innovations: 从统一视角指出 GNC 鲁棒优化、Gaussian Homotopy 全局优化、Homotopy Continuation 多项式求根和 Annealed Langevin Dynamics 采样都可抽象为外层 Predictor 与内层 Corrector；这主要是概念与接口层面的系统化，而不是提出 PC 本身。
把手工步长与终止规则改写为序列决策问题，同时学习外层 Homotopy 步长和内层 Corrector 终止阈值或最大更新次数，在精度、稳定性与计算成本之间自适应权衡。
采用按问题类进行的 amortized RL training：在随机化实例分布上一次离线训练，随后直接用于同类未见实例；实验展示了跨实例迁移。
implementation: 基本闭环为 \(H(\mathbf{x},0)=f(\mathbf{x})\) 到 \(H(\mathbf{x},1)=g(\mathbf{x})\)：Predictor 先令 \(t_n=t_{n-1}+\Delta t_n\) 并预测新 level 的解初值，Corrector 再迭代修正，使结果回到当前 level 的解轨迹附近。
NPC 状态由当前或上一步 Homotopy level、Corrector 达到的 tolerance、迭代次数以及 convergence velocity 构成；优化与求根任务用目标量的相对变化描述收敛速度，采样任务使用 KSD 等统计距离的变化。

动作包含 Predictor 步长 \(\Delta t_n\) 和 Corrector termination。后者可以是收敛阈值 \(\epsilon_n\)，也可以是最大更新次数 \(i_n^{\max}\)；其具体物理量由任务决定，例如多项式 HC 的 Newton Corrector 在 \(\lVert\Delta\mathbf{x}\rVert<\epsilon_n\) 时停止，因此不能统一理解为 \(\lVert H\rVert\) 的残差阈值。
奖励为逐步精度项与终局效率项的加权和：\(R=\lambda_1\sum_t r_t^{\mathrm{acc}}+\lambda_2(T_{\max}-T)\)，其中 \(T\) 是整条路径的 Corrector 总迭代次数；没有最优步长或 tolerance 的监督标签，PPO 根据累计回报学习二者的权衡。
策略与价值网络均为两层 MLP，每个隐藏层 16 个单元并使用 ReLU；训练采用 Stable Baselines3 的 PPO，其余 PPO 超参数使用库默认值。论文报告的实验通常取 50 次独立试验的平均值。
四种实例化分别为：GNC 中更新非凸程度并用 Gauss–Newton 或 LM 校正；Gaussian Homotopy 中逐步减小平滑并优化当前目标；多项式 HC 使用 Padé predictor 与 Newton corrector；ALD 中调度中间分布并以 Langevin dynamics 作为 Corrector。NPC 只调度这些已有模块，不替代其数值更新。
在 GNC 点云配准实验中，策略只在 Aquarius 序列上训练；论文报告其在 bunny、cube、dragon 等未见序列上相对 Classic GNC 减少约 70%–80% 的迭代和 80%–90% 的运行时间，同时保持相近的旋转与平移误差。其他实验分别在随机化 Ackley、四视图三角化多项式和 10-mode GMM 上训练，再测试同类或相关未见问题。
主要限制是奖励尺度仍需依据问题及噪声水平手工调整；不合适的逐步奖励与终局奖励比例会诱导短视策略甚至训练失败。部署虽无需针对每个新实例重新训练策略，但目标实例的 PC/Homotopy 求解过程并未被取消。

en.title: Neural Predictor-Corrector: Solving Homotopy Problems with Reinforcement Learning
en.authors: Jiayao Mai, Bangyan Liao, Zhenjun Zhao, Yingping Zeng, Haoang Li, Javier Civera, Tailin Wu, Yi Zhou, Peidong Liu
en.institutions: Hunan University; Westlake University; University of Zaragoza; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
en.takeaway: Uses RL to schedule homotopy step size and corrector precision from solver state, improving predictor–corrector efficiency.
en.mainContent: NPC learns an RL scheduler for predictor–corrector homotopy solvers, selecting step size and corrector tolerance or iteration budget from solver state. The numerical solver updates the solution while the policy allocates computation to balance efficiency and accuracy.
innovations: It systematizes GNC robust optimization, Gaussian Homotopy global optimization, Homotopy Continuation polynomial root-finding, and Annealed Langevin Dynamics sampling under a shared outer-predictor/inner-corrector abstraction; this is primarily a conceptual and interface-level unification, not the invention of PC itself.

It recasts hand-designed step-size and termination heuristics as a sequential decision problem and jointly learns the outer homotopy step and the inner corrector threshold or maximum update count, adapting the accuracy–stability–cost trade-off.

It uses problem-class-specific amortized RL training: one offline policy is learned on a randomized instance distribution and then transferred to unseen instances from the same class. The experiments show cross-instance transfer, not a single shared policy that directly spans all four homotopy families.
implementation: The core loop deforms \(H(\mathbf{x},0)=f(\mathbf{x})\) into \(H(\mathbf{x},1)=g(\mathbf{x})\): the predictor first sets \(t_n=t_{n-1}+\Delta t_n\) and estimates an initial solution at the new level, and the corrector iteratively refines it toward the solution trajectory at that level.

The NPC state contains the current or previous homotopy level, attained corrector tolerance, iteration count, and convergence velocity. Optimization and root-finding use relative change in an objective-related quantity, while sampling uses changes in a statistical distance such as KSD.

The action contains the predictor step \(\Delta t_n\) and corrector termination. The latter may be a convergence threshold \(\epsilon_n\) or a maximum update count \(i_n^{\max}\), and its concrete meaning is task-dependent. For polynomial HC, for example, the Newton corrector stops when \(\lVert\Delta\mathbf{x}\rVert<\epsilon_n\), so \(\epsilon_n\) should not be universally interpreted as a threshold on the residual \(\lVert H\rVert\).

The reward combines step-wise accuracy with a terminal efficiency bonus: \(R=\lambda_1\sum_t r_t^{\mathrm{acc}}+\lambda_2(T_{\max}-T)\), where \(T\) is the total number of corrector iterations along the path. There are no supervised labels for the optimal step or tolerance; PPO learns their trade-off from cumulative return.

Both policy and value functions are two-layer MLPs with 16 hidden units per layer and ReLU activations. Training uses Stable Baselines3 PPO, with the remaining PPO hyperparameters set to the library defaults. Reported experiments generally average 50 independent trials.

The four instantiations are: GNC schedules non-convexity and uses Gauss–Newton or LM correction; Gaussian Homotopy progressively removes smoothing and optimizes the current objective; polynomial HC combines a Padé predictor with a Newton corrector; and ALD schedules intermediate distributions with Langevin dynamics as the corrector. NPC schedules these existing modules rather than replacing their numerical updates.

For GNC point-cloud registration, the policy is trained only on the Aquarius sequence. On unseen bunny, cube, and dragon sequences, the paper reports roughly 70%–80% fewer iterations and 80%–90% lower runtime than Classic GNC while retaining similar rotation and translation errors. The other agents are trained respectively on randomized Ackley instances, four-view triangulation polynomials, and a randomized 10-mode GMM before evaluation on unseen related problems.

The main reported limitation is that reward scales still require manual adjustment according to the problem and noise level; a poor balance between step-wise and terminal rewards can induce myopic behavior or training failure. Deployment avoids retraining on each new instance, but it does not eliminate per-instance PC/homotopy numerical solving.

zh.title: VPIES: Variational Privileged Information Encoder as Scaffold for Legged Locomotion Learning
zh.authors: Yubiao Ma, Han Yu, Kai Guo, Boyang Xing, Xuemei Ren, Dongdong Zheng
zh.institutions: School of Automation, Beijing Institute of Technology；Humanoid Robotics (Shanghai) Company, Ltd.；School of Mechanical Engineering, Shandong University
zh.takeaway: 训练时以变分 latent 提供特权支架，再用性能门控 KL 逐步撤除，让双时间尺度本体历史接管控制。
zh.mainContent: VPIES 在 PPO 训练中把特权状态压缩成 12 维随机 latent，与 0.1 秒和 1.0 秒本体历史共同输入 actor。性能门控的 KL 逐步撤除该支架，部署将 latent 设为零并使用本体历史控制。地形解码实验中，长历史特征的可解码率从 31.4% 升至 78.5%，展示历史分支接管环境信息。
innovations: 核心方法创新是把 privileged information 当作可撤除的训练期 scaffold，而不是训练一个 privileged teacher 再蒸馏 student。编码器定义 \(q_\phi(z\mid x)\)，PPO 梯度经重参数化的 \(z\) 进入编码器，使它早期保留对控制有用的信息；同时利用 \(I_\phi(X;Z)\leq\mathbb E_x[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q_\phi(z\mid x)\Vert p(z))]\) 的上界关系，通过 KL 逐渐削弱 latent 对特权输入的依赖。

Scaffold-KL 不只按迭代数退火，而是在同一 PPO minibatch 上计算 \(\Delta J=\mathbb E_t[\hat A_t(\log\pi_\theta(a_t\mid o_t,z=0)-\log\pi_\theta(a_t\mid o_t,z^{(q)}))]\)。若换成部署 latent 后降低好动作概率或提高坏动作概率，则 \(\Delta J<0\)，算法减小 \(\beta\) 暂缓撤除支架；反之增大 \(\beta\)。这是性能感知的 KL 权重调节，但仍是固定状态动作样本上的一阶局部代理。
双时间尺度本体历史编码器把 5 帧短窗和 50 帧长窗并行送入同一 actor：短窗用于快速接触与扰动反应，长窗用于步态周期、地形效应和相位一致性。它不回归显式环境参数，也不把历史 latent 监督对齐到 privileged latent；历史分支主要靠 PPO 回报学习。
论文不仅报告最终回报，还用 linear probing 和长历史 masking 检查信息交接：Phase I 的地形信息主要可从 \(Z\) 解码，Phase II 则主要可从 \(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}\) 解码；遮蔽长历史后接触序列和相位时序受到破坏。该证据支持功能性接管。
线性 probing 与长历史 masking 检查信息交接：地形信息主要可从 Phase I 的 scaffold latent 解码，并在 Phase II 转向长历史特征；遮蔽长历史后接触顺序和相位时序受影响。
implementation: 1. 输入从仿真器开始。完整训练状态写为 \(s_t=(o_t,x_t)\)：部署可用观测 \(o_t=[c_t,\omega_t,g_t,q_t,\dot q_t,a_{t-1}]\)，依次包含速度指令、基座角速度、重力投影、关节角、关节速度和上一动作；训练期特权状态 \(x_t=[d_t,h_t]\)，其中基座外部扰动力 \(d_t\in\mathbb R^3\)，局部离散高程图 \(h_t\in\mathbb R^{187}\)，所以特权输入共 190 维。真实基座线速度不在 actor 的当前观测中。

2. 同一段本体观测历史进入两个并行编码器。控制频率为 50 Hz；短窗 \(W_s=5\) 覆盖 0.1 s，经 MLP [128, 64] 得到 \(h_t^{\mathrm{short}}\)；长窗 \(W_l=50\) 覆盖 1.0 s，经三层 32-channel causal Conv1d（kernel [8,5,5]，stride [4,1,1]）、flatten 和线性投影得到 \(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}\)。前者保留足端接触等高频瞬态，后者聚合至少一个步态周期内的相位与地形线索，两者随后共同进入 actor。

3. 特权通道与历史通道并行。190 维 \(x_t\) 先经过 scaffold shared MLP [128, 64]，再由均值头和尺度头 [32, 12] 定义 12 维后验 \(q_\phi(z_t\mid x_t)=\mathcal N(\mu_t,\operatorname{diag}(\sigma_t^2))\)，通过 \(z_t=\mu_t+\sigma_t\odot\epsilon_t,\ \epsilon_t\sim\mathcal N(0,I)\) 采样。

4. actor MLP [512, 256, 128] 接收 \([h_t^{\mathrm{short}},h_t^{\mathrm{long}},z_t,o_t,\hat v_t]\) 并输出动作偏置 \(a_t\)；期望关节角为 \(\theta_{\mathrm{des}}=\theta_{\mathrm{ref}}+a_t\)，再交给低层关节 PD。四足实验的 PD 增益为 \(k_p=40.0\)、\(k_d=0.75\)。simulator-only critic MLP [512, 256, 128] 直接使用完整状态 \([o_t,x_t]\) 估计价值，因此 actor 的特权通道会被撤除，但 critic 在训练期始终保留 asymmetric privileged access。

5. 一次 rollout 中，策略用带特权采样 \(z_t\) 的 actor 产生动作、环境返回奖励，再由 GAE 计算 \(\hat A_t\) 和 return。clipped PPO objective 更新 actor、短历史编码器和长历史编码器；因为 \(z_t\) 使用重参数化，policy gradient 也会进入 scaffold encoder，使它学习把有助于提高回报的地形和扰动信息写入 \(z_t\)。value MSE 单独更新 critic；这不是 action imitation，也不存在独立 teacher/student 两套 rollout。

6. 长历史特征还送入 velocity estimator MLP [128, 64, 32]，得到 \(\hat v_t=f_V(h_t^{\mathrm{long}})\)，再反馈给 actor。训练标签是仿真器的真实基座线速度 \(v_t\)，损失为 \(L^{\mathrm{vel}}=\|f_V(\operatorname{sg}(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}))-v_t\|_2^2\)。stop-gradient 表示该辅助损失只更新速度头，不更新长历史编码器；长历史表示本身主要仍由 PPO 塑造，因此 \(\hat v_t\) 是训练分布下从本体历史学习出的估计，并非任何状态下都严格可观测的解析速度。

7. scaffold encoder 同时受到 PPO 与 KL 两股梯度。KL 项为 \(L^{\mathrm{KL}}=\beta(k)\mathbb E_x[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q_\phi(z\mid x)\Vert\mathcal N(0,I))]\)：PPO 希望 \(z\) 对控制有用，KL 则推动其分布逐渐不再随 \(x\) 改变。这里不是把每个采样值都压成零，而是把条件后验压向与输入无关的标准正态。
