8. 每个 PPO iteration 后，算法在同一批 \((o_t,x_t,a_t,\hat A_t)\) 上将 posterior sample \(z^{(q)}\) 临时替换为部署值 \(z^{(p)}=0\)，比较同一动作的优势加权 log-probability，并结合 KL 目标更新 \(\beta\)：\(\Delta\beta_J=\eta_J\tanh(\Delta J/s)\)，\(\Delta\beta_{\mathrm{KL}}=\eta_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{KL}_{\mathrm{avg}}-\tau_{\mathrm{KL}}[k])\)，\(\tau_{\mathrm{KL}}[k]=\tau_0e^{-k/\kappa}\)，\(\beta_{k+1}=\operatorname{clip}(\beta_k+\Delta\beta_J+\Delta\beta_{\mathrm{KL}},\beta_{\min},\beta_{\max})\)。超参数为 \(\eta_J=10^{-3}\)、\(s=5\times10^{-2}\)、\(\eta_{\mathrm{KL}}=5\times10^{-4}\)、\(\tau_0=5.5\)、\(\kappa=600\)（四足）/2000（人形）、\(\beta_{\min}=0.01\)、\(\beta_{\max}=0.5\)、\(\beta_0=0.01\)。

9. 部署时删除 scaffold encoder 和 simulator-only critic，不从历史中重新预测 \(z_t\)，而是固定 \(z_t=0\)。最终前向为 \(a_t\sim\pi_\theta(a\mid[h_t^{\mathrm{short}},h_t^{\mathrm{long}},0,o_t,\hat v_t])\)，所以保留的模块是当前观测处理、短/长历史编码器、速度估计器和 actor；训练与部署的 actor 输入维度保持不变。

10. 训练在 Isaac Gym 中使用 4096 个并行环境和单张 NVIDIA RTX 4090，PPO、reward、domain randomization 主要沿用既有 locomotion 配置。机制证据来自 Table III：800 iteration 时 \(Z\) 与长历史的地形分类准确率分别为 86.5%/31.4%，2000 iteration 时变为 18.4%/78.5%，而恒定 \(Z=0\) 的基线为 20.9%；说明 KL 退火后 \(Z\) 接近无信息部署输入，地形结构则更多出现在长历史中。

11. OOD 随机推力实验在速度指令范围 \([-1,1]\)、\([-2,2]\)、\([-3,3]\) m/s 下得到 99.1%/86.4%/70.8% 存活率；对应 Student 为 94.2%/66.2%/49.5%，HIM 为 98.3%/71.6%/51.6%，privileged Teacher 为 99.2%/83.8%/69.7%。Go2 真机在 grassland、pebble road、earthen slope、15 cm stairs、20 cm stairs、obstacle course 上分别达到 100%/100%/100%/100%/80%/80%；G1 仅给出本体感知爬楼梯的定性序列，没有报告统计成功率。
性能门控在当前 privileged rollout 上比较动作偏好变化，以此调节 KL 强度。该代理使用同一批状态估计支架撤除的局部影响。

en.title: VPIES: Variational Privileged Information Encoder as Scaffold for Legged Locomotion Learning
en.authors: Yubiao Ma, Han Yu, Kai Guo, Boyang Xing, Xuemei Ren, Dongdong Zheng
en.institutions: School of Automation, Beijing Institute of Technology; Humanoid Robotics (Shanghai) Company, Ltd.; School of Mechanical Engineering, Shandong University
en.takeaway: Provides a variational privileged scaffold during training and withdraws it through performance-gated KL so dual-timescale proprioceptive history takes over control.
en.mainContent: VPIES compresses privileged state into a 12-dimensional random latent alongside 0.1- and 1.0-second proprioceptive histories during PPO. Performance-gated KL withdraws the scaffold; deployment sets the latent to zero and controls from history. Terrain decoding from long-history features rises from 31.4% to 78.5%, illustrating transfer of environmental information to that branch.
innovations: The central method contribution is to treat privileged information as a removable training-time scaffold rather than to train a privileged teacher and distill a student. The encoder defines \(q_\phi(z\mid x)\), and PPO gradients pass through the reparameterized \(z\) so that it initially retains control-relevant information; meanwhile, the bound \(I_\phi(X;Z)\leq\mathbb E_x[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q_\phi(z\mid x)\Vert p(z))]\) motivates using KL to weaken dependence on privileged inputs.

Scaffold-KL is not purely iteration-based. On the same PPO minibatch it computes \(\Delta J=\mathbb E_t[\hat A_t(\log\pi_\theta(a_t\mid o_t,z=0)-\log\pi_\theta(a_t\mid o_t,z^{(q)}))]\). If replacing the posterior sample with the deployment latent lowers the probability of advantageous actions or raises the probability of disadvantageous actions, \(\Delta J<0\) and \(\beta\) is reduced to delay scaffold removal; otherwise \(\beta\) is increased. This is performance-aware KL control, but it remains a first-order local surrogate on fixed state-action samples.

A dual-timescale proprioceptive history encoder feeds 5-frame and 50-frame windows to the same actor in parallel: the short path handles rapid contact and disturbance reactions, and the long path captures gait-cycle, terrain, and phase-consistent structure. It does not regress explicit environment parameters or supervise the history latent to match the privileged latent; the history pathways are shaped primarily by PPO return.

The paper evaluates the intended information handover through linear probing and long-history masking rather than reporting reward alone. Terrain information is mainly decodable from \(Z\) in Phase I and from \(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}\) in Phase II, while masking the long-history feature perturbs contact sequencing and phase timing.

Linear probing and long-history masking examine information handover: terrain information is mainly decodable from scaffold latents in Phase I and long-history features in Phase II; masking the long history perturbs contact sequencing and phase timing.
implementation: 1. The data flow begins at the simulator. The full training state is \(s_t=(o_t,x_t)\): deployable observation \(o_t=[c_t,\omega_t,g_t,q_t,\dot q_t,a_{t-1}]\) contains the velocity command, base angular velocity, projected gravity, joint positions, joint velocities, and previous action; privileged state \(x_t=[d_t,h_t]\) contains base disturbance force \(d_t\in\mathbb R^3\) and a local discretized elevation map \(h_t\in\mathbb R^{187}\), for 190 privileged dimensions. Ground-truth base linear velocity is not part of the actor's current observation.

2. The same proprioceptive history is processed by two parallel encoders at 50 Hz. The short window \(W_s=5\) covers 0.1 s and uses MLP [128, 64] to produce \(h_t^{\mathrm{short}}\); the long window \(W_l=50\) covers 1.0 s and uses three 32-channel causal Conv1d layers (kernels [8,5,5], strides [4,1,1]), flattening, and a linear projection to produce \(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}\). The former preserves high-frequency contact transients and the latter aggregates phase and terrain clues over at least one gait cycle; both are then fed to the actor.

3. The privileged path runs in parallel with the history paths. The 190-dimensional \(x_t\) passes through scaffold shared MLP [128, 64], followed by mean and scale heads [32, 12] defining \(q_\phi(z_t\mid x_t)=\mathcal N(\mu_t,\operatorname{diag}(\sigma_t^2))\); a 12-dimensional sample is obtained as \(z_t=\mu_t+\sigma_t\odot\epsilon_t,\ \epsilon_t\sim\mathcal N(0,I)\). There are no semantic labels for individual latent dimensions.

4. Actor MLP [512, 256, 128] consumes \([h_t^{\mathrm{short}},h_t^{\mathrm{long}},z_t,o_t,\hat v_t]\) and outputs action offset \(a_t\). Desired joint angles are \(\theta_{\mathrm{des}}=\theta_{\mathrm{ref}}+a_t\) and are tracked by low-level joint PD; quadruped gains are \(k_p=40.0\) and \(k_d=0.75\). A simulator-only critic MLP [512, 256, 128] directly uses full state \([o_t,x_t]\), so the actor scaffold is removed but the critic retains asymmetric privileged access throughout training.

5. During each rollout, the actor with sampled privileged \(z_t\) produces actions, the environment returns rewards, and GAE produces \(\hat A_t\) and returns. The clipped PPO objective updates the actor and both temporal encoders; because \(z_t\) is reparameterized, policy gradients also enter the scaffold encoder and teach it to encode terrain and disturbance information that improves return. Value MSE separately updates the critic. There is no action-imitation loss and no separate teacher/student rollout pair.

6. The long-history feature also feeds velocity estimator MLP [128, 64, 32], producing \(\hat v_t=f_V(h_t^{\mathrm{long}})\), which is then supplied to the actor. Its target is simulator ground-truth base linear velocity \(v_t\), with \(L^{\mathrm{vel}}=\|f_V(\operatorname{sg}(h_t^{\mathrm{long}}))-v_t\|_2^2\). Stop-gradient means this auxiliary loss updates only the velocity head, not the long-history encoder; that representation is still shaped mainly by PPO, so \(\hat v_t\) is a learned estimate under the training distribution rather than an analytically observable velocity in every state.

7. The scaffold encoder receives two competing signals. \(L^{\mathrm{KL}}=\beta(k)\mathbb E_x[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q_\phi(z\mid x)\Vert\mathcal N(0,I))]\): PPO encourages \(z\) to be useful for control, while KL makes its distribution progressively independent of \(x\). This does not force every sampled value to zero; it pushes the conditional posterior toward an input-independent standard normal distribution.

8. After each PPO iteration, the algorithm uses the same \((o_t,x_t,a_t,\hat A_t)\) batch and temporarily replaces posterior sample \(z^{(q)}\) by deployment value \(z^{(p)}=0\), comparing advantage-weighted log probabilities of the same action. It combines this signal with KL tracking: \(\Delta\beta_J=\eta_J\tanh(\Delta J/s)\), \(\Delta\beta_{\mathrm{KL}}=\eta_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{KL}_{\mathrm{avg}}-\tau_{\mathrm{KL}}[k])\), \(\tau_{\mathrm{KL}}[k]=\tau_0e^{-k/\kappa}\), and \(\beta_{k+1}=\operatorname{clip}(\beta_k+\Delta\beta_J+\Delta\beta_{\mathrm{KL}},\beta_{\min},\beta_{\max})\). Hyperparameters are \(\eta_J=10^{-3}\), \(s=5\times10^{-2}\), \(\eta_{\mathrm{KL}}=5\times10^{-4}\), \(\tau_0=5.5\), \(\kappa=600\) for the quadruped and 2000 for the humanoid, \(\beta_{\min}=0.01\), \(\beta_{\max}=0.5\), and \(\beta_0=0.01\).

9. At deployment, the scaffold encoder and simulator-only critic are removed; history is not used to predict a replacement \(z_t\), and \(z_t\) is simply fixed to zero. The final forward pass is \(a_t\sim\pi_\theta(a\mid[h_t^{\mathrm{short}},h_t^{\mathrm{long}},0,o_t,\hat v_t])\), retaining current-observation processing, both history encoders, the velocity estimator, and the actor while preserving the actor input dimensionality.

10. Training uses Isaac Gym with 4096 parallel environments on one NVIDIA RTX 4090, while PPO, rewards, and domain randomization largely follow prior locomotion configurations. Table III provides mechanism evidence: at iteration 800, terrain classification from \(Z\) and the long-history feature is 86.5%/31.4%; at iteration 2000 it is 18.4%/78.5%; a constant \(Z=0\) deployment baseline gives 20.9%. Thus, after KL annealing, \(Z\) approaches an uninformative deployment input while terrain structure becomes more decodable from history.

11. Under randomized pushes, survival rates for velocity-command ranges \([-1,1]\), \([-2,2]\), and \([-3,3]\) m/s are 99.1%/86.4%/70.8%; Student gives 94.2%/66.2%/49.5%, HIM 98.3%/71.6%/51.6%, and the privileged Teacher 99.2%/83.8%/69.7%. Go2 hardware reaches 100%/100%/100%/100%/80%/80% on grassland, pebble road, earthen slope, 15 cm stairs, 20 cm stairs, and an obstacle course. G1 provides a qualitative proprioception-only stair-climbing sequence but no statistical success rate.
Performance gating compares action-preference changes on the current privileged rollout to adjust KL strength, estimating the local effect of scaffold withdrawal on the same batch of states.

zh.title: Extreme Parkour with Legged Robots
zh.authors: Xuxin Cheng, Kexin Shi, Ananye Agarwal, Deepak Pathak
zh.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University
zh.takeaway: 先用地形与动力学真值训练跑酷教师，再把动作、地形感知和 obstacle-conditioned heading 一起蒸馏给深度学生。
zh.mainContent: Extreme Parkour 先用 scandots、动力学特权信息与 waypoint heading 训练 PPO 教师，再由学生闭环 DAgger 蒸馏动作和 heading。部署以深度图、本体历史、速度指令和风格开关输出 12 维关节位置目标。Unitree A1 真机展示约 0.5 m 高台、0.8 m 沟隙和倾斜跳台，并提供独立的 handstand 技能。
innovations: 核心创新：把任务命令改造成由 terrain waypoint 生成的 obstacle-conditioned world-frame heading，使教师能够为斜置跳台等障碍学习随几何变化的起跳与转向方向；部署时再从深度预测该 heading。
核心创新：在 Phase 2 同时蒸馏教师动作与 oracle heading，并提出 MTS（mixture of teacher and student）在 heading 预测不可靠时回退 oracle，以缓解随机初始化 heading predictor 引起的 student distribution drift。Table 3 支持混合训练配置有用。
关键辅助设计：world-frame 速度投影奖励抑制绕障或碰撞重试，5 cm edge-clearance penalty 为真机落脚提供几何安全裕度；前者在 NoInner 消融中贡献明显，后者主要改变 edge-contact 统计和真机成功率。
工程组合而非原创组件：scandots teacher 到 depth ConvNet–GRU student、student-rollout DAgger、PPO、terrain curriculum、ROA 和低层 PD 均继承已有工作；本文的系统价值在于将它们与 heading 接口、统一奖励和低频视觉部署接成一个极限跑酷闭环。
implementation: Phase 1 教师 actor 的论文级输入为本体观测 \(\mathbf{x}_t\)、132 个 scandots \(\mathbf{m}_t\)、由 waypoint 计算的目标 heading \(\hat{\mathbf d}_t\)、walking/style flag \(W_t\) 和速度命令 \(v_t^{\mathrm{cmd}}\)。Waypoint 坐标本身不直接输入 actor；edge mask、接触力和完整仿真状态主要用于 reward、termination 或 critic，也不能全部算作教师 actor 输入。

ROA（Regularized Online Adaptation）处理动力学不完全可观测性：训练时 privileged encoder 用仿真环境参数 \(e_t\) 产生 \(z_t^{\mathrm{priv}}\)，history encoder 用最近本体历史 \(x_{t-H+1:t}\) 产生 \(z_t^{\mathrm{hist}}\)。目标 \(\lambda\lVert z_t^{\mathrm{priv}}-\operatorname{sg}(z_t^{\mathrm{hist}})\rVert_2^2+\lVert\operatorname{sg}(z_t^{\mathrm{priv}})-z_t^{\mathrm{hist}}\rVert_2^2\) 一方面约束 privileged latent 不要包含历史无法恢复的信息，另一方面训练 history encoder 模仿它。

ROA 中 PPO reward/advantage 更新 actor、critic 及 privileged 表示；latent imitation loss 直接更新 history encoder。部署只保留 history encoder，根据最新 observation history 每步重新计算 latent；online 指在线推断和适应控制，不是在真机上反向传播或更新权重。ROA 处理质量、质心、摩擦与 motor strength 等动力学变化，不负责 scandots 到 depth 的视觉替换。
Phase 1 每个 policy step 由 actor 输出 12 维归一化 action，仿真器推进并产生下一状态、接触和 reward；PPO 根据 rollout 的 return/advantage 更新 actor 和 critic。训练地形含 tilted ramp、gap、hurdle 与 high step，并用行进距离决定课程升降级。

Phase 2 初始化时冻结 Phase 1 teacher，并用其 actor 参数 deep-copy 初始化 student；Depth ConvNet–GRU 起初未训练。每一步由 student action 真正推进仿真，冻结 teacher 在同一 student-visited state 上读取 scandots 与 oracle heading，给出动作标签；因此这是 on-policy data aggregation 的 DAgger，而不是固定离线 BC 数据集。

Phase 2 有两个监督目标：teacher 的 12 维 action 监督 student action，waypoint oracle yaw 监督 depth network 的 predicted yaw。MTS 只决定 copied actor 此刻接收 predicted heading 还是 oracle heading，并不混合或切换 teacher/student action。公开实现用 action L2 与 yaw L2 联合更新 depth encoder、GRU 和 copied student actor，teacher 与 simulator 不接收梯度。
论文给出的 MTS 判据为预测误差 \(|\hat\theta_t-\theta_t^*|<0.6\) 时使用 predicted heading，否则使用 oracle。公开代码却检查 target yaw 与机器人当前 yaw 的差是否小于 0.6，既不是 prediction error，也没有对应的绝对值；这是论文—代码的核心复现冲突，不能擅自认定哪一版代表最终实验。

真机 D435 深度约为 \(10\pm2\) Hz，裁剪 dead pixels 后降采样到 \(58\times87\)；Jetson NX 上的 depth network 以 10 Hz 输出 terrain latent 与 heading，经 UDP 提供给 50 Hz base actor。训练中固定模拟约 80 ms depth latency 与 16 ms proprioceptive latency。

部署时保留 Depth ConvNet–GRU、student actor、ROA history adaptation 和低层 PD；丢弃 scandots、waypoint/oracle heading、privileged encoder 的真实参数输入、teacher、critic、reward 与仿真器。公开代码把 action 解释为 \(q_t^{\mathrm{des}}=q^{\mathrm{default}}+0.25a_t\)，再由 PD 产生力矩，因此系统是 pixels-to-joint-target，而不是 pixels-to-torque。

[外部官方资料] 公开配置为 53 维 proprioception、132 维 scandots、9 维显式 privileged state、29 维 latent privileged information、10 帧 history 与 12 维 action；base policy 建议训练 10k–15k iterations，vision distillation 建议 5k–10k iterations。代码还显示 scandot MLP 输出 32 维、privileged/history encoder 输出 20 维、GRU hidden size 为 512，但这些实现细节不能自动视为论文最终内部 checkpoint 的完整配置。
真机极限结果证明完整视觉—heading—action—PD 闭环在作者的四类静态障碍上可行；它没有隔离 ROA 的独立贡献，也没有用等 oracle 使用量的随机 gate 或固定 schedule 对照 MTS。每个真机设置仅 5 次试验，且缺少自然场景 OOD、动态障碍、相机失效、安全恢复和完整 torque/thermal 统计。

en.title: Extreme Parkour with Legged Robots
en.authors: Xuxin Cheng, Kexin Shi, Ananye Agarwal, Deepak Pathak
en.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University
en.takeaway: Trains a parkour teacher with terrain and dynamics truth, then distills actions, terrain perception, and obstacle-conditioned headings into a depth student.
en.mainContent: Extreme Parkour trains a PPO teacher with scandots, privileged dynamics, and waypoint headings, then distills actions and headings through student-controlled DAgger. Deployment maps depth, proprioceptive history, velocity commands, and a style flag to 12 joint-position targets. Unitree A1 demonstrations include roughly 0.5 m steps, 0.8 m gaps, tilted ramps, and a separate handstand skill.
innovations: Core innovation: reformulate the task command as an obstacle-conditioned world-frame heading generated from terrain waypoints, enabling the teacher to learn geometry-dependent takeoff and turning directions for cases such as tilted ramps; at deployment this heading is predicted from depth.

Core innovation: jointly distill teacher actions and oracle headings in Phase 2, with MTS (mixture of teacher and student) falling back to the oracle when heading prediction is unreliable to mitigate distribution drift caused by an initially random heading predictor. Table 3 supports the usefulness of mixed training.

Key supporting designs: a world-frame projected-velocity reward discourages detours and collision retries, while a 5 cm edge-clearance penalty creates a geometric foothold margin for transfer. NoInner strongly affects progress, whereas NoClear mainly affects edge-contact statistics and real-world success.

Engineering integration rather than original components: PPO, terrain curricula, scandots-teacher to Depth ConvNet-GRU student distillation, student-rollout DAgger, ROA, and low-level PD are inherited. The system contribution is connecting them to the heading interface, unified rewards, and low-rate visual deployment for extreme parkour.
implementation: The paper-level Phase 1 teacher-actor inputs are proprioception \(\mathbf{x}_t\), 132 scandots \(\mathbf{m}_t\), waypoint-derived target heading \(\hat{\mathbf d}_t\), walking/style flag \(W_t\), and commanded speed \(v_t^{\mathrm{cmd}}\). Waypoint coordinates are not directly fed to the actor; the edge mask, contact forces, and full simulator state are mainly used by rewards, termination, or the critic and should not all be counted as teacher-actor inputs.

ROA (Regularized Online Adaptation) addresses partially observed dynamics. During training, a privileged encoder maps simulator parameters \(e_t\) to \(z_t^{\mathrm{priv}}\), while a history encoder maps recent proprioception \(x_{t-H+1:t}\) to \(z_t^{\mathrm{hist}}\). The objective \(\lambda\lVert z_t^{\mathrm{priv}}-\operatorname{sg}(z_t^{\mathrm{hist}})\rVert_2^2+\lVert\operatorname{sg}(z_t^{\mathrm{priv}})-z_t^{\mathrm{hist}}\rVert_2^2\) both constrains the privileged latent to remain recoverable from history and trains the history encoder to imitate it.

In ROA, PPO rewards and advantages update the actor, critic, and privileged representation, while the latent-imitation term directly trains the history encoder. Deployment retains only the history encoder and recomputes its latent from the latest observation history; online means online inference and adaptive control, not real-robot backpropagation or weight updates. ROA handles dynamics such as mass, center of mass, friction, and motor strength, not the scandots-to-depth visual replacement.

At each Phase 1 policy step, the actor outputs a 12-D normalized action, the simulator produces the next state, contacts, and reward, and PPO updates actor and critic from rollout returns and advantages. Training terrains include tilted ramps, gaps, hurdles, and high steps, with a distance-based terrain curriculum.

Phase 2 freezes the Phase 1 teacher and deep-copies its actor into the student, while the Depth ConvNet-GRU starts untrained. Student actions advance the simulator; at each student-visited state, the frozen teacher reads scandots and the oracle heading to provide an action label. This is student-distribution DAgger rather than behavioral cloning on a fixed offline dataset.

Phase 2 has two supervision targets: the teacher's 12-D action supervises the student action, and waypoint-derived oracle yaw supervises predicted yaw. MTS only chooses whether the copied actor receives predicted or oracle heading; it does not mix or switch teacher and student actions. The released implementation jointly updates the depth encoder, GRU, and copied student actor with action-L2 and yaw-L2 losses, while the teacher and simulator receive no gradients.

The paper defines MTS to use predicted heading when \(|\hat\theta_t-\theta_t^*|<0.6\), otherwise using the oracle. The released code instead tests whether target yaw minus current robot yaw is below 0.6; this is not prediction error and lacks the corresponding absolute value. Reproduction must resolve this paper–code difference in the MTS gate.

The real D435 depth stream runs at approximately \(10\pm2\) Hz and is cropped and downsampled to \(58\times87\). On a Jetson NX, the depth network produces a terrain latent and heading at 10 Hz and sends them over UDP to a 50 Hz base actor. Training models approximately 80 ms depth latency and 16 ms proprioceptive latency.

Deployment retains the Depth ConvNet-GRU, student actor, ROA history adaptation, and low-level PD, while discarding scandots, waypoint/oracle headings, privileged simulator inputs, teacher, critic, rewards, and simulator. The released code interprets actions as \(q_t^{\mathrm{des}}=q^{\mathrm{default}}+0.25a_t\) before PD produces torque, so the system is pixels-to-joint-target rather than pixels-to-torque.

[External official material] The released configuration uses 53-D proprioception, 132 scandots, 9 explicit privileged states, 29 latent privileged variables, a 10-frame history, and 12 actions. The repository recommends 10k-15k iterations for the base policy and 5k-10k for visual distillation; it also shows a 32-D scandot latent, 20-D privileged/history latent, and GRU hidden size 512, but these details do not by themselves prove the exact configuration of the paper's final internal checkpoints.

The extreme real-robot results establish feasibility of the complete vision-heading-action-PD loop on the authors' four static obstacle families. They do not isolate ROA's independent contribution or compare MTS against random or scheduled gates with matched oracle usage. Each real-world setting has only five trials, and the paper lacks systematic natural-scene OOD, dynamic-obstacle, camera-failure, recovery, torque, and thermal evaluations.

zh.title: Privileged Information Dropout in Reinforcement Learning
zh.authors: Pierre-Alexandre Kamienny, Kai Arulkumaran, Feryal Behbahani, Wendelin Boehmer, Shimon Whiteson
zh.institutions: University of Oxford; Imperial College London
zh.takeaway: 让特权信息调节普通观测特征的乘性噪声，以训练期正则化改善部署表征。
zh.mainContent: PI-Dropout 在训练时让特权信息调节普通观测隐藏特征的乘性噪声，用 Information Bottleneck 式正则化改善表征。测试删除特权分支并将噪声方差设为零。论文在 POMDP gridworld 中比较特权信息学习基线。
innovations: 将 Lambert et al. (2018) 在监督学习中提出的 PI-Dropout 机制迁移到强化学习场景，使 privileged information 在训练时作为噪声分布的条件，而不是作为部署期必需输入。
构造训练期使用 PI、执行期直接去除 PI 的结构：PI 分支不直接提供 action 或 Q-value feature，而是控制普通表示上的 multiplicative log-normal noise；测试时将噪声方差设为 0，因此不需要部署 privileged sensor。
通过 auxiliary task、distillation、Naive Dropout 和 standard Information Dropout 等对照，说明在该 gridworld 中收益不能简单归结为一般 dropout regularization。
implementation: 环境由三个相连的 6×6 房间构成；agent 从左房间或中间房间随机位置初始化，必须在 100 步内到达最右侧目标。普通观测 \(x\) 是 5×5 egocentric view；默认 privileged information \(x^*\) 是 full state (FS)，另一种 PI 是包含当前房间并标出正确走廊的 sub-goal (SG)。每执行一步奖励 -0.1，到达目标奖励 +10。

基础 agent 使用 DRQN，即带循环记忆的 Deep Q-Network：网络由两层 convolution、一个 GRU 和两层 fully connected layer 组成，并使用 ReLU。GRU 根据当前局部观测特征和上一时刻 hidden state 累积历史，在这个 POMDP 中形成隐式 belief state；Q head 输出各离散动作的 Q-value。作者也尝试过 A3C 与 PPO，但因为 DRQN 在该环境中表现更好，后续实验以 DRQN 为主。

PI-Dropout 的核心前向为 \(z=h(x;W)\odot\mathrm{Lognormal}(0,h^*(x^*;W^*))\)。普通分支 \(h(x;W)\) 提取部署时可获得观测的 feature；PI 分支 \(h^*(x^*;W^*)\) 不输出 action 或监督标签，而是参数化乘到普通 feature 上的噪声分布。论文说明实践中在 PI 分支后使用 sigmoid，将噪声方差限制在 (0,1)。

Information Bottleneck 的作用是限制表示 \(z\) 对原始输入 \(x\) 保留过多任务无关信息。Information Dropout 通过对隐藏表示加入可学习的乘性噪声实现这种 bottleneck；PI-Dropout 的变化是由更完整的 privileged information \(x^*\) 来条件化噪声强度。直观上，持续受到较大噪声扰动的 representation direction 很难被下游 Q-network 精确依赖，因此训练会倾向于形成对这些扰动更不敏感的表示。
PI 分支参数 \\(W^*\\) 通过噪声重参数化参与 Q-network 的可微计算，与普通观测分支共同训练。

噪声并不是越大越好。Information Bottleneck regularization 倾向于压缩输入信息，而 RL task objective 要求加噪后的表示仍足以预测有用 Q-value；如果噪声过大并破坏关键任务信息，TD/Q-learning 性能会恶化。超参数 \(\beta\) 控制这种 information compression 与 task performance 的权衡，Supplementary Figure 4 显示 full-state PI 对 \(\beta\) 相当敏感，而 sub-goal PI 相对更稳定。
所有模型训练 \(10^4\) episodes，并使用 \(\epsilon\)-greedy exploration；测试时使用 greedy policy，并对左房间和中间房间的所有可能初始位置求平均。Figure 3 报告 5 个随机种子的平均 test return ± 1 standard error。

主要基线包括：完全不用 PI 的 DRQN；利用 PI reconstruction auxiliary loss 的 AUX；由预训练 teacher 接收 \(x^*\)、student 只接收 \(x\) 的 distillation (DIS)；将 multiplicative noise 在前 3000 episodes 内从 0 手工 anneal 到 1 的 Naive Dropout；以及不使用 privileged information 的 standard Information Dropout。直接接收 full state 的 DRQN[FS,∅] 被作为 oracle upper bound。

Figure 3a 中 PI-D[5x5,FS] 明显优于其他 PI 基线，并最接近 full-state oracle。作者进一步观察到只有 PI-Dropout 和 oracle 能从所有初始位置稳定完成任务；其他方法尤其容易从距离目标最远的左侧房间失败。该实验直接支持“PI-Dropout 在这个 POMDP 上提升最终 RL 性能”，但不能单独证明提升来自作者设想的 Information Bottleneck 表征机制。

Figure 3b 用 sub-goal 替代 full state 作为 privileged information，PI-D[5x5,SG] 同样取得较高性能且收敛更快，说明同一 gridworld 中至少两种不同 PI 都能用于条件化 dropout。Standard Information Dropout 的表现与普通 DRQN 接近，因此作者据此认为增益不是仅由普通 dropout regularization 造成。

作者还用 greedy rollout 收集训练后 agent 的 GRU activation，并冻结 RL agent 后训练线性分类器预测真实位置，以检查 hidden state 是否形成更易解码的位置表示。AUX 的准确率为 94.8%，普通 DRQN 为 90.1%，PI-Dropout test-time 为 88.8%；因此“PI-Dropout 因为学到了更准确、更容易线性解码的位置 belief 才获得更好性能”并没有得到实验支持。
Supplementary Figure 5 显示 PI-Dropout 在 train-time、仍使用 PI-conditioned noise 时对精确位置的预测不确定性反而更高，但其 localisation error 保持在正确房间内部。这个结果提示它可能保留了任务更需要的 coarse room information，而不是精确坐标；不过这只是可能解释。
部署时 privileged information 完全不需要：论文明确说明忽略 PI subnetwork，并把 noise variance 手动设为 0，因此最终在线执行只保留普通观测分支、GRU memory 和 Q-value head。

en.title: Privileged Information Dropout in Reinforcement Learning
en.authors: Pierre-Alexandre Kamienny, Kai Arulkumaran, Feryal Behbahani, Wendelin Boehmer, Shimon Whiteson
en.institutions: University of Oxford; Imperial College London
en.takeaway: Uses privileged information to modulate multiplicative noise on ordinary observation features, regularizing deployment representations during training.
en.mainContent: PI-Dropout uses privileged information to set multiplicative noise on ordinary observation features during training, providing information-bottleneck-style regularization. Testing removes the privileged branch and sets noise variance to zero. Experiments compare privileged-information baselines in a POMDP gridworld.
innovations: Adapts the PI-Dropout mechanism of Lambert et al. (2018) from supervised learning to reinforcement learning, using privileged information to condition the training-time noise distribution rather than making it a required deployment-time input.

Provides a structure in which PI can be used during training and removed at execution: the PI branch does not directly provide actions or Q-value features, but controls multiplicative log-normal noise on the regular representation; at test time the variance is set to zero and the PI branch is discarded.

Compares against auxiliary-task, distillation, Naive Dropout, and standard Information Dropout alternatives, showing that the gain in this gridworld cannot be explained by generic dropout regularization alone; the paper does not, however, close the causal mechanism through representation learning or exploration.
implementation: The environment consists of three connected 6×6 rooms. The agent starts from a random position in the left or centre room and must reach the goal within 100 timesteps. The regular input \(x\) is a 5×5 egocentric view; the default privileged input \(x^*\) is the full state (FS), while an alternative PI is a sub-goal (SG) showing the current room and the correct corridor. Each action gives -0.1 reward and reaching the goal gives +10.

The base agent is a DRQN, i.e. a Deep Q-Network with recurrent memory. Its architecture contains two convolutional layers, a GRU, and two fully connected layers with ReLU nonlinearities. The GRU integrates the current local observation features with its previous hidden state and therefore acts as an implicit belief state in the POMDP, while the Q head outputs Q-values for the discrete actions. The authors also experimented with A3C and PPO but selected DRQN because it performed better in this environment.

The core PI-Dropout forward computation is \(z=h(x;W)\odot\mathrm{Lognormal}(0,h^*(x^*;W^*))\). The regular branch \(h(x;W)\) extracts features from observations available at deployment, while the PI branch \(h^*(x^*;W^*)\) does not output an action or a supervised target; it parameterizes the multiplicative noise distribution applied to the regular representation. In practice, a sigmoid after the PI branch restricts the noise variance to (0,1).

The Information Bottleneck motivation is to prevent the latent representation \(z\) from retaining excessive task-irrelevant information about \(x\). Information Dropout implements this idea by injecting learnable multiplicative noise into hidden features, and PI-Dropout changes the conditioning variable so that the richer privileged input \(x^*\) controls the noise strength. A representation direction that is persistently strongly perturbed becomes unreliable for precise downstream dependence, encouraging a less noise-sensitive representation, but the paper does not directly demonstrate that the PI branch identifies and suppresses task-irrelevant features.

There is no ground-truth label for the 'correct' noise scale. The PI-branch parameters \(W^*\) are learnable and enter the differentiable Q-network computation through PI-conditioned noise, so the PI branch is jointly optimized with the regular network.

More noise is not automatically better. The Information Bottleneck regularizer encourages compression, whereas the RL task objective requires the perturbed representation to remain sufficient for useful Q-value learning. Excessive noise can therefore destroy task-relevant information and hurt training. The hyperparameter \(\beta\) controls this compression-versus-task trade-off; Supplementary Figure 4 shows that full-state PI is relatively sensitive to \(\beta\), while sub-goal PI is less sensitive.

All models are trained for \(10^4\) episodes with \(\epsilon\)-greedy exploration. Evaluation uses the greedy policy and averages reward over all possible starting positions in the left and centre rooms. Figure 3 reports mean test return ± 1 standard error over 5 random seeds.

Baselines include a standard DRQN without PI, AUX with PI reconstruction as an auxiliary task, DIS with a pre-trained teacher that observes \(x^*\) and a student that observes only \(x\), Naive Dropout with multiplicative noise manually annealed from 0 to 1 during the first 3000 episodes, and standard Information Dropout without privileged information. DRQN[FS,∅] is used as a full-state oracle upper bound.

In Figure 3a, PI-D[5x5,FS] outperforms the other PI baselines and comes closest to the full-state oracle. The authors further report that only PI-Dropout and the oracle consistently solve the task from every initial position, whereas the alternatives particularly struggle from the leftmost room. This directly supports improved RL performance in this POMDP, but does not by itself establish the proposed Information Bottleneck representation mechanism.

Figure 3b replaces full-state PI with sub-goal PI. PI-D[5x5,SG] also achieves high performance and converges faster, showing that at least two forms of PI can condition the dropout mechanism in the same gridworld. Standard Information Dropout performs similarly to the normal DRQN, which the authors use as evidence that the gain is not merely generic dropout regularization.

For representation analysis, the authors collect GRU activations from greedy rollouts after RL training and train linear classifiers to predict the true agent position. Accuracy is 94.8% for AUX, 90.1% for standard DRQN, and 88.8% for PI-Dropout at test time. Thus the experiments do not support the explanation that PI-Dropout succeeds because it produces a more linearly decodable exact-position belief representation.

Supplementary Figure 5 shows that train-time PI-Dropout, while more uncertain about the exact position, keeps localisation errors within the correct room. This could indicate preservation of coarse task-relevant room information rather than precise coordinates.
The authors also identify improved exploration as an unresolved possible mechanism. Because every agent already uses \(\epsilon\)-greedy exploration.

At deployment, privileged information is not required: the paper explicitly states that the PI subnetwork is ignored and the noise variance is manually set to zero, leaving the regular observation branch, recurrent memory, and Q-value head for execution.

zh.title: Dynamic Policy Learning for Legged Robot with Simplified Model Pretraining and Model-Homotopy-Inspired Transfer
zh.authors: Dongyun Kang, Min-Gyu Kim, Tae-Gyu Song, Hajun Kim, Sehoon Ha, Hae-Won Park
zh.institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Department of Mechanical Engineering; Georgia Institute of Technology, School of Interactive Computing
zh.takeaway: 先在简化 SRB 动力学中学控制，再逐渐恢复腿部质量和惯量，持续微调到全身动力学。
zh.mainContent: MHIT 先在无质量腿的 SRB 环境中用 PPO 学习身体动量、接触力和摆腿控制，再逐步恢复腿部质量与惯量，持续微调同一个策略。逐渐变化的动力学将简化模型预训练连接到全身机器人控制。
innovations: 提出两阶段动态策略学习框架：先用 SRB pretraining 在简化动力学中发现核心 motion pattern，再通过 continuation 式的 Model-Homotopy-Inspired Transfer 将同一策略逐渐适配到 full-body dynamics，避免从零探索和一步式 model gap。
构造显式的动力学 continuation path：使用 \(\lambda\) 线性缩放腿部质量与惯量，同时将 trunk 的质量、惯量和 CoM 从整机 composite properties 逐渐恢复到真实 full-body 参数；由于接触系统的 hybrid nature，该过程并非严格数学意义上的 homotopy。
最终策略不被要求继续模仿或严格跟踪 SRB 轨迹，而是在 full-body 环境中继续通过 RL 优化，因此能够偏离原始 SRB motion，适应腿部惯量等 SRB 中不存在的动力学效应。
保持 SRB 与 full-body 阶段相近的 hybrid action semantics：stance 足输出 GRF，swing 足输出 nominal swing trajectory 上的 residual foot target；进入 full-body 后再通过 Jacobian-transpose 与 task-space PD 将这些动作转换成关节力矩。
implementation: SRB 将机器人建模为一个具有固定 lumped mass 与 inertia 的 floating rigid body，腿无质量，四个足端为 ideal point contacts。状态包含 base/CoM 的位置、姿态、线速度、角速度和四个虚拟足端 Cartesian position；接触足的 ground reaction force \(\mathbf f_i\) 作为动力学控制输入。

动作采用 stance/swing hybrid interface。stance phase 中 policy 输出 GRF \(\mathbf f_i\)，并限制在 friction cone 内；swing phase 中输出 residual foot target \(\Delta\mathbf r_i\)，与预定义 nominal swing trajectory 相加得到最终足端目标。gait、flip 和 wall-assisted maneuver 均具有预定义 contact plan 与 nominal swing trajectory，policy 只学习 residual。

Actor 为 MLP，并使用 PPO 训练。SRB observation 包含 gravity vector、linear/angular velocity、四个足端 local-base-frame position、contact state 与当前 motion phase 的 sine/cosine；其中 linear velocity 与 contact state 是 simulation ground truth privileged information。每次 iteration 用 100 个并行环境收集 4 s rollout，并训练 8 epochs。

MHIT 使用 \(m_{leg}(\lambda)=\lambda m_{leg,full}\) 和 \(I_{leg}(\lambda)=\lambda I_{leg,full}\)；trunk 的 mass、inertia 与 CoM 则在 nominal-pose composite properties 和真实 trunk properties 之间插值。\(\lambda\) 从 0.01 增长到 1.0，持续前 900 iterations，并在靠近目标模型时减小步长；低 \(\lambda\) 下使用更小 timestep 缓解 mass matrix 数值病态。
进入 full-body 后，stance GRF 通过 \(\boldsymbol\tau_i^{stance}=J_i^T\mathbf f_i\) 转换为关节力矩；swing 足通过 task-space PD 跟踪目标再做 Jacobian-transpose 映射，论文给出的增益为 \(K_p=500\)、\(K_d=5\)。

Full-body 阶段使用并行 two-layer MLP estimator 从关节位置、速度、torque command history 及其他非特权观测中预测 base linear velocity 和 contact state；其损失为 \(L_{est}=\lVert\hat{\mathbf v}-\mathbf v\rVert^2+\lVert\hat{\mathbf c}-\mathbf c\rVert^2\)，contact probability 以 0.5 阈值离散化。actor 与 estimator 均为 100 Hz，action conversion / low-level control 为 2 kHz。
wall-assisted backflip 中，MHIT 相比 Imitation Transfer 的 normalized return 高 19.0%，收敛 iteration 为 2240 对 4610；相对 Direct Transfer，其五次训练 normalized-return max-min range 为 0.0042 对 0.2285。

真机使用 Unitree Go1；仿真包含 rotor inertia、sensor/motor-command latency、actuator characteristics，以及 initial pose、friction、trunk inertia、motor strength 和 sensor noise 的 domain randomization。trot 的 forward-velocity/yaw-rate RMSE 为 0.28 m/s 和 0.11 rad/s（直接部署 SRB policy 为 0.53 m/s、0.29 rad/s）；backflip 在 10 次连续试验中成功率 90%。

MHIT、Direct Transfer 与 Imitation Transfer 共享 SRB-pretrained initialization，Figure 5 因此主要比较 pretraining 之后的 transfer efficiency，省略共同的 SRB-pretraining cost；Vanilla RL 从随机 full-body policy 开始，主要说明 SRB initialization 对复杂动作可发现性的帮助，不能单独证明 homotopy mechanism。

en.title: Dynamic Policy Learning for Legged Robot with Simplified Model Pretraining and Model-Homotopy-Inspired Transfer
en.authors: Dongyun Kang, Min-Gyu Kim, Tae-Gyu Song, Hajun Kim, Sehoon Ha, Hae-Won Park
en.institutions: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST); School of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
en.takeaway: Pretrains control in reduced SRB dynamics, then restores leg mass and inertia gradually while fine-tuning toward full-body dynamics.
en.mainContent: MHIT first learns momentum, contact-force, and swing-leg control with PPO in an SRB environment with massless legs, then gradually restores leg mass and inertia while fine-tuning the same policy. Progressive dynamics connect reduced-model pretraining to full-body control.
innovations: A two-stage framework combining SRB pretraining for discovering core motion patterns with continuation-based Model-Homotopy-Inspired Transfer for adapting the same policy to full-body dynamics.

An explicit \(\lambda\)-parameterized continuation path restores leg mass and inertia while interpolating trunk mass, inertia, and CoM; the authors explicitly acknowledge that this hybrid-contact construction is not strict mathematical homotopy.
The final policy continues RL optimization in the full-body environment rather than permanently tracking an SRB reference, allowing adaptation to non-negligible leg inertia.
Shared hybrid action semantics across stages use GRFs for stance legs and residual foot targets for swing legs, later converted to joint torques through Jacobian-transpose mappings and task-space PD.
implementation: The SRB has lumped mass/inertia, massless legs, and four ideal point contacts. Its state includes base/CoM pose and velocities plus virtual-foot positions; contact GRFs \(\mathbf f_i\) are the control inputs.

The MLP actor is trained with PPO. SRB observations include gravity, velocities, local foot positions, contact states, and phase features; true simulation velocity and contact state are privileged during pretraining. Each iteration collects a 4 s rollout from 100 parallel environments and runs eight epochs.

MHIT uses \(m_{leg}(\lambda)=\lambda m_{leg,full}\) and \(I_{leg}(\lambda)=\lambda I_{leg,full}\), while interpolating trunk properties. \(\lambda\) grows from 0.01 to 1.0 over the first 900 transfer iterations, with smaller late steps and a reduced timestep at low \(\lambda\).

In full-body dynamics, stance torques use \(\boldsymbol\tau_i^{stance}=J_i^T\mathbf f_i\); swing feet use task-space PD followed by a Jacobian-transpose mapping, with \(K_p=500\) and \(K_d=5\). A concurrent two-layer estimator replaces privileged base velocity and contact state from proprioceptive histories. Actor and estimator run at 100 Hz; low-level control runs at 2 kHz.

For wall-assisted backflip, MHIT reports 19.0% higher normalized return than Imitation Transfer and converges in 2240 versus 4610 iterations. On Unitree Go1 it reports trot RMSEs of 0.28 m/s forward velocity and 0.11 rad/s yaw rate, and 90% backflip success over 10 consecutive trials.

MHIT, Direct Transfer, and Imitation Transfer share SRB-pretrained initialization, so the transfer plot omits their common pretraining cost; Vanilla RL chiefly establishes the value of SRB initialization for motion discovery rather than isolating the homotopy mechanism.
