zh.title: Contact-Aided Invariant Extended Kalman Filtering for Robot State Estimation
zh.authors: Ross Hartley, Maani Ghaffari, Ryan M. Eustice, Jessy W. Grizzle
zh.institutions: 密歇根大学机器人研究所与工程学院，美国密歇根州安娜堡
zh.takeaway: 把接触辅助惯性状态与 invariant error 配合，利用 log-linear 误差动力学改善状态估计收敛。
zh.mainContent: 论文将接触辅助惯性系统写成 Lie-group 状态，并设计 invariant error，使无 IMU bias 情况下的误差满足与当前估计无关的 log-linear dynamics。该结构改善差初始化条件下的状态估计收敛；加入 IMU bias 时使用扩展的 imperfect InEKF。
innovations: 核心创新：将机体姿态、速度、位置和任意数量的当前接触点共同表示为 \(SE_{N+2}(3)\) 上的单一群状态，并为 IMU/contact 过程模型与前向运动学校正推导 contact-aided right-invariant EKF。
机制创新：证明无 IMU bias 的确定性过程满足 group-affine property，使 invariant error 满足 exact log-linear autonomous dynamics；同时前向运动学测量具有 right-invariant observation form，因此传播矩阵 \(A_t\) 与观测矩阵 \(H_t\) 不依赖当前状态估计。
关键辅助与工程扩展：给出 IMU bias augmentation 的 imperfect InEKF、接触点动态增加与删除、left-/right-invariant 误差之间的 adjoint 变换、world-centric 与 robo-centric 版本、解析离散化以及开源 C++ 实现。
implementation: 在线输入为 IMU 角速度与线加速度、关节编码器角度以及二值接触指示；滤波器输出机体旋转 \(R_t\)、速度 \(v_t\)、位置 \(p_t\)、当前接触点世界坐标 \(d_{i,t}\)、IMU bias 估计和协方差。它没有监督学习或强化学习阶段，也不存在可训练网络参数。

Propagation 使用 strapdown IMU 积分；在零阶保持假设下，离散状态更新为 \(\bar R_{k+1}=\bar R_k\Gamma_0(\bar\omega_k\Delta t)\)、\(\bar v_{k+1}=\bar v_k+\bar R_k\Gamma_1(\bar\omega_k\Delta t)\bar a_k\Delta t+g\Delta t\)，位置用对应的 \(\Gamma_2\) 二重积分项更新。接触点在接触期间被建模为带小过程噪声的近似静止点，以容纳足端滑移。

Correction 使用前向运动学测量 \(h_p(\tilde\alpha_t)=R_t^\top(d_t-p_t)+J_p(\tilde\alpha_t)w_t^\alpha\)。在 world-centric right-invariant 形式中，观测雅可比为与状态估计无关的 \(H_t=[0\;0\;-I\;I]\)，Kalman gain 由 \(K_t=P_tH_t^\top(H_tP_tH_t^\top+\bar N_t)^{-1}\) 得到，随后以 \(\bar X_t^+=\exp(K_t\Pi\bar X_tY_t)\bar X_t\) 左乘修正群状态。
新接触建立时，用 \(\bar d_t=\bar p_t+\bar R_t h_p(\tilde\alpha_t)\) 初始化接触点，并通过显式线性映射扩充 covariance；接触解除时直接边缘化对应状态与协方差行列。因此每个新时间步只需继续递推，不需要重新训练或对整段轨迹做逐实例优化。
加入陀螺仪与加速度计 bias 后，bias 以 Brownian motion 建模并作为 \(\theta_t=[b_t^g;b_t^a]\) 追加到状态。此时传播矩阵重新依赖估计的 \(R_t,v_t,p_t,d_t\)，论文明确称其为 imperfect InEKF；前向运动学 measurement 本身不依赖 bias，但其 innovation 可通过交叉协方差间接修正 bias。

Cassie 平台有 20 DoF、10 个执行器和 14 个关节编码器；VectorNav-100 IMU 以 800 Hz 输出，编码器以 2000 Hz 输出，论文报告滤波器实现可运行在 2000 Hz 以上。仿真与真机均对 QEKF 和 RIEKF 做 100 次同测量、同噪声、同初始协方差的随机初始化比较，初始 Euler angle 取 \([-30^\circ,30^\circ]\)，初始速度取 \([-1,1]\,\mathrm{m/s}\)，RIEKF 对所有可观测状态收敛更快；良好初始化时两者表现接近。
真机精度证据包括：60 s、约 15 m 的 motion-capture 实验中最终位置漂移小于路程的 5%；约 200 m、7 分 45 秒的室外行走中轨迹始终大致保持在人行道上，终点误差为数米量级。

en.title: Contact-Aided Invariant Extended Kalman Filtering for Robot State Estimation
en.authors: Ross Hartley, Maani Ghaffari, Ryan M. Eustice, Jessy W. Grizzle
en.institutions: Robotics Institute and College of Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, MI, USA
en.takeaway: Pairs contact-aided inertial states with invariant errors to improve estimation convergence through log-linear error dynamics.
en.mainContent: The paper formulates contact-aided inertial estimation on a Lie group with invariant errors, yielding estimate-independent log-linear error dynamics in the bias-free case. This structure improves convergence under poor initialization; IMU bias is handled with an extended imperfect InEKF.
innovations: Core innovation: represent base orientation, velocity, position, and an arbitrary number of active contact points as one state on \(SE_{N+2}(3)\), and derive a contact-aided right-invariant EKF for an IMU/contact process model with forward-kinematic corrections.

Mechanistic contribution: prove that the deterministic bias-free process is group-affine, so the invariant error follows exact log-linear autonomous dynamics; the forward-kinematic measurement is also right-invariant, making both \(A_t\) and \(H_t\) independent of the current state estimate.

Key extensions and engineering integration: an imperfect InEKF with IMU-bias augmentation, dynamic contact addition/removal, adjoint conversion between left- and right-invariant errors, world-centric and robo-centric forms, analytical discretization, and an open-source C++ implementation.
implementation: Online inputs are IMU angular velocity and linear acceleration, joint-encoder positions, and binary contact indicators. Outputs are base rotation \(R_t\), velocity \(v_t\), position \(p_t\), world-frame active contact positions \(d_{i,t}\), IMU-bias estimates, and covariance. There is no supervised-learning or reinforcement-learning stage and no trainable neural-network parameter.

Propagation uses strapdown IMU integration. Under zero-order-hold inputs, the discrete updates include \(\bar R_{k+1}=\bar R_k\Gamma_0(\bar\omega_k\Delta t)\) and \(\bar v_{k+1}=\bar v_k+\bar R_k\Gamma_1(\bar\omega_k\Delta t)\bar a_k\Delta t+g\Delta t\), with position using the corresponding \(\Gamma_2\) double-integral term. Contact points are modeled as nearly stationary with small process noise to accommodate slip.

Correction uses the forward-kinematic measurement \(h_p(\tilde\alpha_t)=R_t^\top(d_t-p_t)+J_p(\tilde\alpha_t)w_t^\alpha\). In the world-centric right-invariant form, \(H_t=[0\;0\;-I\;I]\) is independent of the estimate, the gain is \(K_t=P_tH_t^\top(H_tP_tH_t^\top+\bar N_t)^{-1}\), and the group state is corrected by \(\bar X_t^+=\exp(K_t\Pi\bar X_tY_t)\bar X_t\).

When a new contact is created, its mean is initialized as \(\bar d_t=\bar p_t+\bar R_t h_p(\tilde\alpha_t)\) and the covariance is augmented through an explicit linear map. When contact is broken, the corresponding state and covariance rows and columns are marginalized. Each incoming sensor sample therefore advances the recursive filter directly; no retraining or whole-trajectory per-instance optimization is required.

Gyroscope and accelerometer biases are modeled as Brownian motions and appended as \(\theta_t=[b_t^g;b_t^a]\). The resulting propagation matrix again depends on estimated \(R_t,v_t,p_t,d_t\), which the paper explicitly calls an imperfect InEKF. The forward-kinematic measurement itself does not contain the biases, but bias states can still be corrected through cross-covariance.

Cassie has 20 DoF, 10 actuators, and 14 joint encoders. The VectorNav-100 IMU runs at 800 Hz, encoders at 2000 Hz, and the paper reports filter execution above 2000 Hz. Both simulation and hardware compare QEKF and RIEKF over 100 runs with identical measurements, noise, and initial covariance; RIEKF converges faster for all observable states, whereas the two filters are similar under good initialization.

Hardware evidence includes a 60 s, roughly 15 m motion-capture walk with final position drift below 5% of traveled distance, and a roughly 200 m outdoor walk over 7 min 45 s whose estimate remained near the sidewalk and ended within a few meters of the true position.

zh.title: PIE: Parkour with Implicit-Explicit Learning Framework for Legged Robots
zh.authors: Shixin Luo, Songbo Li, Ruiqi Yu, Zhicheng Wang, Jun Wu, Qiuguo Zhu
zh.institutions: Institute of Cyber-Systems and Control, Zhejiang University; State Key Laboratory of Industrial Control Technology, Zhejiang University
zh.takeaway: 联合本体历史和深度图估计速度、足高、地形与下一状态 latent，再由 PPO actor 输出关节目标。
zh.mainContent: PIE 将本体历史与深度图联合编码，预测速度、足端高度、地形 latent 和下一状态 latent。PPO actor 使用这些显式与隐式表征输出关节位置目标，将估计器训练与视觉跑酷控制结合。
innovations: 核心方法是双层 implicit-explicit estimation：一层同时学习 successor-state 的隐式预测与 height map 的显式重建，另一层同时保留压缩 latent 与具有明确物理意义的基座速度、足端离地高度。
将视觉—本体 estimator 与 asymmetric actor-critic 放在同一训练阶段并发优化，避免先训练 privileged teacher、再蒸馏 student 时可能出现的表示替换与信息损失。
通过 10 Hz 低成本深度相机、50 Hz 动作输出和 RK3588 板载推理，在 Lite3 上实现未经真机微调的 zero-shot Sim-to-Real 跑酷。
新颖性边界：estimator-conditioned policy 与 RMA 系列在抽象架构上相似，successor-state reconstruction 明确继承 DreamWaQ；可信贡献是视觉、本体、多头监督和一阶段训练的系统组合。
implementation: 部署前向流为：当前 45 维本体观测 \(o_t=[\omega_t,g_t,c_t,\theta_t,\dot\theta_t,a_{t-1}]^T\)，加 estimator 输出的 \(\hat v_t,\hat h_t^f,z_t^m,z_t\)，进入 actor 得到 12 维动作 \(a_t\)；最终关节目标为 \(\theta_{target}=\theta_{stand}+a_t\)，由低层 PD 跟踪。
Estimator 输入为 \(H_1=10\) 帧本体历史和 \(H_2=2\) 帧深度图历史。深度分支使用 CNN，本体分支使用 MLP，二者进入共享 Transformer 做跨模态融合，再经 GRU 形成时序记忆；\(\hat v_t,\hat h_t^f,z_t\) 进入 successor-state decoder，\(z_t^m\) 进入 height-map decoder。

Estimator 损失为 KL latent regularization 与 \(\hat o_{t+1}\)、height map、速度、foot clearance 的 MSE 之和；标签均由仿真 rollout 提供，部署时不需要。actor 只接收部署可得输入，critic 的特权输入为 \(s_t=[o_t,v_t,m_t]^T\)。论文明确 PPO 更新 actor-critic、回归/重建损失更新 estimator。
奖励包含速度跟踪、姿态、关节加速度/功率、碰撞与动作平滑项；命令范围为线速度 \([0,1.5]\) m/s、yaw rate \([-1.2,1.2]\) rad/s。训练使用 Isaac Gym 4096 环境，RTX 4090 上 10000 iterations 少于 20 小时。
Domain randomization 覆盖 payload、摩擦、CoM、Kp/Kd、motor strength、系统延迟和相机位姿/FOV；课程地形上限为 1 m gap、0.75 m step/hurdle 与 0.25 m stairs。
真机使用 Intel RealSense D435i（10 Hz）、动作输出 50 Hz、Rockchip RK3588 板载图像处理和推理。
Table III 中完整 PIE 的平均终止难度等级为 gap 9.90、stairs 9.86、step 9.81；去掉 height-map reconstruction 后为 9.75、4.25、1.67，去掉 foot-clearance estimation 后为 7.41、7.36、3.09。消融支持模块对性能的贡献，但也同时改变了表示容量和优化约束。

完整 PIE 在相机污染下比去掉 successor-state reconstruction 的版本更稳，支持预测辅助任务与视觉噪声鲁棒性相关。该 decoder 不用于多步 imagined rollout、reward prediction、MPC 或模型内规划，因此是 World Model-inspired predictive representation，而不是完整 World-Model-Based RL。
作者明确局限包括缺少完整 3D 地形理解、不能钻越上方障碍、没有 RGB 语义且只在静态环境训练，因此动态物体可能干扰视觉估计。

en.title: PIE: Parkour with Implicit-Explicit Learning Framework for Legged Robots
en.authors: Shixin Luo, Songbo Li, Ruiqi Yu, Zhicheng Wang, Jun Wu, Qiuguo Zhu
en.institutions: Institute of Cyber-Systems and Control, Zhejiang University; State Key Laboratory of Industrial Control Technology, Zhejiang University
en.takeaway: Combines proprioceptive history and depth to estimate velocity, foot height, terrain, and next-state latents for PPO joint-target control.
en.mainContent: PIE jointly encodes proprioceptive history and depth to predict velocity, foot height, terrain latents, and next-state latents. A PPO actor uses these explicit and implicit features to produce joint-position targets, combining estimator learning with visual parkour.
innovations: Dual-level implicit-explicit estimation combines successor-state prediction with height-map reconstruction and compressed latents with explicit base-velocity and foot-clearance estimates.
The visual-proprioceptive estimator and asymmetric actor-critic are optimized concurrently in one stage, though policy-gradient coupling through the estimator is not specified.
The system demonstrates zero-shot Sim-to-Real parkour on a Lite3 with 10 Hz depth, 50 Hz actions, and onboard RK3588 inference.
The estimator-conditioned abstraction resembles RMA and successor-state reconstruction is inherited from DreamWaQ; the defensible novelty is their system-level combination.
implementation: The 45-D proprioceptive observation and \(\hat v_t,\hat h_t^f,z_t^m,z_t\) feed the actor, which outputs a 12-D action; \(\theta_{target}=\theta_{stand}+a_t\) is tracked by low-level PD.

The estimator uses 10 proprioceptive and 2 depth frames. CNN and MLP encoders feed a shared Transformer and GRU; its direct objective combines KL regularization with MSE reconstruction of successor proprioception, height map, velocity, and foot clearance from simulator labels.
PPO trains actor-critic while regression/reconstruction trains the estimator. The critic receives privileged \(s_t=[o_t,v_t,m_t]^T\).

Training uses 4096 Isaac Gym environments and takes under 20 hours for 10000 iterations on an RTX 4090. Domain randomization includes robot dynamics, delay, and camera pose/FOV. D435i runs at 10 Hz, actions at 50 Hz, and inference runs on RK3588.

Full PIE reaches mean terminated difficulty levels 9.90/9.86/9.81 for gaps/stairs/steps. Successor-state reconstruction improves camera-corruption robustness. The decoder is not used for imagined rollouts, reward prediction, MPC, or planning, making PIE world-model-inspired rather than model-based RL.
Reported limitations are incomplete 3D terrain understanding, no overhead-obstacle traversal or RGB semantics, and static-only training.

zh.title: Architecture Is All You Need: Diversity-Enabled Sweet Spots for Robust Humanoid Locomotion
zh.authors: Blake Werner, Lizhi Yang, Aaron D. Ames
zh.institutions: California Institute of Technology, Mechanical and Civil Engineering (Caltech MCE)
zh.takeaway: 先训练只靠本体感知的稳定反馈，再开放 heightmap 学习地形适应，逐步建立视觉控制。
zh.mainContent: 论文先训练仅依赖本体感知的 blind stabilizer，再开放 heightmap 学习地形控制；critic 在两个阶段使用特权信息。two-stage MLP / LSTM / CNN 在 OOD hard uneven terrain 的成功率为 70.96% / 72.36% / 71.95%，对应 one-stage 为 61.60% / 58.02% / 63.93%。真机 G1 实验也展示更稳定的地形执行。
innovations: 将 perception-conditioned humanoid locomotion 放在 LCA 与 Diversity-Enabled Sweet Spots 的架构视角下，强调不同信息预算和时间尺度的职责分离，而非增加 world model、estimator 或 perception backbone。

使用极简 two-stage curriculum 诱导同一策略形成分层职责：Stage 1 去除 actor perception 以优化 proprioceptive stabilization，Stage 2 恢复 perception 并优化 terrain-conditioned behavior。作者将其解释为先获得较好的 \(\theta_x^{\dagger}\)，再以 \(\theta_{x,0}=\theta_x^{\dagger}\) 初始化完整非凸优化。
通过 blind、one-stage、two-stage 与 MLP/LSTM/CNN 组合消融隔离训练架构与网络复杂度；结果表明 encoder/backbone 选择影响通常小于 one-stage/two-stage 对 OOD 和真机鲁棒性的影响。
创新更接近对 blind-then-vision、multi-rate control 和标准 RL 组件的架构化整合与系统验证，而非新 RL 算法、感知模型或蒸馏方法。
implementation: Actor proprioception 使用长度为 \(K\) 的状态历史：joint position \(q\)、joint velocity \(\dot q\)、body-frame base angular velocity \(\omega_b\)、projected gravity \(g_b\)，以及 planar velocity command \(u\) 和上一 action \(a_{k-1}\)。它额外接收 noisy sparse heightmap \(H^{\pi}\in\mathbb{R}^{11\times11}\)，覆盖机器人中心附近 \(1.0\,\mathrm{m}\times1.0\,\mathrm{m}\)。
Asymmetric critic 除类似 proprioception 外还接收 privileged world-frame/base velocity 与更大、无噪声的 \(1.5\,\mathrm{m}\times1.5\,\mathrm{m}\) heightmap \(H^V\)。两种 heightmap 都减去网格均值并 clip 至 \([-1,1]\)。

Perception encoder 是小型 MLP 或 CNN，将 heightmap 编为 \(z_H\)：MLP/CNN hidden layers 为 {256, 256}，CNN 用 \(3\times3\) kernel、stride 1；actor backbone 比较 MLP 与 LSTM，hidden layers 为 {512, 256, 128}。actor 输出 joint-position setpoints，由 joint PD 跟踪。

Stage 1 将 actor \(H\equiv0\)，critic 仍保留完整 privileged information；Stage 2 恢复 heightmap。对比中的 two-stage policy 前半训练 blind，后半引入 perception。所有策略在 IsaacSim 中用一张 RTX 4090、4096 并行环境和 asymmetric actor-critic 训练 40000 steps，四种地形各占 25%。

Reward 在架构间一致，除 tracking/regularization 外包含 phase-contact consistency、foot strike、sliding、orientation 和 clearance：\(r=r_{\mathrm{locomotion}}+0.5r_{\mathrm{phase}}-r_{\mathrm{strike}}-0.2r_{\mathrm{slide}}-r_{\mathrm{orient}}+r_{\mathrm{clear}}\)。

真机两台 Intel RealSense D435 的 depth 合并为 30 Hz point cloud，再生成 \(1.0\,\mathrm{m}\times1.0\,\mathrm{m}\) 的 \(11\times11\) grid：cell 取最小有效高度，经 outlier rejection、zero-mean、clip 与 5 cm quantization。Unitree G1 上 perception stack 运行 Jetson Orin NX，RL controller 运行 Ryzen 7 7840U；point cloud 30 Hz，policy 50 Hz，joint PD 1 kHz。

hard uneven terrain 的 Blind/One-Stage MLP/Two-Stage MLP 成功率为 64.63%/61.60%/70.96%，One/Two-Stage LSTM 为 58.02%/72.36%，CNN 为 63.93%/71.95%。OOD stairs 上 two-stage variants 的 contacts per step 约为对应 one-stage 的三分之一。

真机 stair ascent、stair descent、hinged ledge、soft ledge 各测试 5 次。One-Stage MLP 成功为 1/5、1/5、0/5、0/5；Two-Stage MLP 为 4/5、5/5、5/5、4/5；Two-Stage CNN 为 4/5、5/5、5/5、5/5。Blind 在 ledge 类 control-dominant 任务达 5/5、但 stairs 较弱，支持稳定与感知导航职责互补的解释。

en.title: Architecture Is All You Need: Diversity-Enabled Sweet Spots for Robust Humanoid Locomotion
en.authors: Blake Werner, Lizhi Yang, Aaron D. Ames
en.institutions: California Institute of Technology, Mechanical and Civil Engineering (Caltech MCE)
en.takeaway: First trains stable proprioceptive feedback, then enables heightmaps for terrain adaptation and visual control.
en.mainContent: The method first trains a proprioceptive blind stabilizer, then enables heightmaps for terrain control; critics receive privileged information in both stages. Two-stage MLP / LSTM / CNN reach 70.96% / 72.36% / 71.95% success on OOD hard uneven terrain versus 61.60% / 58.02% / 63.93% for one-stage training, with more stable G1 terrain demonstrations.
innovations: Frames perception-conditioned humanoid locomotion through LCA and Diversity-Enabled Sweet Spots, emphasizing separation of information budgets and timescales.

A simple two-stage curriculum first learns proprioceptive stabilization without actor perception, then restores perception for terrain conditioning; the paper interprets this as favorable initialization of the full non-convex optimization.
Ablations across blind, one-stage, two-stage and MLP/LSTM/CNN variants suggest architecture affects OOD and hardware robustness more than encoder/backbone complexity.
The contribution is architectural synthesis and empirical validation of existing components rather than a new RL algorithm, perception model, or distillation method.
implementation: Actor input is a \(K\)-step history of \(q,\dot q,\omega_b,g_b\), command \(u\), previous action, and a noisy \(11\times11\) heightmap over \(1.0\,\mathrm{m}\times1.0\,\mathrm{m}\). The asymmetric critic additionally gets privileged velocity and a noise-free \(1.5\,\mathrm{m}\times1.5\,\mathrm{m}\) heightmap.

Perception is encoded by MLP or CNN (hidden layers {256, 256}); the actor backbone is MLP or LSTM ({512, 256, 128}) and outputs PD-tracked joint position setpoints. In Stage 1 actor heightmap is zeroed, then restored in Stage 2 while the critic remains privileged.

IsaacSim training uses a single RTX 4090, 4096 parallel environments, 40000 steps, and evenly sampled stair ascent/descent, uneven terrain, and flat ground. Rewards are held fixed across architectures and include tracking, phase/contact, strike, slide, orientation, and clearance terms.

Two D435 cameras create a 30 Hz point cloud and an \(11\times11\) height grid with outlier rejection and 5 cm quantization. On Unitree G1, perception runs on Jetson Orin NX, RL runs on Ryzen 7 7840U, policy runs at 50 Hz, and PD at 1 kHz.
Hardware task success for One-Stage MLP is 1/5, 1/5, 0/5, 0/5; Two-Stage MLP is 4/5, 5/5, 5/5, 4/5; Two-Stage CNN is 4/5, 5/5, 5/5, 5/5 across ascent, descent, hinged ledge, and soft ledge.

zh.title: CHIP: Adaptive Compliance for Humanoid Control through Hindsight Perturbation
zh.authors: Sirui Chen, Zi-ang Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Fernando Castañeda, Chenran Li, Tingwu Wang, Ye Yuan, Linxi "Jim" Fan, C. Karen Liu, Yuke Zhu
zh.institutions: NVIDIA；Stanford University；The University of Texas at Austin
zh.takeaway: 训练时用外力反向偏移 actor 的目标，同时按原参考奖励，学出由柔顺系数调节的末端让位响应。
zh.mainContent: CHIP 在 motion-tracking PPO 训练中向末端施加外力，并把 actor 看到的目标改为 \(g^{hind}=g-f/k\)，跟踪奖励仍使用原参考 g。训练后的策略读取正常目标、本体历史和柔顺系数，在外力下产生近似 \(\Delta x\approx f/k\) 的让位行为。三点控制器用于 VR 遥操作、多机器人协同抓取和自主操作；多机器人抓取平均成功率为 0.80，FALCON 为 0.05，未做外力扰动训练的策略为 0.40。
innovations: 用 hindsight goal perturbation 在运动跟踪中学习可调柔顺性。
保持原参考奖励，让目标偏移与已知外力建立训练关联。
将柔顺参数纳入同一个三点全身控制接口。
implementation: 仿真施加已知末端外力，根据柔顺系数构造反向目标偏移。
PPO 根据原始全身参考更新策略；actor 读取偏移后的目标与本体历史。
部署恢复正常输入目标，以柔顺系数调节外力下的近似位置响应。
局部与全局三点模式接入 VR、协同抓取和 GR00T N1.5 自主操作。

en.title: CHIP: Adaptive Compliance for Humanoid Control through Hindsight Perturbation
en.authors: Sirui Chen, Zi-ang Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Fernando Castañeda, Chenran Li, Tingwu Wang, Ye Yuan, Linxi "Jim" Fan, C. Karen Liu, Yuke Zhu
en.institutions: NVIDIA; Stanford University; The University of Texas at Austin
en.takeaway: Trains compliant endpoint responses by shifting the actor goal against an applied force while rewarding tracking of the original reference.
en.mainContent: CHIP applies endpoint forces during motion-tracking PPO and changes the actor goal to \(g^{hind}=g-f/k\), while tracking rewards retain the original reference g. The deployed policy uses normal goals, proprioceptive history, and a compliance coefficient to produce approximately \(\Delta x\approx f/k\) displacement under force. Three-point controllers support VR teleoperation, cooperative grasping, and autonomous manipulation; cooperative grasping averages 0.80 success versus 0.05 for FALCON and 0.40 without force-perturbation training.
innovations: Learns adjustable compliance in motion tracking with hindsight goal perturbation.
Keeps reference rewards intact to associate goal offsets with known forces during training.
Adds compliance parameters to a shared three-point whole-body interface.
implementation: Simulation applies known endpoint forces and constructs opposing goal offsets from the compliance coefficient.
PPO updates the policy against the original full-body reference; the actor observes shifted goals and proprioceptive history.
Deployment restores normal goal inputs and uses the compliance coefficient to adjust approximate displacement responses to force.
Local and global three-point modes support VR, cooperative grasping, and GR00T N1.5 autonomous manipulation.

zh.title: Learning Agile Skills via Adversarial Imitation of Rough Partial Demonstrations
zh.authors: Chenhao Li, Marin Vlastelica, Sebastian Blaes, Jonas Frey, Felix Grimminger, Georg Martius
zh.institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich
zh.takeaway: 用粗糙基座演示训练 Wasserstein 型判别器提供模仿奖励，让 PPO 在物理仿真中学出完整可执行动作。
zh.mainContent: WASABI 从人手搬动机器人产生的粗糙基座轨迹学习模仿奖励。连续 H 帧基座特征训练 Wasserstein 型判别器，其标准化输出引导 PPO 在 Isaac Gym 中探索完整关节动作。SoloStandUp / SoloBackFlip 的 DTW 距离从 LSGAN 的 678.21 / 813.76 降至 351.13 / 477.43，并在 Solo 8 上部署 Leap、Wave 和 BackFlip。
innovations: 将 AMP/GAIL 中通常作为辅助 style reward 的判别器提升为主要 task reward，使策略无需显式的“完成后空翻”或“站起来”奖励，也能从部分 observation-only demonstrations 中学习技能。
用 Wasserstein 型线性 critic objective 替代 LSGAN 的 \(+1/-1\) 回归与截断奖励映射，使策略分布远离演示分布时仍能获得具有相对区分度的训练信号。
将判别器输入从短 transition 扩展为连续 \(H\) 帧基座片段，试图避免策略只重复参考运动中容易获得高分的局部片段；附录实验仅部分支持这一设计，尚未直接测量 mode collapse。
核心贡献属于 adversarial imitation、低维基座表示、PPO 和 Sim-to-Real 技术的系统组合，而不是完全不同于 AMP 的新训练框架；论文附录明确把 LSGAN baseline 描述为面向任务学习改造后的 AMP。
implementation: 每条手持演示只记录机器人坐标系下的基座线速度 \(v\)、角速度 \(\omega\)、重力投影 \(g\) 和基座高度 \(z\)，每帧共 10 维；每个技能采集 20 条轨迹，没有关节角、接触序列或专家 action。

判别器输入为连续 \(H\) 帧特征，维度为 \(10H\)，网络结构为 \(10H\rightarrow512\rightarrow256\rightarrow1\)。其目标为 \(\mathcal L_D=w_D[-\mathbb E_{d_M}D(o^H)+\mathbb E_{d_\pi}D(\Phi(s^H))]+w_{GP}\mathbb E_{d_M}\|\nabla D(o^H)\|_2^2\)，其中 \(w_D=0.5\)、\(w_{GP}=5.0\)。该损失只更新判别器参数，不通过仿真器直接反向传播到 actor。
判别器分数通过运行均值和方差标准化为 \(r_t^I=(D(\Phi(s_t^H))-\hat\mu)/\hat\sigma\)。总奖励为 \(r_t=w_I(r_t^I+r_t^T)+r_t^R\)，其中 \(r_t^T\) 防止策略通过主动摔倒提前结束负回报 episode，\(r_t^R\) 包含动作变化、关节加速度、力矩、基座 roll/yaw 角速度和横向速度惩罚。

仿真 actor 和 critic 均接收两帧 policy observation，每帧包含 \(v,\omega,g,z,q,\dot q,a_{t-1}\)，合计 68 维。actor 为 \(68\rightarrow128\rightarrow128\rightarrow128\rightarrow8\) 的 ELU MLP，输出 8 个目标关节位置；critic 输出标量 value，只在 PPO 训练中使用。
策略以 50 Hz 运行，目标关节位置由 \(K_p=5.0\)、\(K_d=0.1\) 的 PD 控制器执行。训练使用 4096 个并行 Isaac Gym 环境、每轮 24 步、最多 5000 iterations、5 个随机种子；PPO clip 为 0.2，discount factor 为 0.99，entropy coefficient 为 0.01。
训练采用交替更新：先用当前策略 rollout 计算 imitation、termination 和 regularization rewards，再用 PPO 更新 actor 与 value function；随后固定策略，用演示片段和策略片段更新判别器。actor 接收的是标量 reward，而不是演示动作标签。
Sim-to-Real 训练加入基座质量随机化和周期性随机推力。真机策略改为只使用当前单帧 34 维 observation，由 100 Hz Vicon 提供 root-state estimation；部署时仅保留 actor 与 PD 控制器，删除演示数据、判别器和 critic。
WASABI 不是 full-body mimic 的完全上位方法：如果已有完整且可执行的 retargeted reference，phase/reference-conditioned mimic 能获得更明确的全身跟踪监督。WASABI 的优势是无需关节参考，但代价是只能约束低维基座运动，关节姿态和接触行为存在多解。
关键证据缺口是 WASABI 与 LSGAN 的 optimizer、learning rate、判别器时域 \(H\) 和 imitation reward 权重 \(w_I\) 同时不同，因此现有实验支持整套 WASABI recipe，而不能将性能提升单独归因于 Wasserstein loss。

en.title: Learning Agile Skills via Adversarial Imitation of Rough Partial Demonstrations
en.authors: Chenhao Li, Marin Vlastelica, Sebastian Blaes, Jonas Frey, Felix Grimminger, Georg Martius
en.institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich
en.takeaway: Learns imitation rewards from rough base-motion demonstrations with a Wasserstein-style discriminator, letting PPO discover executable full-body actions in simulation.
en.mainContent: WASABI learns imitation rewards from rough base trajectories produced by manually moving a robot. A Wasserstein-style discriminator observes H-frame base features and supplies normalized rewards for PPO to discover joint actions in Isaac Gym. SoloStandUp / SoloBackFlip DTW distances decrease from LSGAN’s 678.21 / 813.76 to 351.13 / 477.43, with Leap, Wave, and BackFlip deployed on Solo 8.
innovations: The discriminator, which normally supplies an auxiliary style reward in AMP/GAIL, is promoted to the primary task-reward source, allowing skills to be learned from partial observation-only demonstrations without explicit stand-up or backflip rewards.

A Wasserstein-style linear critic objective replaces LSGAN regression to \(+1/-1\) and its clipped reward mapping, preserving relative reward information when the policy distribution is initially far from the demonstrations.

The discriminator receives \(H\) consecutive base-observation frames to discourage policies from repeatedly exploiting an easy local segment of the reference motion; the appendix provides only partial evidence and does not directly measure mode collapse.

The principal contribution is a system-level combination of adversarial imitation, a low-dimensional base representation, PPO, and sim-to-real methods rather than an entirely different framework from AMP; the appendix explicitly describes the LSGAN baseline as an AMP adaptation for task learning.
implementation: Each hand-held demonstration records only base linear velocity \(v\), angular velocity \(\omega\), projected gravity \(g\), and base height \(z\) in the robot frame, totaling 10 dimensions per frame. Twenty trajectories are collected per skill, without joint states, contact sequences, or expert actions.

The discriminator consumes \(H\) consecutive feature frames with input dimension \(10H\) and architecture \(10H\rightarrow512\rightarrow256\rightarrow1\). Its objective is \(\mathcal L_D=w_D[-\mathbb E_{d_M}D(o^H)+\mathbb E_{d_\pi}D(\Phi(s^H))]+w_{GP}\mathbb E_{d_M}\|\nabla D(o^H)\|_2^2\), with \(w_D=0.5\) and \(w_{GP}=5.0\). This loss updates only the discriminator and is not differentiated through the simulator into the actor.

The discriminator score is normalized as \(r_t^I=(D(\Phi(s_t^H))-\hat\mu)/\hat\sigma\). The total reward is \(r_t=w_I(r_t^I+r_t^T)+r_t^R\), where \(r_t^T\) prevents the policy from terminating negative-reward episodes by deliberately falling and \(r_t^R\) penalizes action rate, joint acceleration, torque, base roll/yaw rates, and lateral velocity.

The simulated actor and critic receive two policy-observation frames. Each frame contains \(v,\omega,g,z,q,\dot q,a_{t-1}\), giving 68 dimensions. The ELU actor has architecture \(68\rightarrow128\rightarrow128\rightarrow128\rightarrow8\) and outputs eight target joint positions; the critic outputs a scalar value and is used only during PPO training.

The policy runs at 50 Hz and its joint targets are executed by a PD controller with \(K_p=5.0\) and \(K_d=0.1\). Training uses 4096 parallel Isaac Gym environments, 24 steps per iteration, up to 5000 iterations, and five random seeds; PPO uses a clip range of 0.2, discount factor of 0.99, and entropy coefficient of 0.01.

Training alternates between collecting policy rollouts and using PPO to update the actor and value function from imitation, termination, and regularization rewards, followed by discriminator updates using demonstration and policy segments while the policy is fixed. The actor receives a scalar reward rather than demonstrated action labels.

Sim-to-real training includes base-mass randomization and periodic random pushes. The real-robot policy uses only the current 34-dimensional observation, with root-state estimates supplied by a 100 Hz Vicon system. Deployment retains only the actor and PD controller; demonstrations, discriminator, and critic are removed.

WASABI is not a strict superset of full-body mimic. With complete and feasible retargeted references, a phase- or reference-conditioned mimic policy receives much stronger whole-body tracking supervision. WASABI avoids requiring joint references but constrains only low-dimensional base motion, leaving joint and contact behaviors underdetermined.

The main evidence limitation is that optimizer choice, learning rates, discriminator horizon \(H\), and imitation-reward weight \(w_I\) differ between WASABI and LSGAN. The results therefore support the complete WASABI recipe rather than isolating the Wasserstein loss as the sole causal factor.

zh.title: Learning One Representation to Optimize All Rewards
zh.authors: Ahmed Touati, Yann Ollivier
zh.institutions: Mila, University of Montreal；Facebook Artificial Intelligence Research, Paris
zh.takeaway: 用无奖励交互学会长期访问关系，把新奖励压缩成任务向量，再直接调用对应策略。
zh.mainContent: 论文提出 Forward-Backward（FB）表示：前向网络 F 描述给定策略下从当前状态和动作出发的长期访问关系，后向网络 B 编码被访问的状态或目标，两者内积近似 successor measure 的密度。新奖励通过奖励加权的 B 特征变成任务向量 z，策略再依据 F 与 z 的内积选择动作，实现一次无奖励预训练后的奖励切换。它是 Meta Motivo / FB-CPR 和 BFM-Zero 的表示基础；原文实验覆盖迷宫、FetchReach 和 Ms. Pacman，最优性定理以精确 FB 表示为前提。
innovations: 把长期访问预测分解为 F 与 B，并让任务条件策略与该预测共同学习。（§3，Definition 1，Eq. 2）
提供奖励到策略的显式接口：\(z_r=\mathbb E_{g\sim\rho}[B(g)r(g)]\)，\(\pi_{z_r}(s)=\arg\max_a F(s,a,z_r)^\top z_r\)。（Theorem 2；§4）
利用 Bellman / TD 自举学习无奖励转移中的长期结构，并用 B 的正交化正则控制表示尺度和相关性。（§4；Appendix D.3）
implementation: 采集探索策略产生的转移，存入 replay buffer；每次更新分别采样转移、查询目标和任务条件 z。实验的 B 输入包括迷宫状态、夹爪位置或 Ms. Pacman 的二维位置。（Algorithm 1；Appendix D.3）
F 与 B 的内积拟合相对于参考分布的折扣访问密度。访问累计包含当前步和重复访问；参考分布决定目标采样及奖励编码的加权方式。（Eq. 1–2）
目标 F、B 根据真实下一状态和后续动作分布构造折扣未来访问预测；该分支停止梯度。在线 F、B 通过平方自举误差与注入当前访问贡献的负内积项联合更新。（Algorithm 1，Eq. 164）
批次大小为 128，在线参数使用 Adam；每个 cycle 的 40 次梯度更新后，以 0.95 / 0.05 的 Polyak 权重同步目标网络。训练中的后续动作使用温度 200 的 softmax。（Appendix D.3）
部署时冻结网络，用新奖励样本估计任务向量，再逐状态计算动作分数。B 用于奖励编码，在线动作选择使用 F 与 z；一般新奖励只需重新计算 z。（§4，Eq. 6–8）
Figure 8–10 的近似读数：FetchReach 中 FB-50 与 goal-conditioned DQN 均约 100% 成功；Continuous Maze 中 FB-200 约 90%，DQN 约 99%；Discrete Maze 中 FB-75/100 的归一化策略质量约 0.97，DQN 约 0.96。

en.title: Learning One Representation to Optimize All Rewards
en.authors: Ahmed Touati, Yann Ollivier
en.institutions: Mila, University of Montreal; Facebook Artificial Intelligence Research, Paris
en.takeaway: Learn long-term occupancy from reward-free interaction, encode a new reward as a task vector, and directly execute its policy.
en.mainContent: Forward-Backward (FB) representations factor successor-measure densities into policy-conditioned forward features F and shared backward features B. Reward-weighted B features produce a task vector z, and the policy selects actions using the inner product of F and z, enabling reward changes after reward-free pretraining. This representation underlies Meta Motivo / FB-CPR and BFM-Zero; the original experiments use mazes, FetchReach, and Ms. Pacman, and the optimality theorem assumes an exact FB representation.
innovations: Jointly learns a factorized long-term occupancy representation and its task-conditioned policy. (§3, Definition 1, Eq. 2)
Provides an explicit reward-to-policy interface: \(z_r=\mathbb E_{g\sim\rho}[B(g)r(g)]\), \(\pi_{z_r}(s)=\arg\max_a F(s,a,z_r)^\top z_r\). (Theorem 2; §4)
Uses Bellman / TD bootstrapping to learn long-term structure from reward-free transitions, with B orthogonalization controlling feature scale and correlation. (§4; Appendix D.3)
implementation: Stores exploratory transitions in replay and samples transition, query-goal, and task-condition batches. Experimental B inputs include maze states, gripper positions, and the two-dimensional Ms. Pacman position. (Algorithm 1; Appendix D.3)

The F–B inner product fits discounted occupancy density relative to a reference distribution. Occupancy includes the current step and repeat visits; the reference distribution determines query sampling and reward encoding. (Eq. 1–2)

Target F and B construct a discounted future-occupancy estimate from the observed next state and subsequent action distribution, with gradients stopped. Online F and B are updated jointly using squared bootstrap error and a negative inner-product term that supplies current occupancy. (Algorithm 1, Eq. 164)

Uses batch size 128 and Adam, with target networks synchronized by 0.95 / 0.05 Polyak averaging after 40 gradient steps per cycle. Training uses a temperature-200 softmax for subsequent actions. (Appendix D.3)
At deployment, frozen B encodes reward samples into a task vector, while F and z score actions at each state. A new reward generally requires recomputing z. (§4, Eq. 6–8)

Approximate readings from Figures 8–10: FB-50 and goal-conditioned DQN both reach about 100% success in FetchReach; FB-200 reaches about 90% versus 99% for DQN in Continuous Maze; FB-75/100 reaches about 0.97 normalized policy quality versus 0.96 for DQN in Discrete Maze.

zh.title: Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoids with Learned Point Cloud Correspondence
zh.authors: Hanyang Cao, Yuetong Fang, Taesoo Kwon, Runyi Yu, Ji Ma, Jing Tan, Yangchen Zhou, Baoze Du, Yi Gu, Yukang Gao, Ruoli Dai, Lei Han, Renjing Xu
zh.institutions: 香港科技大学（广州）；Noitom Robotics；Hanyang University；香港科技大学；香港大学
zh.takeaway: 先学人体—机器人密集表面对应，再复用对应逐帧优化姿态与接触，把多种人体表示变成机器人参考。
zh.mainContent: UMR 以身体表面点云作为人体与机器人的共享接口。先在对齐的 T-pose 上学习有共同编号的密集对应并绑定到网格，再在动作序列中匹配表面位置、朝向和接触，逐帧求解机器人姿态。方法支持 SMPL-X、SOMA、绑定角色和扫描网格，实验连接 BeyondMimic 单动作跟踪、SONIC 大规模训练以及人体—物体和人体—场景交互。
innovations: 以学习的密集表面对应连接不同骨架与机器人拓扑。
共享点编号同时支持姿态匹配、身体分区标签继承和接触迁移。
把可复用的对应学习与逐动作姿态优化分成两个阶段。
implementation: 第一阶段用 PointNet 式 encoder 与 deformation decoder 预测人体点对应的机器人位置，以 Chamfer、repulsion 和 geodesic edge smoothness 训练。对应按源模板与目标机器人复用。（III-B，Eq. 2–5）
人体点随网格做 barycentric transport，机器人点以 link-local binding 随 FK 运动；机器人对应点继承人体分区标签。（III-B–C）
第二阶段最小化位置、表面朝向与接触 residual；接触集合按人体点到环境最近点的距离阈值筛选，所选点增加接触匹配权重。（Eq. 6–11）
线性化 residual 后以受约束 Gauss–Newton 求更新，限制关节、步长和地面穿透；MuJoCo 提供运动学，Clarabel 求解子问题。（Eq. 12–14；IV）
评估包括 LAFAN1 单动作、BONES-SEED 大规模参考以及 OmniContact 的 Carry / Kick / Push 和 GRAIL 的 Chair / Stair / Slope；下游策略训练使用生成的机器人轨迹。（IV-B–C）

en.title: Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoids with Learned Point Cloud Correspondence
en.authors: Hanyang Cao, Yuetong Fang, Taesoo Kwon, Runyi Yu, Ji Ma, Jing Tan, Yangchen Zhou, Baoze Du, Yi Gu, Yukang Gao, Ruoli Dai, Lei Han, Renjing Xu
en.institutions: HKUST (Guangzhou); Noitom Robotics; Hanyang University; HKUST; University of Hong Kong
en.takeaway: Learns dense human–robot surface correspondence, then reuses it for framewise pose and contact optimization across human-motion representations.
en.mainContent: UMR uses exterior body point clouds as a shared human–robot interface. It learns indexed dense correspondence in aligned T-poses, binds points to meshes, and solves robot poses frame by frame by matching surface positions, orientations, and contacts. SMPL-X, SOMA, rigged characters, and scanned meshes feed the same pipeline; experiments use BeyondMimic, SONIC, and object or scene interactions.
innovations: Connects different skeletons and robot topologies through learned dense surface correspondence.
Shared point indices support pose matching, inherited body-region labels, and contact transfer.
Separates reusable correspondence learning from per-motion pose optimization.
implementation: Stage I uses a PointNet-style encoder and deformation decoder with Chamfer, repulsion, and geodesic-edge smoothness losses. Correspondence is reused for the same source template and robot. (III-B, Eq. 2–5)
Human points move by barycentric transport; robot points follow link-local bindings through FK and inherit source body-region labels. (III-B–C)
Stage II minimizes position, surface-orientation, and contact residuals. A human-to-environment distance threshold selects contact points for additional matching weight. (Eq. 6–11)
Constrained Gauss–Newton updates enforce joint, step-size, and floor constraints. MuJoCo supplies kinematics and Clarabel solves the subproblems. (Eq. 12–14; IV)
Evaluates LAFAN1 clips, large-scale BONES-SEED references, OmniContact Carry / Kick / Push, and GRAIL Chair / Stair / Slope; generated references train downstream policies. (IV-B–C)

zh.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
zh.authors: Weishuai Zeng, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu, Shunlin Lu, Weixiang Zhong, Jiahe Chen, Feiyu Jia, Xiao Chen, Zirui Wang, Furui Xu, Ming Zhou, Kailin Li, Weinan Zhang, He Wang, Li Yi, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang, Jingbo Wang
zh.institutions: 香港中文大学；上海交通大学；浙江大学；北京大学；清华大学；Galbot；上海人工智能实验室
zh.takeaway: 将全局全身跟踪、交互经验规模与动作覆盖协同扩展，用 Humanoid Transformer 把历史和掩码目标变成控制动作。
zh.mainContent: ScaleBFM 研究 BFM 的扩展配方：以全局全身参考跟踪训练行为，协同增加 PPO 交互经验与参考动作覆盖，并采用 Humanoid Transformer。模型通过历史状态和动作的自注意力、对未来掩码目标的交叉注意力生成动作，支持八种身体目标模式。实验分别扩展 rollout、参考库和网络容量；结果表明扩大行为覆盖与合理增加交互规模更有效，Transformer 相比所测 MLP 更充分利用容量，继续增大模型时收益呈饱和。
innovations: 将行为学习落实为全局全身轨迹跟踪，保留 root 与局部姿态的协调。
区分 PPO rollout 数量与参考动作多样性，分别分析并行规模、时域和行为覆盖。
提出 Humanoid Transformer，用历史上下文和未来目标两路 token 条件化动作与价值预测。
implementation: actor 读取部分目标与 link-wise mask，critic 读取完整目标；mask 覆盖八种控制模式，PPO 按完整参考计算跟踪目标。（§3.2）
历史状态与动作 token 交错排列并加入可学习 query e，自注意力汇总历史；未来目标与时间偏移经 tokenization 后通过交叉注意力进入骨干。e 的输出经预测头生成动作或价值。（§3.4；A.4）
actor 使用近期五帧和从第 5–32 帧采样的远期目标，critic 使用 0、1、2、4、8、16、32 的未来偏移；PPO 更新 tokenizers、注意力、FFN 与预测头。（§3.4）
参考库整合 LAFAN、AMASS、OMOMO、GRAB、SnapMoGen、FineDance、BONES-SEED 与 Embody3D，约 1.02 亿帧，统一到 50 FPS。（§3.3）
BONES 留出集评估同来源泛化；Ours 含 839 条 Xsens 和 810 条 100STYLE 动作，评估跨来源泛化。官方发布原始 BVH、G1 重定向轨迹和处理数据。（§4.1；官方数据发布）
模型实验同时扩展 actor 与 critic；约 3M 的 Transformer 优于相近规模 MLP。Ours 全身模式成功率在 4.44M 达到 98.85%，9.91M 为 98.36%，体现容量增加后的饱和。（Figure 9；B.6）

en.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
en.authors: Weishuai Zeng, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu, Shunlin Lu, Weixiang Zhong, Jiahe Chen, Feiyu Jia, Xiao Chen, Zirui Wang, Furui Xu, Ming Zhou, Kailin Li, Weinan Zhang, He Wang, Li Yi, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang, Jingbo Wang
en.institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Zhejiang University; Peking University; Tsinghua University; Galbot; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
en.takeaway: Scales global whole-body tracking, interaction experience, and motion coverage together, using Humanoid Transformer to map history and masked goals to actions.
en.mainContent: ScaleBFM studies a scaling recipe combining global whole-body tracking, PPO interaction experience, motion coverage, and Humanoid Transformer. Self-attention over state/action history and cross-attention to masked future goals produce actions for eight body-target modes. Experiments separately vary rollouts, reference libraries, and model capacity; broader behavior coverage and balanced interaction scaling help, while the Transformer uses capacity more effectively than tested MLPs and shows saturation at larger sizes.
innovations: Grounds behavior learning in global whole-body tracking that preserves root–pose coordination.
Separates PPO rollout quantity from reference-motion diversity, studying parallelism, horizon, and behavior coverage.
Introduces Humanoid Transformer with history-context and future-goal tokens for action and value prediction.
implementation: The actor receives partial goals and link-wise masks, while the critic receives full goals. Eight masks define control modes and PPO uses the full reference tracking objective. (§3.2)

Interleaved state/action tokens and a learnable query e summarize history through self-attention. Tokenized future goals and time offsets enter through cross-attention; the query output predicts actions or value. (§3.4; A.4)
Actor goals include five near frames and a sampled offset from 5–32; critic offsets are 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32. PPO updates tokenizers, attention, FFNs, and prediction heads. (§3.4)
References combine LAFAN, AMASS, OMOMO, GRAB, SnapMoGen, FineDance, BONES-SEED, and Embody3D: about 102 million frames at 50 FPS. (§3.3)

BONES holdouts test in-source generalization; Ours uses 839 Xsens and 810 100STYLE sequences for cross-source tests. The official release includes original BVH, G1 references, and processed data. (§4.1; official release)

Architecture experiments scale actor and critic together. The roughly 3M Transformer outperforms the similarly sized MLP; Ours whole-body success reaches 98.85% at 4.44M and 98.36% at 9.91M, illustrating saturation. (Figure 9; B.6)

zh.title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Behavioral Foundation Models to Unseen Dynamics
zh.authors: Maksim Bobrin, Ilya Zisman, Alexander Nikulin, Vladislav Kurenkov, Dmitry Dylov
zh.institutions: AXXX; Applied AI Institute, Computational Imaging Lab; MSU; Innopolis University; Humanoid
zh.status: 正文与方法附录已精读
zh.takeaway: 先用下一状态预测学环境上下文并条件化 Forward，再围绕上下文方向采样任务向量，缓解混合动力学下的表示干扰。
zh.mainContent: 本文研究隐藏环境配置导致的动力学变化：相同可见状态在不同门洞布局、风向或摩擦下需要不同策略，原始 FB 的共享输入会混合这些未来占据分布。BFB 从无奖励历史推断上下文 h 并条件化 Forward；RFB 进一步将训练任务向量的先验改为围绕 h 方向的 vMF 分布。模型用多个环境的离线轨迹训练，测试时根据短历史和指定奖励提取策略，无需梯度更新；在 Four-Rooms、Pointmass、AntWind 与 OGBench Scene 的未见配置上改善表现。
innovations: 把动力学适应接入 FB 的 successor measure 表示：用历史推断环境上下文，保留共享 Backward 与任意奖励的任务编码接口。
用轨迹共享的潜变量辅助预测下一状态，先预训练上下文估计器，再训练条件化的 FB 表示。
RFB 用上下文方向引导任务向量采样，使不同动力学在任务空间形成偏好的区域，进一步缓解策略表示干扰。
implementation: 问题表述为 Contextual MDP：隐藏配置 c 决定转移函数，每个 episode 内保持不变，跨 episode 改变；训练不使用配置标签。FB 本身通过 successor measure 隐式表示长期动力学，本文补充区分隐藏配置的条件信息。（A.1，第 15 页；§3.1）
上下文 Transformer 读取轨迹转移，输出高斯均值与 log 标准差，通过重参数化得到 h；一个轨迹窗口共享同一个 h。预测头结合当前状态、动作和 h，以下一状态的均方误差预训练编码器。（§3.2；Algorithm 1，第 24 页）
将 h 与任务向量拼接后输入 Forward，Backward 跨上下文共享并继续训练；沿用 FB 的 TD 目标。作者发现分阶段训练比端到端训练效果更好。（公式 6，第 6 页；Algorithm 1）
原始 FB 在均匀球面采样和 z=B(s) 之间按 50:50 混合。RFB 改用归一化 h 为中心的 vMF 采样：先围绕北极采样，再经 Householder 变换对齐到 h，最后投影到半径 sqrt(d) 的球面；默认 κ=50，Pointmass 为 100。（E.3；Algorithm 2，第 23–24 页）
测试时先用短的无奖励随机探索轨迹推断 h，再由奖励加权的 Backward 表示得到任务向量，条件化策略执行；零样本指无需测试时梯度更新，仍需要环境历史。（§3.2–4，第 6–7 页）
主实验比较 FB、HILP、LAP 和随机策略；Table 1 还包含 Contextual-FB、Oracle-ID 与 OGBench Scene 摩擦变化。Four-Rooms 未见布局成功率 BFB 为 0.40、RFB 为 0.61，FB 为 0.15。（Table 1，第 10 页；Table 2，第 20 页）
Figure 4 展示上下文与任务向量的几何结构，Figure 7 展示学到的上下文随布局、风向区分。有限 κ 的 vMF 是软采样偏置；理论的误差解耦依赖不重叠区域与参数块可分假设，不能直接当作共享神经网络完全消除干扰的保证。（第 6、9 页；Appendix B）
附录将本文与 Contextual FB 的域分类器及奖励修正、PEARL/VariBAD 的历史信念推断、Transformer 的 in-context RL 联系起来。本文的组合重点是无奖励动力学上下文、FB 奖励提示接口和上下文条件化的任务先验。（A.2，第 15–16 页）

en.title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Behavioral Foundation Models to Unseen Dynamics
en.authors: Maksim Bobrin, Ilya Zisman, Alexander Nikulin, Vladislav Kurenkov, Dmitry Dylov
en.institutions: AXXX; Applied AI Institute, Computational Imaging Lab; MSU; Innopolis University; Humanoid
en.status: Main text and method appendices reviewed
en.takeaway: Learns dynamics context through next-state prediction, conditions Forward on that context, and samples task vectors around its direction to reduce interference across dynamics.
en.mainContent: Hidden environment configurations make identical visible states require different policies under changing doorway layouts, wind, or friction; vanilla FB inputs conflate their future occupancy distributions. BFB infers context h from reward-free history and conditions Forward on it, while RFB additionally replaces the training task prior with a vMF distribution around the context direction. Trained on offline trajectories from multiple environments, the models extract reward-prompted policies from short test histories without gradient updates and improve generalization on Four-Rooms, Pointmass, AntWind, and OGBench Scene.
innovations: Adds hidden-dynamics context inference to FB successor measures while retaining a shared Backward representation and arbitrary-reward task encoding.
Pretrains a trajectory-shared context latent through auxiliary next-state prediction before learning the conditioned FB representation.
RFB biases task-vector sampling toward context directions, encouraging dynamics-specific preferred regions and reducing policy-representation interference.
implementation: The Contextual MDP has a hidden configuration c that determines transitions and stays fixed within each episode. Training uses no configuration labels. FB already represents long-term dynamics implicitly through successor measures; the added context distinguishes hidden configurations. (A.1, p.15; §3.1)

A context Transformer encodes trajectory transitions into Gaussian means and log standard deviations; reparameterization produces h, shared across a trajectory window. A prediction head takes state, action, and h, and next-state mean squared error pretrains the encoder. (§3.2; Algorithm 1, p.24)

Concatenate h with the task vector for Forward while keeping Backward shared and trainable. Use the FB TD objective; the authors report better results with separate encoder pretraining than end-to-end training. (Eq.6, p.6; Algorithm 1)

Vanilla FB mixes uniform sphere sampling and z=B(s) at 50:50. RFB samples vMF vectors around normalized h via north-pole sampling and a Householder transform, then projects them onto the sphere of radius sqrt(d). Default κ is 50 and Pointmass uses 100. (E.3; Algorithm 2, pp.23–24)

At test time, a short reward-free random-exploration history yields h; reward-weighted Backward features yield the task vector for the conditioned policy. Zero-shot adaptation requires no test-time gradient updates but does require environment history. (§3.2–4, pp.6–7)

Main baselines include FB, HILP, LAP, and random policies. Table 1 also includes Contextual-FB, Oracle-ID, and OGBench Scene friction shifts. Unseen Four-Rooms success is 0.40 for BFB, 0.61 for RFB, and 0.15 for FB. (Table 1, p.10; Table 2, p.20)

Figure 4 illustrates context/task geometry; Figure 7 distinguishes contexts by layouts and wind. Finite-κ vMF sampling is a soft bias. The theoretical error decoupling assumes disjoint regions and block-separable parameters, rather than guaranteeing zero interference in the shared neural network. (pp.6, 9; Appendix B)

Related work connects domain-classifier reward correction in Contextual FB, history-based belief inference in PEARL/VariBAD, and Transformer in-context RL. The contribution combines reward-free dynamics context, the FB reward-prompt interface, and a context-conditioned task prior. (A.2, pp.15–16)

zh.title: UniPhys: Unified Planner and Controller with Diffusion for Flexible Physics-Based Character Control
zh.authors: Yan Wu, Korrawe Karunratanakul, Zhengyi Luo, Siyu Tang
zh.institutions: ETH Zurich; Carnegie Mellon University
zh.status: 方法与关键实验已阅读
zh.takeaway: 用扩散模型联合生成未来身体状态与 PULSE 动作 latent，解码执行一小段后更新历史，再生成下一段。
zh.mainContent: UniPhys 针对运动学规划器与物理控制器分离造成的跟踪偏差，用 PULSE 跟踪 AMASS 运动并配上 BABEL 文字，构建物理状态—动作示范。因果 Transformer 按 Diffusion Forcing 方式训练，联合生成未来状态和 32 维动作 latent，再经 PULSE 解码器与 PD 控制在 Isaac Gym 中执行。推理通过文字或任务损失引导去噪，同一模型完成文字控制、目标到达、速度控制与动态避障；实验展示较自然、平滑的运动，推理效率仍是主要限制。
innovations: 联合建模状态和动作 latent：未来状态支持规划与任务损失引导，latent 经现有 PULSE 解码器转成控制动作；“统一”指共享行为生成模型。（§4.2–4.3，图 3）
将逐帧独立噪声的 Diffusion Forcing 用于物理行为克隆，并配合历史稳定化和不同去噪日程，缓解长期执行中的误差积累。（§4.2–4.3）
在推理阶段使用 CFG 与任务损失梯度引导同一模型，实现多种控制要求，无需逐任务微调；同时构建带文字的物理状态—动作数据集。（§4.1、§4.3–4.4）
implementation: 数据：BABEL 提供与 AMASS 运动对应的人工文字及时间段标注，不提供物理控制动作。PULSE 在仿真中跟踪运动，记录状态、控制动作和 latent，保留成功跟踪的序列；最终 4,875 段、15.7 小时。（§4.1，第 4 页）
表示与网络：每个实际训练 token 为 \(x_t=[z_t,s_{t+1}]\)，拼接 32 维动作 latent 与 366 维状态，共 398 维；文字经 CLIP 编码，单独作为条件。token 与噪声等级嵌入经 MLP、加时间位置编码，进入 12 层、隐藏维度 768 的因果 Transformer；因果注意力不读取后续行为 token。（图 3(a)、§4.2；附录 A）
训练：以步长 8 将运动切成 32 帧片段，多条文字标注时随机选一条；各帧独立采样噪声等级并直接加高斯噪声。网络预测干净序列，损失为 \(\mathcal L=\mathbb E\|X^0-M_\theta(X^k,k,c)\|^2\)。一次更新是加噪、一次前向预测、误差反传，再重新采样；不在每次训练更新中完整运行多轮反向去噪。（式 1；附录 A）
推理：历史行为作为上下文，未知未来 token 从高斯随机噪声初始化。网络每轮输出干净序列的估计，DDIM 采样器据此更新到更低噪声等级，再输入同一网络；附录采用 5 步 DDIM。干净估计不是最终正确轨迹，采样过程不更新网络权重。（算法 1；附录 A）
帧数务必分开：训练窗口长度 32、历史长度 \(h\)、未来预测长度 \(H\)、实际执行长度 \(T_a\) 是不同量。文字控制为 \(h=4,H=8,T_a=8\)；目标到达、速度控制、避障为 \(h=4,H=28,T_a=8\)。目标任务的 32 帧窗口是 4 帧历史＋28 帧未来，不能把执行 8 帧误记成“8 帧历史＋24 帧噪声”。（表 1，第 6 页）

执行闭环：对要执行的前 \(T_a\) 帧，将对应预测状态和 latent 交给 PULSE 解码器得到动作 \(a_i=D(\hat s_i,\hat z_i)\)。动作指定关节 PD 目标，再由物理仿真产生实际状态；预测状态不会直接赋给身体。默认执行 8 帧后更新历史，取最近 4 帧继续生成未来；每次生成包含多步去噪，并非只调用 Transformer 一次。（§3、§4.3–4.4，算法 1）
稳定化：把已去噪帧的噪声标记从 0 改为小的非零值，提示模型历史可能含误差；只修改噪声标记，不实际给这些状态—动作预测再加噪声。文字控制采用自回归去噪，目标等任务采用优先处理近期帧的渐进去噪。（§4.3，表 1）
任务引导：文字用 CFG；目标位置、速度和动态障碍物分别定义任务损失，用经网络预测结果反传得到的样本梯度调整生成序列，MCG 对多个样本的梯度取平均。这里的梯度用于生成过程，不是测试时训练网络。（式 2–4；附录 B）
时效性：默认每执行 8 个运动帧重新生成，不等于每 8 帧一定能及时算完。A100、5 步 DDIM 下，表 4 的自回归、渐进、全序列去噪分别为 9.5、18、23 FPS；全序列配置稳定性较差。附录 D 承认推理效率低于 RL 策略，实时控制需要优化；文中没有说明异步生成与执行重叠的调度，也未给出第 9 帧衔接的延迟保证。（§5.5、表 4；附录 D）

en.title: UniPhys: Unified Planner and Controller with Diffusion for Flexible Physics-Based Character Control
en.authors: Yan Wu, Korrawe Karunratanakul, Zhengyi Luo, Siyu Tang
en.institutions: ETH Zurich; Carnegie Mellon University
en.takeaway: Jointly generates future body states and PULSE action latents with diffusion, decodes and executes a short segment, then updates history and generates again.
en.mainContent: UniPhys addresses tracking discrepancies between separate kinematic planners and physics controllers by tracking AMASS motion with PULSE and pairing the resulting physical demonstrations with BABEL text. A causal Transformer trained with Diffusion Forcing jointly generates future states and 32-dimensional action latents, which a PULSE decoder and PD controllers execute in Isaac Gym. Text or task-loss guidance enables text control, goal reaching, velocity control, and dynamic obstacle avoidance with one model; experiments show natural, smooth motion, while inference efficiency remains a major limitation.
innovations: Jointly models states and action latents: predicted states enable planning and task-loss guidance, while latents are decoded into control actions by the existing PULSE decoder. Unification refers to the shared behavior generator. (§4.2–4.3, Figure 3)

Applies per-frame independent-noise Diffusion Forcing to physics-based behavior cloning, combining history stabilization and flexible denoising schedules to mitigate accumulated rollout errors. (§4.2–4.3)
Uses CFG and task-loss gradient guidance at inference to support multiple control objectives without per-task finetuning, and constructs a text-paired physical state–action dataset. (§4.1, §4.3–4.4)
implementation: Data: BABEL provides human-written text and temporal annotations aligned with AMASS motion, rather than physical control actions. PULSE tracks motion in simulation, logging states, actions, and latents and retaining successfully tracked sequences: 4,875 sequences and 15.7 hours. (§4.1, p.4)

Representation and network: each actual training token is \(x_t=[z_t,s_{t+1}]\), combining a 32-dimensional action latent and 366-dimensional state into 398 features. CLIP text is supplied separately as conditioning. Tokens and noise-level embeddings pass through an MLP, receive temporal positional encoding, and enter a 12-layer causal Transformer with hidden size 768; causal attention cannot read later behavior tokens. (Figure 3(a), §4.2; Appendix A)

Training: cut motion into 32-frame clips with stride 8, randomly selecting one text annotation when several apply. Independently sample each frame's noise level and directly corrupt it with Gaussian noise. Predict the clean sequence with \(\mathcal L=\mathbb E\|X^0-M_\theta(X^k,k,c)\|^2\). Each update consists of corruption, one forward prediction, error backpropagation, and resampling; it does not run the full iterative reverse sampling process. (Eq.1; Appendix A)

Inference: use past behavior as context and initialize unknown future tokens with Gaussian noise. Each network call estimates the clean sequence; the DDIM sampler constructs lower-noise inputs for subsequent calls to the same network. Appendix A uses 5 DDIM steps. A clean estimate is not a guaranteed correct trajectory, and sampling does not update network weights. (Algorithm 1; Appendix A)

Keep frame counts distinct: the 32-frame training window, history \(h\), prediction horizon \(H\), and execution interval \(T_a\) are separate quantities. Text control uses \(h=4,H=8,T_a=8\); goal reaching, velocity control, and avoidance use \(h=4,H=28,T_a=8\). The goal-task window is 4 history frames plus 28 future frames, not 8 history frames plus 24 noise frames. (Table 1, p.6)

Execution loop: for the first \(T_a\) frames, decode corresponding predicted states and latents into actions \(a_i=D(\hat s_i,\hat z_i)\). Actions specify joint PD targets; simulation produces actual states rather than assigning predicted states directly to the body. By default execute 8 frames, update history, and use the latest 4 frames to generate again. Each generation involves multiple denoising steps, rather than a single Transformer call. (§3, §4.3–4.4, Algorithm 1)

Stabilization: replace zero noise indicators on denoised frames with small nonzero values to signal possible history errors, without actually adding noise to those state–action predictions. Text control uses autoregressive denoising; goal-related tasks use gradual denoising that prioritizes near-future frames. (§4.3, Table 1)

Guidance: text uses CFG. Position, velocity, and dynamic-obstacle tasks define losses whose sample gradients propagate through predicted outputs to guide generation; MCG averages gradients from multiple samples. These gradients modify sampling, rather than training the network at test time. (Eqs.2–4; Appendix B)

Timing: generating again after every 8 executed motion frames does not guarantee that computation meets that deadline. Table 4 reports 9.5, 18, and 23 FPS for autoregressive, gradual, and full-sequence denoising on A100 with 5 DDIM steps; full-sequence denoising is less stable. Appendix D identifies inference inefficiency relative to RL policies. The paper does not describe overlapping asynchronous generation/execution or guarantee latency at the ninth-frame boundary. (§5.5, Table 4; Appendix D)

zh.title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting
zh.authors: David Müller, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer
zh.institutions: Disney Research, Switzerland
zh.status: 方法与关键实验已阅读
zh.takeaway: 用双层优化同时学习参考动作的几何修正与机器人 RL 跟踪策略，再把仿真中实际执行出的轨迹作为重定向数据。
zh.mainContent: ReActor 解决人体与机器人形态差异导致的脚滑、自穿透和难以跟踪的参考动作问题。方法从稀疏刚体配对生成参数化参考，上层优化位置、朝向和高度偏移，下层用 PPO 在物理仿真中学习跟踪，最终记录实际机器人轨迹。实验覆盖 Unitree G1、Lima 与 ANYmal D，并在 Lima 上展示实机应用；表 4 中，ReActor 数据训练的下游策略在 G1 和 Lima 上的成功率分别为 97.45% 和 95.07%。
innovations: 联合优化参考与策略：参考目标随跟踪误差调整，机器人策略同时学习跟踪；借助物理仿真的接触与碰撞处理生成重定向数据，无需预先规定接触时序。（第 2–3 页，图 2，式 1–3）
简化上层梯度：假设最优轨迹对参考变化的敏感度近似为标量乘单位矩阵，得到只需对几何映射求导的缩放梯度，避免对整个 RL 求解过程求导。（第 3 页，式 4–7）
稀疏、跨形态的参考参数化：仅需标准姿态下的刚体语义配对，允许源与目标的关节数量不同；固定的局部位置与朝向修正及每段动作的高度修正可联合学习。（第 3–4 页，图 3，式 8–14）
implementation: 输入与初始校准：提供人体与机器人的标准姿态，人工指定刚体配对及根部配对；按根部高度比缩放源动作，再由标准姿态自动计算固定位置偏移与旋转变换。GMR 是对比基线，不是此流程的前置步骤。（第 3–4、6 页）
几何修正：每个配对刚体学习三维局部位置偏移与旋转向量，每段动作学习一个世界竖直方向的高度偏移；参数在时间上保持常量。位置偏移随源刚体旋转，朝向修正在初始朝向右侧相乘，参数幅度受约束。（第 4 页，式 10–14；第 9 页）
参考与输出：几何映射给出配对刚体的位置、朝向和速度目标，不直接给出机器人关节角；策略接收本体观测与参考，输出关节位置目标及根部辅助力/力矩，以 50 Hz 经 PD 控制和仿真生成实际轨迹。（第 4–5 页，式 10–20）
上层更新：从当前策略 rollout 中采样参考与实际状态，按论文近似对参考映射参数求导，并做投影梯度更新；无需等下层策略完全收敛。默认上层位置/朝向权重为 10/1，线速度与角速度权重为 0。（第 3、6 页，式 3、6、7及表 2）
下层训练：PPO；策略与价值网络均为三层、每层 512 单元的 ELU MLP。使用筛选后的 AMASS、Isaac Sim 和 4096 个并行环境，20k 次训练迭代约 6 小时，单张 RTX 5090。（第 6 页）
起始姿态：根部状态对齐源动作，关节位置在机器人标准姿态附近随机采样；暂停参考，通过渐增的跟踪阶段变量让策略先到达起始姿态，该准备阶段的数据不用于上层参数优化。（第 5 页）
下游与迁移边界：重定向策略允许受惩罚的根部辅助力，生成数据后另训下游跟踪策略。同一目标机器人的策略可处理大量动作并测试未见动作；论文没有展示跨机器人共享控制策略，更换本体通常需要重新配对、校准并联合训练。（第 2、7–8 页；最后一句为基于控制接口与动力学的理解）

en.title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting
en.authors: David Müller, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer
en.institutions: Disney Research, Switzerland
en.takeaway: Jointly learns geometric reference corrections and a robot RL tracking policy through bilevel optimization, then uses actual simulated robot trajectories as retargeted data.
en.mainContent: ReActor addresses foot sliding, self-penetration, and difficult-to-track references caused by morphological differences between humans and robots. Sparse body correspondences define a parameterized reference; the upper level optimizes position, orientation, and height offsets while the lower level learns physics-based tracking with PPO, producing actual robot trajectories. Experiments cover Unitree G1, Lima, and ANYmal D, with hardware applications on Lima; downstream policies trained on ReActor data achieve success rates of 97.45% on G1 and 95.07% on Lima in Table 4.
innovations: Joint reference and policy optimization: references adapt to tracking errors while the policy learns to track, and simulated contacts and collisions shape the retargeted data without prescribed contact schedules. (pp. 2–3, Fig. 2, Eqs. 1–3)

Simplified upper-level gradient: a scalar-times-identity approximation of optimal trajectory sensitivity yields a scaled gradient through the geometric mapping, avoiding differentiation through the entire RL solution process. (p. 3, Eqs. 4–7)

Sparse cross-morphology parameterization: semantic body pairs in nominal poses support different joint counts, with learned constant local position/orientation offsets and a per-motion height correction. (pp. 3–4, Fig. 3, Eqs. 8–14)
implementation: Inputs and calibration: provide nominal human and robot configurations and manually select body pairs, including the root. Scale source motion by the root-height ratio and automatically compute fixed nominal position and rotation transforms. GMR is a comparison baseline, not a preprocessing stage. (pp. 3–4, 6)

Geometric corrections: learn a 3D local position offset and rotation vector per body pair and one world-vertical height offset per motion. Parameters remain constant over time; position offsets rotate with the source body, orientation corrections multiply on the right, and parameter magnitudes are constrained. (p. 4, Eqs. 10–14; p. 9)

References and outputs: the mapping produces paired-body position, orientation, and velocity targets rather than robot joint angles. The policy receives proprioception and references and outputs joint position setpoints plus auxiliary root forces/torques at 50 Hz; PD control and simulation produce the actual trajectory. (pp. 4–5, Eqs. 10–20)

Upper-level updates: sample reference/state pairs from current-policy rollouts, differentiate reference parameters using the paper’s approximation, and apply projected gradient updates without waiting for full lower-level convergence. Default upper-level position/orientation weights are 10/1; linear/angular velocity weights are zero. (pp. 3, 6, Eqs. 3, 6–7, Table 2)

Lower-level training: PPO with three-layer, 512-unit-per-layer ELU MLPs for both policy and value function. Filtered AMASS, Isaac Sim, 4096 parallel environments, and 20k training iterations in about 6 hours on one RTX 5090. (p. 6)

Initialization: align the root with the source and randomly sample joints around the robot nominal pose. Pause the reference and ramp a tracking-phase variable to learn the starting pose; preparation samples are excluded from upper-level updates. (p. 5)

Downstream use and transfer scope: the retargeting policy permits penalized auxiliary root wrenches; separate downstream tracking policies are trained on its output. One target-specific policy handles many motions and is tested on unseen motions; shared control across robots is not demonstrated, and changing the embodiment generally requires new pairing, calibration, and joint training. (pp. 2, 7–8; the final statement is an interpretation based on control interfaces and dynamics)

zh.title: HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion
zh.authors: Mike Zhang, Dongho Kang, Kevin Bergamin, Nicola Burger, Robin Deits, Jonathan Foster, Bilal Hammoud, Katie Hughes, Francesco Iacobelli, Twan Koolen, M. Eva Mungai, Zach Nobles, Shane Rozen-Levy, Jean Pierre Sleiman, Fangzhou Yu, Yunbo Zhang, Alfred Rizzi, Jessica Hodgins, Scott Kuindersma, Yeuhi Abe, Sylvain Bertrand, Farbod Farshidian
zh.institutions: RAI Institute; Boston Dynamics; Carnegie Mellon University
zh.status: 方法与关键实验已阅读
zh.takeaway: 先把完整参考动作教师蒸馏成速度指令学生，再用短时模仿与长时指令任务共同微调；先适配 critic，再放开 actor 更新。
zh.mainContent: HuMBLE 面向人形机器人自然步态与灵活指令控制之间的矛盾，使用约 3 小时人类运动数据学习可部署的运动策略。先用 PPO 训练完整参考条件教师，再通过 DAgger 变体蒸馏出仅接收本体感知与平面速度指令的 prior；随后以参考模仿和任意指令跟踪两组环境共同微调，兼顾风格与指令覆盖。方法分别在 Atlas R1、Atlas D1 和 Unitree G1 上部署，展示协调摆臂、脚跟到脚尖的接触过渡以及走跑切换，控制表现总体接近从零 RL 基线。
innovations: 将风格获取与指令空间扩展拆成两阶段：教师先实现物理可行的全身参考跟踪，学生再移除参考输入，最后通过多任务 RL 扩展数据稀疏区域的操控能力。（图 6，第 12–16 页）
用并行环境分组显式保持动作风格：参考引导组提供全身模仿奖励，目标条件组提供速度跟踪奖励；共享同一个 actor，默认 50:50 分配，比例可调节动作保真度与指令性能的折中。（式 7–8、图 5B，第 11、16 页）
面向蒸馏后 RL 微调设计价值函数适配与任务条件估值：先冻结 actor 预热 critic，再以仅 critic 可见的任务指示量和分组优势归一化处理两类回报。（第 16–17 页）
整理覆盖多速度、多方向及启停切换的动捕数据，并结合三种机器人上的部署、指令扫描和消融验证整套训练方案。（图 1–5，第 3–11、21 页）
implementation: 教师训练：输入本体感知、SE(2) 速度指令与完整参考状态；PPO 奖励由参考跟踪、正则和生存项组成。RSI 从参考状态采样并扰动初始化；非对称 critic 额外接收仿真特权信息。（式 3–5，第 15 页）
学生蒸馏：由学生 rollout，在学生实际到达的相同状态上查询教师动作，以动作差异做监督更新。学生只接收本体感知与速度指令；教师在此阶段提供动作标签，得到 prior。（式 6，第 15 页）
Critic 预热：微调加载 prior actor 和教师 critic，先在参考引导任务上冻结 actor、仅更新 critic 5000 次迭代，使教师价值函数适配学生行为，再联合更新 actor 与 critic。（第 16 页）
任务条件 critic：参考环境的支持指示量为 0，目标环境为 1，仅 critic 接收该指示量；两组分别归一化优势，减少任务间奖励尺度差异对 PPO 更新的影响。（式 5，第 16–17 页）
短模仿与长指令：参考组最长 3 s，用参考状态计算奖励但不给 actor 看参考，减轻不可观测参考造成的长期误差累积；目标组最长 8 s，episode 内重采样速度指令，训练持续运动与指令切换。默认各占 2048/4096 个环境。（第 16 页、表 S9）
GC-RSI：按速度指令对参考状态分桶，目标任务根据采样指令检索相近参考帧，再从其时间邻域采样并扰动作为初始状态。参考数据用于初始化，目标任务奖励不跟踪参考动作。（第 16 页）
保守微调：prior 为三层、每层 1024 单元的 ELU MLP；微调学习率为 1e-6，熵系数由教师阶段的 0.0015 降为 0.001，减少大幅更新对已有风格的破坏。（第 17 页、表 S9）
数据处理：重定向到机器人形态，估计并平滑躯干速度后作时间调整，生成速度指令标签，再镜像扩充。缩小本体时同步缩放动作时长以保持重力下的动态一致性；能力缺口可反馈到补采数据。（第 13–14、21 页）
真机适配：G1 初次部署出现踝关节过硬、落脚易绊的问题，通过训练地形粗糙度随机化增加落脚角度和接触条件变化；对户外线速度估计漂移另训去除线速度观测的策略版本。（第 17、24 页）
部署：单一 MLP 以 50 Hz 输出动作，经缩放和偏置变成关节位置目标，由 PD 跟踪。G1 上使用 ONNX Runtime，在 Jetson AGX Orin CPU 平均推理 1.1 ms；教师、参考动作与 critic 均不参与部署。（第 14、17、9 页）
关键验证：图 5 比较直接部分观测模仿与教师蒸馏、扫描五种参考/目标环境比例，并比较微调前后的指令覆盖。纯目标微调丢失风格，纯参考微调在测试侧移指令时失败；最终策略在该组指令扫描测试中没有摔倒。（第 10–11 页）
证据边界：自然度量化采用 DTW 对齐后的参考误差，G1 最终策略关节 MAE 为 0.055 rad，教师为 0.033 rad；高速响应通常慢于从零 RL。主要消融支持两阶段与分组训练，未单独隔离 critic 预热、GC-RSI 等每个细节的收益；上下箱由独立子策略完成。（第 7–11 页）

en.title: HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion
en.authors: Mike Zhang, Dongho Kang, Kevin Bergamin, Nicola Burger, Robin Deits, Jonathan Foster, Bilal Hammoud, Katie Hughes, Francesco Iacobelli, Twan Koolen, M. Eva Mungai, Zach Nobles, Shane Rozen-Levy, Jean Pierre Sleiman, Fangzhou Yu, Yunbo Zhang, Alfred Rizzi, Jessica Hodgins, Scott Kuindersma, Yeuhi Abe, Sylvain Bertrand, Farbod Farshidian
en.institutions: RAI Institute; Boston Dynamics; Carnegie Mellon University
en.takeaway: Distill a full-reference teacher into a velocity-commanded student, then fine-tune with short imitation and long command-tracking tasks; adapt the critic before unfreezing actor updates.
en.mainContent: HuMBLE addresses the trade-off between natural humanoid gait and flexible command following using approximately three hours of human locomotion data. PPO first trains a full-reference-conditioned teacher, a DAgger variant distills it into a proprioception-and-planar-velocity-conditioned prior, and reference-imitation and arbitrary-command environments jointly fine-tune the prior for style retention and command coverage. Target-specific policies are deployed on Atlas R1, Atlas D1, and Unitree G1, exhibiting coordinated arm swing, heel-to-toe contact transitions, and walking-to-running transitions while achieving control performance broadly comparable to a Tabula Rasa RL baseline.
innovations: Separates style acquisition from command-space expansion: the teacher learns dynamically feasible full-body tracking, the student removes reference inputs, and multi-task RL expands controllability in sparsely represented command regions. (Fig. 6, pp. 12–16)

Explicitly preserves style through parallel environment groups: reference environments supply full-body imitation rewards and goal environments supply velocity-tracking rewards to one shared actor. The default 50:50 allocation offers an adjustable fidelity–tracking trade-off. (Eqs. 7–8, Fig. 5B, pp. 11, 16)

Adapts value estimation for post-distillation RL: warm-start the critic with a frozen actor, then distinguish task returns using a critic-only task indicator and normalize advantages separately by group. (pp. 16–17)

Curates motion capture spanning speeds, directions, and start/stop transitions, and validates the complete recipe through three robot deployments, command sweeps, and ablations. (Figs. 1–5, pp. 3–11, 21)
implementation: Teacher training: proprioception, SE(2) velocity commands, and full reference states feed a PPO actor with tracking, regularization, and survival rewards. RSI samples and perturbs reference states; an asymmetric critic additionally observes privileged simulation information. (Eqs. 3–5, p. 15)

Student distillation: the student generates rollouts; the teacher is queried at the same student-visited states to label expert actions, and supervised action matching trains the prior. Only proprioception and velocity commands enter the student; the teacher supplies action labels in this stage. (Eq. 6, p. 15)

Critic warm-start: load the prior actor and teacher critic, freeze the actor, and train only the critic for 5000 iterations on the reference-guided task to adapt value estimates to student behavior before joint actor–critic optimization. (p. 16)

Task-conditioned critic: the support indicator is 0 for reference environments and 1 for goal environments and is visible only to the critic. Normalize advantages separately for both groups to mitigate reward-scale differences in PPO updates. (Eq. 5, pp. 16–17)

Short imitation and long command tasks: reference episodes last up to 3 s and compute imitation rewards without exposing references to the actor, limiting accumulated drift from hidden references. Goal episodes last up to 8 s and resample commands within episodes for sustained locomotion and transitions. The default split is 2048/4096 environments per task. (p. 16, Table S9)

GC-RSI: bin reference states by annotated velocity commands, retrieve a similar-command frame, sample in its temporal neighborhood, and perturb the initial state. References initialize goal rollouts but do not define their tracking reward. (p. 16)

Conservative fine-tuning: the prior is a three-layer ELU MLP with 1024 units per layer. Fine-tuning uses a 1e-6 learning rate and reduces entropy regularization from 0.0015 in teacher training to 0.001 to limit disruption of learned style. (p. 17, Table S9)

Data processing: retarget human motion, estimate and smooth torso velocities, temporally adjust command labels, and mirror trajectories. Scale motion duration with body size to preserve gravitational dynamic consistency; observed capability gaps can guide additional data collection. (pp. 13–14, 21)

Hardware adaptation: initial G1 deployment exposed stiff ankles and stumbling, addressed by terrain-roughness randomization that diversifies landing angles and contact conditions. A separate policy variant omits linear-velocity observations for outdoor estimation drift. (pp. 17, 24)

Deployment: one MLP outputs actions at 50 Hz, scaled and offset into joint position targets tracked by PD controllers. ONNX Runtime inference averages 1.1 ms on the G1 Jetson AGX Orin CPU; teachers, reference motions, and critics are absent at deployment. (pp. 14, 17, 9)

Key validation: Fig. 5 compares direct partial-observation imitation with teacher distillation, sweeps five reference/goal allocation ratios, and compares command coverage before and after fine-tuning. Goal-only fine-tuning loses style, reference-only fine-tuning fails the tested sidestep command, and the final policy does not fall in the reported command sweep. (pp. 10–11)

Evidence scope: fidelity uses DTW-aligned reference errors; final G1 joint MAE is 0.055 rad versus 0.033 rad for the teacher. High-speed response is typically slower than Tabula Rasa RL. Main ablations support staged and grouped training without isolating every detail such as critic warm-start or GC-RSI; separate sub-policies handle box climbing. (pp. 7–11)
